H1.gloss: father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application
H1.def: a primitive word; father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application KJV: chief, (fore-) father(-less), [idiom] patrimony, principal. Compare names in 'Abi-'.

H3.def: from the same as H24 (אָבִיב); a green plant KJV: greenness, fruit.

H4.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3 (אֵב) {a green plant} KJV: fruit.

H5.def: of foreign origin; Abagtha, a eunuch of Xerxes KJV: Abagtha.

H6.def: a primitive root; properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy) KJV: break, destroy(-uction), [phrase] not escape, fail, lose, (cause to, make) perish, spend, [idiom] and surely, take, be undone, [idiom] utterly, be void of, have no way to flee.

H7.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H6 (אָבַד) {properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy)} KJV: destroy, perish.

H8.def: active of participle of H6 (אָבַד); (concrete) wretched or (abstract) destruction KJV: perish.

H9.def: from H6 (אָבַד); Compare H10 (אֲבַדֹּה). concrete, something lost; abstract, destruction, i.e. Hades KJV: lost.

H10.def: the same as H9 (אֲבֵדָה), miswritten for H11 (אֲבַדּוֹן); a perishing KJV: destruction.

H11.def: intensive from H6 (אָבַד); abstract, a perishing; concrete, Hades KJV: destruction.

H12.def: from H6 (אָבַד); a perishing KJV: destruction.

H13.def: from H6 (אָבַד); a perishing KJV: destruction.

H14.def: a primitive root; to breathe after, i.e. (figuratively) to be acquiescent KJV: consent, rest content will, be willing.

H16.def: from H14 (אָבָה) (in the sense of bending toward); the papyrus KJV: swift.

H17.def: from H14 (אָבָה) (in the sense of desiring); want KJV: sorrow.

H18.def: from H75 (אָבַס); a manger or stall KJV: crib.

H19.def: from an unused root (apparently meaning to turn); brandishing of a sword KJV: point.

H20.def: of uncertain derivation; a melon (only plural) KJV: melon.

H21.def: from H1 (אָב); fatherly; Abi, Hezekiah's mother KJV: Abi.

H22.gloss: Abiel, the name of two Israelites
H22.def: from H1 (אָב) and H410 (אֵל); father (i.e. possessor) of God; Abiel, the name of two Israelites KJV: Abiel.

H23.def: from H1 (אָב) and H622 (אָסַף); father of gathering (i.e. gatherer); Abiasaph, an Israelite KJV: Abiasaph.

H24.def: from an unused root (meaning to be tender); green, i.e. a young ear of grain; hence, the name of the month Abib or Nisan KJV: Abib, ear, green ears of corn (not maize).

H25.def: from H1 (אָב) and H1391 (גִּבְעוֹן); father (i.e. founder) of Gibon; Abi-Gibon, perhaps an Israelite KJV: father of Gibeon.

H26.gloss: Abigail or Abigal, the name of two Israelitesses
H26.def: or shorter אֲבִיגַל; from H1 (אָב) and H1524 (גִּיל); father (i.e. source) of joy; Abigail or Abigal, the name of two Israelitesses KJV: Abigal.

H27.def: from H1 (אָב) and H1777 (דִּין); father of judgment (i.e. judge); Abidan, an Israelite KJV: Abidan.

H28.gloss: Abida, a son of Abraham by Keturah
H28.def: from H1 (אָב) and H3045 (יָדַע); father of knowledge (i.e. knowing); Abida, a son of Abraham by Keturah KJV: Abida, Abidah.

H29.gloss: Abijah, the name of several Israelite men and two Israelitesses
H29.def: or prolonged אֲבִיָּהוּ ; from H1 (אָב) and H3050 (יָהּ); father (i.e. worshipper) of Jah; Abijah, the name of several Israelite men and two Israelitesses KJV: Abiah, Abijah.

H30.def: from H1 (אָב) and H1931 (הוּא); father (i.e. worshipper) of Him (i.e. God); Abihu, a son of Aaron KJV: Abihu.

H31.gloss: Abihud, the name of two Israelites
H31.def: from H1 (אָב) and H1935 (הוֹד); father (i.e. possessor) of renown; Abihud, the name of two Israelites KJV: Abihud.

H32.gloss: Abihail or Abichail, the name of three Israelites and two Israelitesses
H32.def: or (more correctly) אֲבִיחַיִל ; from H1 (אָב) and H2428 (חַיִל); father (i.e. possessor) of might; Abihail or Abichail, the name of three Israelites and two Israelitesses KJV: Abihail.

H33.gloss: an Abiezrite or descendant of Abiezer
H33.def: from H44 (אֲבִיעֶזֶר) with the article inserted; father of the Ezrite; an Abiezrite or descendant of Abiezer KJV: Abiezrite.

H34.def: from H14 (אָבָה), in the sense of want (especially in feeling); destitute KJV: beggar, needy, poor (man).

H35.def: from H14 (אָבָה); provocative of desire; the caper berry (from its stimulative taste) KJV: desire.

H36.def: from H1 (אָב) and H2898 (טוּב); father of goodness (i.e. good); Abitub, an Israelite KJV: Abitub.

H37.gloss: Abital, a wife of King David
H37.def: from H1 (אָב) and H2919 (טַל); father of dew (i.e. fresh); Abital, a wife of King David KJV: Abital.

H38.gloss: Abijam (or Abijah), a king of Judah
H38.def: from H1 (אָב) and H3220 (יָם); father of (the) sea (i.e. seaman); Abijam (or Abijah), a king of Judah KJV: Abijam.

H39.def: from H1 (אָב) and an elsewhere unused (probably foreign) word; father of Mael (apparently some Arab tribe); Abimael, a son of Joktan KJV: Abimael.

H40.gloss: Abimelek, the name of two Philistine kings and of two Israelites
H40.def: from H1 (אָב) and H4428 (מֶלֶךְ); father of (the) king; Abimelek, the name of two Philistine kings and of two Israelites KJV: Abimelech.

H41.gloss: Abinadab, the name of four Israelites
H41.def: from H1 (אָב) and H5068 (נָדַב); father of generosity (i.e. liberal); Abinadab, the name of four Israelites KJV: Abinadab.

H42.def: from H1 (אָב) and H5278 (נֹעַם); father of pleasantness (i.e. gracious); Abinoam, an Israelite KJV: Abinoam.

H43.def: contracted from H23 (אֲבִיאָסָף); Ebjasaph, an Israelite KJV: Ebiasaph.

H44.gloss: Abiezer, the name of two Israelites
H44.def: from H1 (אָב) and H5829 (עֵזֶר); father of help (i.e. helpful); Abiezer, the name of two Israelites KJV: Abiezer.

H45.def: from H1 (אָב) and an unused root of uncertain derivation; probably, father of strength (i.e. valiant); Abialbon, an Israelite KJV: Abialbon.

H46.def: from H82 (אָבַר); mighty (spoken of God) KJV: mighty (one).

H47.def: for H46 (אָבִיר) {mighty (spoken of God)} KJV: angel, bull, chiefest, mighty (one), stout(-hearted), strong (one), valiant.

H48.gloss: Abiram, the name of two Israelites
H48.def: from H1 (אָב) and H7311 (רוּם); father of height (i.e. lofty); Abiram, the name of two Israelites KJV: Abiram.

H49.def: from H1 (אָב) and H7686 (שָׁגָה); father of error (i.e. blundering); Abishag, a concubine of David KJV: Abishag.

H50.gloss: Abishua, the name of two Israelites
H50.def: from H1 (אָב) and H7771 (שׁוֹעַ); father of plenty (i.e. prosperous); Abishua, the name of two Israelites KJV: Abishua.

H51.def: from H1 (אָב) and H7791 (שׁוּר); father of (the) wall (i.e. perhaps mason); Abishur, an Israelite KJV: Abishur.

H52.def: or (shorter) אַבְשַׁי ; from H1 (אָב) and H7862 (שַׁי); father of a gift (i.e. probably generous); Abishai, an Israelite KJV: Abishai.

H53.def: or (shortened) אַבְשָׁלוֹם ; from H1 (אָב) and H7965 (שָׁלוֹם); father of peace (i.e. friendly); Abshalom, a son of David; also (the fuller form) a later Israelite KJV: Abishalom, Absalom.

H54.def: contracted from H1 (אָב) and H3498 (יָתַר); father of abundance (i.e. liberal); Ebjathar, an Israelite KJV: Abiathar.

H55.def: a primitive root; probably to coil upward KJV: mount up.

H56.def: a primitive root; to bewail KJV: lament, mourn.

H58.def: from an unused root (meaning to be grassy); a meadow KJV: plain. Compare also the proper names beginning with Abel-.

H59.gloss: Abel, the name of two places in Palestine
H59.def: from H58 (אָבֵל); a meadow; Abel, the name of two places in Palestine. KJV: Abel.

H61.def: apparently from H56 (אָבַל) through the idea of negation; nay, i.e. truly or yet KJV: but, indeed, nevertheless, verily.

H62.gloss: Abel of Beth-maakah, a place in Palestine
H62.def: from H58 (אָבֵל) and H1004 (בַּיִת) and H4601 (מַעֲכָה); meadow of Beth-Maakah; Abel of Beth-maakah, a place in Palestine KJV: Abel-beth-maachah, Abel of Beth-maachah,

H63.gloss: Abel hash-Shittim, a place in Palestine
H63.def: from H58 (אָבֵל) and the plural of H7848 (שִׁטָּה), with the article inserted; meadow of the acacias; Abel hash-Shittim, a place in Palestine KJV: Abelshittim.

H64.def: from H58 (אָבֵל) and the plural of H3754 (כֶּרֶם); meadow of vineyards; Abel-Keramim, a place in Palestine KJV: plain of the vineyards.

H65.def: from H58 (אָבֵל) and H4246 (מְחֹלָה)xlit mᵉchôwlâh corrected to mᵉchôlâh; meadow of dancing; Abel-Mecholah, a place in Palestine KJV: Abel-meholah.

H66.def: from H58 (אָבֵל) and H4325 (מַיִם); meadow of water; Abel-Majim, a place in Palestine KJV: Abel-maim.

H67.def: from H58 (אָבֵל) and H4714 (מִצְרַיִם); meadow of Egypt; Abel-Mitsrajim, a place in Palestine KJV: Abel-mizraim.

H68.def: from the root of H1129 (בָּנָה) through the meaning to build; a stone KJV: [phrase] carbuncle, [phrase] mason, [phrase] plummet, (chalk-, hail-, head-, sling-) stone(-ny), (divers) weight(-s).

H69.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H68 (אֶבֶן) {a stone} KJV: stone.

H70.def: from the same as H68 (אֶבֶן); a pair of stones (only dual); a potter's wheel or a midwife's stool (consisting alike of two horizontal disks with a support between) KJV: wheel, stool.

H71.def: perhaps feminine of H68 (אֶבֶן); stony;  Compare H549 (אֲמָנָה). Abanah, a river near Damascus KJV: Abana.

H72.def: from H68 (אֶבֶן) and H5828 (עֵזֶר) with the article inserted; stone of the help; Eben-ha-Ezer, a place in Palestine KJV: Ebenezer.

H73.def: of uncertain derivation; a belt KJV: girdle.

H74.def: or (fully) אֲבִינֵר ; from H1 (אָב) and H5216 (נִיר); father of light (i.e. enlightening); Abner, an Israelite KJV: Abner.

H75.def: a primitive root; to fodder KJV: fatted, stalled.

H76.def: (by reduplication) from an unused root (meaning to belch forth); an inflammatory pustule (as eruption) KJV: blains.

H77.def: from an unused root probably meaning to gleam; conspicuous; Ebets, a place in Palestine KJV: Abez.

H78.def: from the same as H76 (אֲבַעְבֻּעָה); splendid; Ibtsan, an Israelite KJV: Ibzan.

H79.def: a primitive root, probably to float away (as vapor), but used only as denominative from H80 (אָבָק); to bedust, i.e. grapple KJV: wrestle.

H80.def: from root of H79 (אָבַק); light particles (as volatile) KJV: (small) dust, powder.

H81.def: feminine of H80 (אָבָק) {light particles (as volatile)} KJV: powder.

H82.def: a primitive root; to soar KJV: fly.

H83.def: from H82 (אָבַר); a pinion KJV: (long-) wing(-ed).

H84.def: feminine of H83 (אֵבֶר) {a pinion} KJV: feather, wing.

H85.gloss: Abraham, the later name of Abram
H85.def: contracted from H1 (אָב) and an unused root (probably meaning to be populous); father of a multitude; Abraham, the later name of Abram KJV: Abraham.

H86.def: probably an Egyptian word meaning kneel KJV: bow the knee.

H87.gloss: Abram, the original name of Abraham
H87.def: contracted from H48 (אֲבִירָם); high father; Abram, the original name of Abraham KJV: Abram.

H88.gloss: Oboth, a place in the Desert
H88.def: plural of H178 (אוֹב); water-skins; Oboth, a place in the Desert KJV: Oboth.

H89.def: of uncertain derivation (compare H90 (אֲגַג)); Age, an Israelite KJV: Agee.

H90.gloss: Agag, a title of Amalekitish kings
H90.def: or אֲגָג; of uncertain derivation (compare H89 (אָגֵא)); flame; Agag, a title of Amalekitish kings KJV: Agag.

H91.gloss: an Agagite or descendent (subject) of Agag
H91.def: patrial or patronymic from H90 (אֲגַג); an Agagite or descendent (subject) of Agag KJV: Agagite.

H92.gloss: a band, bundle, knot, or arch
H92.def: feminine passive participle of an unused root (meaning to bind); a band, bundle, knot, or arch KJV: bunch, burden, troop.

H93.def: prob of Persian origin; a nut KJV: nut.

H94.gloss: Agur, a fanciful name for Solomon
H94.def: passive participle of H103 (אָגַר); gathered (i.e. received among the sages); Agur, a fanciful name for Solomon KJV: Agur.

H95.def: from the same as H94 (אָגוּר); properly, something gathered, i.e. perhaps a grain or berry; used only of a small (silver) coin KJV: piece (of) silver.

H96.def: from an unused root (meaning to flow down or together as drops); a reservoir KJV: drop.

H97.def: dual of H96 (אֶגֶל).; a double pond; Eglajim, a place in Moab KJV: Eglaim.

H98.def: from an unused root (meaning to collect as water); a marsh; hence a rush (as growing in swamps); hence a stockade of reeds KJV: pond, pool, standing (water).

H99.def: probably from the same as H98 (אֲגַם) (in the sense of stagnant water); figuratively, sad KJV: pond.

H100.def: from the same as H98 (אֲגַם); a marshy pool (others from a different root, a kettle); by implication a bulrush (as growing there); collectively a rope of bulrushes KJV: bulrush, caldron, hook, rush.

H101.def: probably from H5059 (נָגַן); a bowl (as pounded out hollow) KJV: basin, cup, goblet.

H102.gloss: (only plural) wings of an army, or crowds of troops
H102.def: probably from H5062 (נָגַף) (through the idea of impending); a cover or heap; i.e. (only plural) wings of an army, or crowds of troops KJV: bands.

H103.def: a primitive root; to harvest KJV: gather.

H104.gloss: an epistle (as carried by a state courier or postman)
H104.def: (Aramaic) of Persian origin; an epistle (as carried by a state courier or postman) KJV: letter.

H105.def: of uncertain derivation; a basin KJV: charger.

H106.def: from H1640 (גָּרַף) (in the sense of grasping); the clenched hand KJV: fist.

H107.def: feminine of H104 (אִגְּרָא); an epistle KJV: letter.

H108.def: from the same as H181 (אוּד) (in the sense of enveloping); a fog KJV: mist, vapor.

H109.def: a primitive root; to languish KJV: grieve.

H110.def: probably from H109 (אָדַב) (in the sense of chastisement) and H410 (אֵל); disciplined of God; Adbeel, a son of Ishmael KJV: Adbeel.

H111.def: probably an orthographical variation for H2301 (חֲדַד); Adad (or Hadad), an Edomite KJV: Hadad.

H112.def: of uncertain derivation; Iddo, an Israelite KJV: Iddo.

H113.def: or (shortened) אָדֹן; from an unused root (meaning to rule); sovereign, i.e. controller (human or divine) KJV: lord, master, owner. Compare also names beginning with 'Adoni-'.

H114.def: probably intensive for H113 (אָדוֹן); powerful; Addon, apparently an Israelite KJV: Addon.

H115.def: dual from H142 (אָדַר) (in the sense of eminence); double mound; Adorajim, a place in Palestine KJV: Adoraim.

H116.def: (Aramaic) of uncertain derivation; then (of time) KJV: now, that time, then.

H117.def: from H142 (אָדַר); wide or (generally) large; figuratively, powerful KJV: excellent, famous, gallant, glorious, goodly, lordly, mighty(-ier one), noble, principal, worthy.

H118.def: of Persian derivation; Adalja, a son of Haman KJV: Adalia.

H119.def: to show blood (in the face), i.e. flush or turn rosy KJV: be (dyed, made) red (ruddy).

H120.def: from H119 (אָדַם); ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.) KJV: [idiom] another, [phrase] hypocrite, [phrase] common sort, [idiom] low, man (mean, of low degree), person.

H121.gloss: Adam the name of the first man, also of a place in Palestine
H121.def: the same as H120 (אָדָם); Adam the name of the first man, also of a place in Palestine KJV: Adam.

H122.def: from H119 (אָדַם); rosy KJV: red, ruddy.

H123.gloss: Edom, the elder twin-brother of Jacob
H123.def: or (fully) אֱדוֹם ; from H122 (אָדֹם); red (see Genesis 25:25); Edom, the elder twin-brother of Jacob; hence the region (Idumaea) occupied by him KJV: Edom, Edomites, Idumea.

H124.def: from H119 (אָדַם); redness, i.e. the ruby, garnet, or some other red gem KJV: sardius.

H125.def: reduplicated from H119 (אָדַם); reddish KJV: (somewhat) reddish.

H126.gloss: Admah, a place near the Dead Sea
H126.def: contracted for H127 (אֲדָמָה); earthy; Admah, a place near the Dead Sea KJV: Admah.

H127.def: from H119 (אָדַם); soil (from its general redness) KJV: country, earth, ground, husband(-man) (-ry), land.

H128.def: the same as H127 (אֲדָמָה); Adamah, a place in Palestine KJV: Adamah.

H129.def: from H127 (אֲדָמָה); earthy; Adami, a place in Palestine KJV: Adami.

H130.gloss: an Edomite, or descendants from (or inhabitants of) Edom
H130.def: or (fully) אֱדוֹמִי ; patronymic from H123 (אֱדֹם); See H726 (אֲרוֹמִי). an Edomite, or descendants from (or inhabitants of) Edom KJV: Edomite.

H131.def: plural of H121 (אָדָם); red spots; Adummim, a pass in Palestine KJV: Adummim.

H132.gloss: reddish (of the hair or the complexion)
H132.def: or (fully) אַדְמוֹנִי ; from H119 (אָדַם); reddish (of the hair or the complexion) KJV: red, ruddy.

H133.def: probably of Persian derivation; Admatha, a Persian nobleman KJV: Admatha.

H134.gloss: a basis (of a building, a column, etc
H134.def: from the same as H113 (אָדוֹן) (in the sense of strength); a basis (of a building, a column, etc.) KJV: foundation, socket.

H135.def: intensive from the same as H134 (אֶדֶן); firm; Addan, an Israelite KJV: Addan.

H136.gloss: the Lord (used as a proper name of God only)
H136.def: an emphatic form of H113 (אָדוֹן); the Lord (used as a proper name of God only) KJV: (my) Lord.

H137.def: from H113 (אָדוֹן) and H966 (בֶּזֶק); lord of Bezek; Adoni-Bezek; a Canaanitish king KJV: Adonibezek.

H138.gloss: Adonijah, the name of three Israelites
H138.def: original (prolonged) אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ ; from H113 (אָדוֹן) and H3050 (יָהּ); lord (i.e. worshipper) of Jah; Adonijah, the name of three Israelites KJV: Adonijah.

H139.def: from H113 (אָדוֹן) and H6664 (צֶדֶק); lord of justice; Adoni-Tsedek, a Canaanitish king KJV: Adonizedec.

H140.gloss: Adonikam, the name of one or two Israelites
H140.def: from H113 (אָדוֹן) and H6965 (קוּם); lord of rising (i.e. high); Adonikam, the name of one or two Israelites KJV: Adonikam.

H141.def: from H113 (אָדוֹן) and H7311 (רוּם); lord of height; Adoniram, an Israelite KJV: Adoniram.

H142.def: a primitive root; to expand, i.e. be great or (figuratively) magnificent KJV: (become) glorious, honourable.

H143.def: probably of foreign derivation; perhaps meaning fire; Adar, the 12th Hebrew month KJV: Adar.

H144.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H143 (אֲדָר) {Adar, the 12th Hebrew month} KJV: Adar.

H145.def: from H142 (אָדַר); amplitude, i.e. (concrete) a mantle; also (figuratively) splendor KJV: goodly, robe.

H146.def: intensive from H142 (אָדַר); ample; Addar, a place in Palestine; also an Israelite KJV: Addar.

H147.def: (Aramaic) intensive, from a root corresponding to H142 (אָדַר); ample, i.e. a threshing-floor KJV: threshingfloor.

H148.def: (Aramaic) from the same as H147 (אִדַּר), and H1505 (גְּזַר); a chief diviner, or astrologer KJV: judge.

H149.def: (Aramaic) probably of Persian origin; quickly or carefully KJV: diligently.

H150.def: of Persian origin; a daric or Persian coin KJV: dram.

H151.def: contracted for H141 (אֲדֹנִירָם); Adoram (or Adoniram), an Israelite KJV: Adoram.

H152.gloss: Adrammelek, the name of an Assyrian idol, also of a son of Sennacherib
H152.def: from H142 (אָדַר) and H4428 (מֶלֶךְ); splendor of (the) king; Adrammelek, the name of an Assyrian idol, also of a son of Sennacherib KJV: Adrammelech.

H153.def: (Aramaic) an orthographical variation for H1872 (דְּרַע); an arm, i.e. (figuratively) power KJV: force.

H154.gloss: Edrei, the name of two places in Palestine
H154.def: from the equivalent of H153 (אֶדְרָע); mighty; Edrei, the name of two places in Palestine KJV: Edrei.

H155.gloss: something ample (as a large vine, a wide dress)
H155.def: feminine of H117 (אַדִּיר); ; also the same as H145 (אֶדֶר) something ample (as a large vine, a wide dress) KJV: garment, glory, goodly, mantle, robe.

H761.def: patrial from H758 (אֲרָם); an Aramite or Aramaean KJV: Syrian, Aramitess.

H762.def: feminine of H761 (אֲרַמִּי); (only adverbial) in Aramean KJV: in the Syrian language (tongue), in Syriac.

H763.gloss: Aram of (the) two rivers (Euphrates and Tigris) or Mesopotamia
H763.def: from H758 (אֲרָם) and the dual of H5104 (נָהָר); Aram of (the) two rivers (Euphrates and Tigris) or Mesopotamia KJV: Aham-naharaim, Mesopotamia.

H764.def: from H759 (אַרְמוֹן); palatial; Armoni, an Israelite KJV: Armoni.

H765.def: from H7442 (רָנַן); stridulous; Aran, an Edomite KJV: Aran.

H766.def: from the same as H765 (אֲרָן) (in the sense of strength); the ash tree (from its toughness) KJV: ash.

H767.def: the same as H766 (אֹרֶן); Oren, an Israelite KJV: Oren.

H768.def: of uncertain derivation; the hare KJV: hare.

H769.gloss: the Arnon, a river east of the Jordan, also its territory

H770.def: probably from the same as H769 (אַרְנוֹן); noisy; Arnan, an Israelite KJV: Arnan.

H774.def: from H7502 (רָפַד); spread out; Arpad, a place in Syria KJV: Arpad, Arphad.

H775.def: probably of foreign origin; Arpakshad, a son of Noah; also the region settled by him KJV: Arphaxad.

H776.gloss: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H776.def: from an unused root probably meaning to be firm; the earth (at large, or partitively a land) KJV: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.

H777.def: from H776 (אֶרֶץ); earthiness; Artsa, an Israelite KJV: Arza.

H778.def: (Aramaic) by transmutation for H772 (אֲרַע); the earth KJV: earth.

H779.def: a primitive root; to execrate KJV: [idiom] bitterly curse.

H780.def: of foreign origin; Ararat (or rather Armenia) KJV: Ararat, Armenia.

H781.def: a primitive root; to engage for matrimony KJV: betroth, espouse.

H782.def: from H781 (אָרַשׂ) (in the sense of desiring to possess); a longing for KJV: request.

H783.gloss: Artachshasta (or Artaxerxes), a title (rather than name) of several Persian kings

H785.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H784 (אֵשׁ) {fire (literally or figuratively)} KJV: flame.

H786.gloss: entity, used only adverbially, there is or are
H786.def: identical (in origin and formation) with H784 (אֵשׁ); entity, used only adverbially, there is or are KJV: are there, none can. Compare H3426 (יֵשׁ).

H788.def: probably from the same as H7640 (שֹׁבֶל); flowing; Ashbel, an Israelite KJV: Ashbel.

H789.gloss: an Ashbelite (collectively) or descendant of Ashbel

H790.def: probably from the same as H7644 (שֶׁבְנָא); vigorous; Eshban, an Idumaean KJV: Eshban.

H794.def: feminine of H793 (אֶשֶׁד); a ravine KJV: springs.

H795.def: from H7703 (שָׁדַד); ravager; Ashdod, a place in Palestine KJV: Ahdod.

H796.gloss: an Ashdodite (often collectively) or inhabitant of Asdod
H796.def: patrial from H795 (אַשְׁדּוֹד); an Ashdodite (often collectively) or inhabitant of Asdod KJV: Ashdodites, of Ashdod.

H797.gloss: (only adverb) in the language of Ashdod
H797.def: feminine of H796 (אַשְׁדּוֹדִי); (only adverb) in the language of Ashdod KJV: in the speech of Ashdod.

H798.gloss: Ashdoth-Pisgah, a place east of the Jordan
H798.def: from the plural of H794 (אֲשֵׁדָה) and H6449 (פִּסְגָּה) with the article interposed; ravines of the Pisgah; Ashdoth-Pisgah, a place east of the Jordan KJV: Ashdoth-pisgah.

H804.gloss: Ashshur, the second son of Shem
H804.def: or אַשֻּׁר; apparently from H833 (אָשַׁר) (in the sense of successful); Ashshur, the second son of Shem; also his descendants and the country occupied by them (i.e. Assyria), its region and its empire KJV: Asshur, Assur, Assyria, Assyrians. See H838 (אָשֻׁר).

H805.gloss: an Ashurite (collectively) or inhabitant of Ashur, a district in Palestine
H805.def: or אַשּׁוּרִי; from a patrial word of the same form as H804 (אַשּׁוּר); an Ashurite (collectively) or inhabitant of Ashur, a district in Palestine KJV: Asshurim, Ashurites.

H806.def: probably from H7835 (שָׁחַר); black; Ashchur, an Israelite KJV: Ashur.

H807.def: of foreign origin; Ashima, a deity of Hamath KJV: Ashima.

H811.gloss: a bunch of grapes or other fruit

H815.def: from a root of uncertain signification; a tamarisk tree; by extension, a grove of any kind KJV: grove, tree.

H817.def: from H816 (אָשַׁם); guilt; by implication, a fault; also a sin-offering KJV: guiltiness, (offering for) sin, trespass (offering).

H818.def: from H816 (אָשַׁם); guilty; hence, presenting asin-offering KJV: one which is faulty, guilty.

H820.def: probably from H8081 (שֶׁמֶן); a fat-field KJV: desolate place.

H821.def: or אַשׁמוּרָה; or אַשׁמֹרֶת; (feminine) from H8104 (שָׁמַר); a night watch KJV: watch.

H822.def: apparently from an unused root (probably meaning to leave interstices); a latticed window KJV: casement, lattice.

H826.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H825 (אַשָּׁף) {a conjurer} KJV: astrologer.

H1162.def: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Boaz, the ancestor of David; also the name of a pillar in front of the temple KJV: Boaz.

H1164.def: from H1158 (בָּעָה); a prayer KJV: grave.

H1165.def: from H1197 (בָּעַר) (in the sense of eating); cattle KJV: beast, cattle.

H1169.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H1167 (בַּעַל) {a master; hence, a husband,} KJV: [phrase] chancellor.

H1170.gloss: Baal-Berith, a special deity of the Shechemites
H1170.def: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H1285 (בְּרִית); Baal of (the) covenant; Baal-Berith, a special deity of the Shechemites KJV: Baal-berith.

H1171.def: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H1409 (גָּד); Baal of Fortune; Baal-Gad, a place in Syria KJV: Baal-gad.

H1172.def: feminine of H1167 (בַּעַל); a mistress KJV: that hath, mistress.

H1173.gloss: Baalah, the name of three places in Palestine
H1173.def: the same as H1172 (בַּעֲלָה); Baalah, the name of three places in Palestine KJV: Baalah.

H1174.def: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H1995 (הָמוֹן); possessor of a multitude; Baal-Hamon, a place in Palestine KJV: Baal-hamon.

H1175.def: plural of H1172 (בַּעֲלָה); mistresses; Bealoth, a place in Palestine KJV: Bealoth, in Aloth (by mistake for a plural from H5927 (עָלָה) with prepositional prefix).

H1176.gloss: Baal-Zebub, a special deity of the Ekronites
H1176.def: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H2070 (זְבוּב); Baal of (the) Fly; Baal-Zebub, a special deity of the Ekronites KJV: Baal-zebub.

H1177.gloss: Baal-Chanan, the name of an Edomite, also of an Israelite
H1177.def: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H2603 (חָנַן); possessor of grace; Baal-Chanan, the name of an Edomite, also of an Israelite KJV: Baal-hanan.

H1178.def: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and a modification of H2691 (חָצֵר); possessor of a village; Baal-Chatsor, a place in Palestine KJV: Baal-hazor.

H1179.def: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H2768 (חֶרְמוֹן); possessor of Hermon; Baal-Chermon, a place in Palestine KJV: Baal-hermon.

H1180.gloss: Baali, a symbolical name for Jehovah
H1180.def: from H1167 (בַּעַל) with pron. suff.; my master; Baali, a symbolical name for Jehovah KJV: Baali.

H1181.gloss: Baale-Bamoth, a place East of the Jordan
H1181.def: from the plural of H1168 (בַּעַל) and the plural of H1116 (בָּמָה); Baals of (the) heights; Baale-Bamoth, a place East of the Jordan KJV: lords of the high places.

H1182.def: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H3045 (יָדַע); Baal has known; Beeljada, an Israelite KJV: Beeliada.

H1183.def: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah (is) master; Bealjah, an Israelite KJV: Bealiah.

H1184.def: from the plural of H1167 (בַּעַל) and H3063 (יְהוּדָה); masters of Judah; Baale-Jehudah, a place in Palestine KJV: Baale of Judah.

H1185.def: probably from a derivative of H5965 (עָלַס) with prepositional prefix; in exultation; Baalis, an Ammonitish king KJV: Baalis.

H1186.gloss: Baal-Meon, a place East of the Jordan
H1186.def: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H4583 (מָעוֹן); Baal of (the) habitation (of) (compare H1010 (בֵּית בַּעַל מְעוֹן)); Baal-Meon, a place East of the Jordan KJV: Baal-meon.

H1187.def: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H6465 (פְּעוֹר); Baal of Peor; Baal-Peor, a Moabitish deity KJV: Baal-peor.

H1188.def: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and the plural of H6556 (פֶּרֶץ); possessor of breaches; Baal-Peratsim, a place in Palestine KJV: Baal-perazim.

H1190.gloss: Baal of Shalishah, Baal-Shalishah, a place in Palestine

H1191.def: a modification of H1172 (בַּעֲלָה); mistressship; Baalath, a place in Palestine KJV: Baalath.

H1192.def: from H1172 (בַּעֲלָה) and H875 (בְּאֵר); mistress of a well; Baalath-Beer, a place in Palestine KJV: Baalath-beer.

H1193.def: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H8558 (תָּמָר); possessor of (the) palm-tree; Baal-Tamar, a place in Palestine KJV: Baal-tamar.

H1194.gloss: Beon, a place East of the Jordan
H1194.def: probably a contraction of H1010 (בֵּית בַּעַל מְעוֹן); Beon, a place East of the Jordan KJV: Beon.

H1195.gloss: Banana, the name of four Israelite

H1196.gloss: Baanah, the name of four Israelites
H1196.def: from a derivative of H6031 (עָנָה) with prepositional prefix; in affliction Baanah, the name of four Israelites KJV: Baanah.

H1199.def: from H1198 (בַּעַר); brutish; Baara, an Israelitish woman KJV: Baara.

H1200.def: from H1197 (בָּעַר); a burning KJV: fire.

H1211.def: from an unused root apparently meaning to peel; an onion KJV: onion.

H1218.def: from H1216 (בָּצֵק); a swell of ground; Botscath, a place in Palestine KJV: Bozcath, Boskath.

H1222.def: another form for H1220 (בֶּצֶר); gold KJV: gold.

H1269.def: probably feminine plural from an unused root (apparently mean to pierce); holes; Birzoth, an Israelite KJV: Birzavith (from the marg.).

H1270.def: perhaps from the root of H1269 (בִּרְזוֹת); iron (as cutting); by extension, an iron implement KJV: (ax) head, iron.

H1271.gloss: Barzillai, the name of three Israelites

H1275.def: probably by contraction from H882 (בְּאֵרִי); Beri, an Israelite KJV: Beri.

H1276.gloss: (only in the plural and with the article) the Berites, a place in Palestine
H1276.def: of uncertain derivation; (only in the plural and with the article) the Berites, a place in Palestine KJV: Berites.

H1277.def: from H1254 (בָּרָא) (in the sense of H1262 (בָּרָה)); fatted or plump KJV: fat ((fleshed), -ter), fed, firm, plenteous, rank.

H1278.def: feminine from H1254 (בָּרָא); a creation, i.e. a novelty KJV: new thing.

H1279.def: feminine from H1262 (בָּרָה); food KJV: meat.

H1280.def: from H1272 (בָּרַח); a bolt KJV: bar, fugitive.

H1281.def: or בָּרִחַ; (shortened) from H1272 (בָּרַח); a fugitive, i.e. the serpent (as fleeing), and the constellation by that name KJV: crooked, noble, piercing.

H1282.def: the same as H1281 (בָּרִיחַ); Bariach, an Israelite KJV: Bariah.

H1283.gloss: Beriah, the name of four Israelites

H1284.gloss: a Beriite (collectively) or descendants of Beriah
H1284.def: patronymically from H1283 (בְּרִיעָה); a Beriite (collectively) or descendants of Beriah KJV: Beerites.

H1285.gloss: a compact (because made by passing between pieces of flesh)

H1286.def: the same as H1285 (בְּרִית); Berith, a Shechemitish deity KJV: Berith.

H1287.def: feminine of H1253 (בֹּר); vegetable alkali KJV: sope.

H1289.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H1288 (בָרַךְ) {to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason)} KJV: bless, kneel.

H1290.def: from H1288 (בָרַךְ); a knee KJV: knee.

H1293.def: from H1288 (בָרַךְ); benediction; by implication prosperity KJV: blessing, liberal, pool, present.

H1911.def: a primitive root (compare H3034 (יָדָה)); to stretch forth the hand KJV: put.

H1912.def: of foreign origin; Hodu (i.e. Hindustan) KJV: India.

H1913.gloss: Hadoram, a son of Joktan, and the tribe descended from him
H1913.def: or הֲדֹרָם; probably of foreign derivation; Hadoram, a son of Joktan, and the tribe descended from him KJV: Hadoram.

H1914.def: of uncertain derivation; Hiddai, an Israelite KJV: Hiddai.

H1915.def: a primitive root (compare H1854 (דָּקַק)); to crush with the foot KJV: tread down.

H1917.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of H1916 (הֲדֹם); something stamped to pieces, i.e. a bit KJV: piece.

H1955.gloss: Hoshajah, the name of two Israelites
H1955.def: from H3467 (יָשַׁע) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has saved; Hoshajah, the name of two Israelites KJV: Hoshaiah.

H1956.def: from H3498 (יָתַר); he has caused to remain; Hothir, an Israelite KJV: Hothir.

H2681.def: a collateral form of H2691 (חָצֵר); a court or abode KJV: court.

H2682.def: perhaps originally the same as H2681 (חָצִיר), from the greenness of a courtyard; grass; also a leek (collectively) KJV: grass, hay, herb, leek.

H2683.gloss: the bosom (as comprised between the arms)
H2683.def: from an unused root meaning to hold firmly; the bosom (as comprised between the arms) KJV: bosom.

H2684.def: a collateral form of H2683 (חֵצֶן), and meaning the same {the bosom (as comprised between the arms)} KJV: arm, lap.

H2685.gloss: properly, to shear or cut close
H2685.def: (Aramaic) a primitive root; properly, to shear or cut close; figuratively, to be severe KJV: hasty, be urgent.

H2686.gloss: properly, to chop into, pierce or sever
H2686.def: a primitive root (compare H2673 (חָצָה)lemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה); also as denominative from H2671 (חֵץ) properly, to chop into, pierce or sever; hence, to curtail, to distribute (into ranks);  to shoot an arrow KJV: archer, [idiom] bands, cut off in the midst.

H2687.def: from H2687 (חָצָץ);  also like H2671 (חֵץ) properly, something cutting; hence, gravel (as grit); an arrow KJV: arrow, gravel (stone).

H2688.def: or חַצֲצֹן תָּמָר; from H2686 (חָצַץ) and H8558 (תָּמָר); division (i.e. perhaps row) of (the) palm-tree; Chatsetson-tamar, a place in Palestine KJV: Hazezon-tamar.

H2689.gloss: a trumpet (from its sundered or quavering note)
H2689.def: by reduplication from H2690 (חָצַר); a trumpet (from its sundered or quavering note) KJV: trumpet(-er).

H2690.def: a primitive root; properly, to surround with a stockade, and thus separate from the open country; but used only in the reduplicated form חֲצֹצֵר; or (2 Chronicles 5:12) חֲצֹרֵר; as dem. from H2689 (חֲצֹצְרָה); to trumpet, i.e. blow on that instrument KJV: blow, sound, trumpeter.

H2691.gloss: a yard (as inclosed by a fence)
H2691.def: (masculine and feminine); from H2690 (חָצַר) in its original sense; a yard (as inclosed by a fence); also a hamlet (as similarly surrounded with walls) KJV: court, tower, village.

H2692.def: from H2691 (חָצֵר) and H146 (אַדָּר); (the) village of Addar; Chatsar-Addar, a place in Palestine KJV: Hazar-addar.

H2693.def: from H2691 (חָצֵר) and a feminine of H1408 (גַּד); (the) village of (female) Fortune; Chatsar-Gaddah, a place in Palestine KJV: Hazar-gaddah.

H2694.def: from H2691 (חָצֵר) and H8484 (תִּיכוֹן) with the article interposed; village of the middle; Chatsar-hat-Tikon, a place in Palestine KJV: Hazar-hatticon.

H2695.def: by an orthographical variation for H2696 (חֶצְרוֹן); enclosure; Chetsro, an Israelite KJV: Hezro, Hezrai.

H2696.gloss: Chetsron, the name of a place in Palestine
H2696.def: from H2691 (חָצֵר); court-yard; Chetsron, the name of a place in Palestine; also of two Israelites KJV: Hezron.

H2697.gloss: a Chetsronite or (collectively) descendants of Chetsron
H2697.def: patronymically from H2696 (חֶצְרוֹן); a Chetsronite or (collectively) descendants of Chetsron KJV: Hezronites.

H2698.def: feminine plural of H2691 (חָצֵר); yards; Chatseroth, a place in Palestine KJV: Hazeroth.

H2699.def: plural masculine of H2691 (חָצֵר); yards; Chatserim, a place in Palestine KJV: Hazerim.

H2700.def: from H2691 (חָצֵר) and H4194 (מָוֶת); village of death; Chatsarmaveth, a place in Arabia KJV: Hazarmaveth.

H2701.def: from H2691 (חָצֵר) and H5484 (סוּסָה); village of cavalry; Chatsar-Susah, a place in Palestine KJV: Hazar-susah.

H2702.def: from H2691 (חָצֵר) and the plural of H5483 (סוּס); village of horses; Chatsar-Susim, a place in Palestine KJV: Hazar-susim.

H2703.def: from H2691 (חָצֵר) and a derivative of H5869 (עַיִן); village of springs; Chatsar-Enon, a place in Palestine KJV: Hazar-enon.

H2704.def: from H2691 (חָצֵר) and the same as H5881 (עֵינָן); village of springs; Chatsar-Enan, a place in Palestine KJV: Hazar-enan.

H2705.def: from H2691 (חָצֵר) and H7776 (שׁוּעָל); village of (the) fox; Chatsar-Shual, a place in Palestine KJV: Hazar-shual.

H2706.def: from H2710 (חָקַק); an enactment; hence, an appointment (of time, space, quantity, labor or usage) KJV: appointed, bound, commandment, convenient, custom, decree(-d), due, law, measure, [idiom] necessary, ordinance(-nary), portion, set time, statute, task.

H2707.def: a primitive root; to carve; by implication, to delineate; also to entrench KJV: carved work, portrayed, set a print.

H2708.def: feminine of H2706 (חֹק), and meaning substantially the same {an enactment; hence, an appointment (of time, space, quantity, labor or usage)} KJV: appointed, custom, manner, ordinance, site, statute.

H2709.def: from an unused root probably meaning to bend; crooked; Chakupha, one of the Nethinim KJV: Hakupha.

H2710.def: a primitive root; properly, to hack, i.e. engrave (Judges 5:14, to be a scribe simply); by implication, to enact (laws being cut in stone or metal tablets in primitive times) or (gen.) prescribe KJV: appoint, decree, governor, grave, lawgiver, note, pourtray, print, set.

H2711.def: from H2710 (חָקַק); an enactment, a resolution KJV: decree, thought.

H2712.gloss: Chukkok or Chukok, a place in Palestine
H2712.def: or (fully) חוּקֹק; from H2710 (חָקַק); appointed; Chukkok or Chukok, a place in Palestine KJV: Hukkok, Hukok.

H2713.def: a primitive root; properly, to penetrate; hence, to examine intimately KJV: find out, (make) search (out), seek (out), sound, try.

H2714.def: from H2713 (חָקַר); examination, enumeration, deliberation KJV: finding out, number, (un-) search(-able, -ed, out, -ing).

H2715.gloss: properly, white or pure (from the cleansing or shining power of fire
H2715.def: or (fully) חוֹר; from H2787 (חָרַר); (compare H2751 (חֹרִי)) properly, white or pure (from the cleansing or shining power of fire; hence (figuratively) noble (in rank) KJV: noble.

H2716.def: from an unused (and vulgar) root probably meaning to evacuate the bowels; excrement KJV: dung. Also חֲרִי.

H2717.def: or חֲרֵב; a primitive root; to parch (through drought) i.e. (by analogy,) to desolate, destroy, kill KJV: decay, (be) desolate, destroy(-er), (be) dry (up), slay, [idiom] surely, (lay, lie, make) waste.

H2718.def: (Aramaic) a root corresponding to H2717 (חָרַב); to demolish KJV: destroy.

H2719.def: from H2717 (חָרַב); drought; also a cutting instrument (from its destructive effect), as a knife, sword, or other sharp implement KJV: axe, dagger, knife, mattock, sword, tool.

H2720.def: from H2717 (חָרַב); parched or ruined KJV: desolate, dry, waste.

H2721.def: a collaterally form of H2719 (חֶרֶב); drought or desolation KJV: desolation, drought, dry, heat, [idiom] utterly, waste.

H2722.gloss: Choreb, a (generic) name for the Sinaitic mountains
H2722.def: from H2717 (חָרַב); desolate; Choreb, a (generic) name for the Sinaitic mountains KJV: Horeb.

H2723.def: feminine of H2721 (חֹרֶב); properly, drought, i.e. (by implication) a desolation KJV: decayed place, desolate (place, -tion), destruction, (laid) waste (place).

H2724.def: feminine of H2720 (חָרֵב); a desert KJV: dry (ground, land).

H2725.def: from H2717 (חָרַב); parching heat KJV: drought.

H2726.gloss: Charbona or Charbonah, a eunuch of Xerxes
H2726.def: or חַרְבוֹנָה; of Persian origin; Charbona or Charbonah, a eunuch of Xerxes KJV: Harbona, Harbonah.

H2727.def: a primitive root; properly, to leap suddenly, i.e. (by implication) to be dismayed KJV: be afraid.

H2728.def: from H2727 (חָרַג); the leaping insect, i.e. a locust KJV: beetle.

H2729.def: a primitive root; to shudder with terror; hence, to fear; also to hasten (with anxiety) KJV: be (make) afraid, be careful, discomfit, fray (away), quake, tremble.

H2730.def: from H2729 (חָרַד); fearful; also reverential KJV: afraid, trembling.

H2731.def: feminine of H2730 (חָרֵד); fear, anxiety KJV: care, [idiom] exceedingly, fear, quaking, trembling.

H2732.gloss: Charadah, a place in the Desert
H2732.def: the same as H2731 (חֲרָדָה); Charadah, a place in the Desert KJV: Haradah.

H2733.gloss: a Charodite, or inhabitant of Charod
H2733.def: patrial from a derivative of H2729 (חָרַד) (compare H5878 (עֵין חֲרֹד)); a Charodite, or inhabitant of Charod KJV: Harodite.

H2734.def: a primitive root (compare H2787 (חָרַר)); to glow or grow warm; figuratively (usually) to blaze up, of anger, zeal, jealousy KJV: be angry, burn, be displeased, [idiom] earnestly, fret self, grieve, be (wax) hot, be incensed, kindle, [idiom] very, be wroth. See H8474 (תַּחָרָה).

H2735.gloss: Chor-hag-Gidgad, a place in the Desert
H2735.def: from H2356 (חוֹר) and a collateral (masculine) form of H1412 (גֻּדְגֹּדָה), with the article interposed; hole of the cleft; Chor-hag-Gidgad, a place in the Desert KJV: Hor-hagidgad.

H2736.def: ; from H2734 (חָרָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); fearing Jah; Charhajah, an Israelite KJV: Harhaiah.

H2737.def: from an unused root meaning to perforate; properly, pierced, i.e. a bead of pearl, gems or jewels (as strung) KJV: chain.

H2738.def: or (shortened) חָרֻל; apparently, a passive participle of an unused root probably meaning to be prickly; properly, pointed, i.e. a bramble or other thorny weed KJV: nettle.

H2739.def: from passive participle of H2763 (חָרַם) and H639 (אַף); snub-nosed; Charumaph, an Israelite KJV: Harumaph.

H2740.def: or (shortened) חָרֹן; from H2734 (חָרָה); a burning of anger KJV: sore displeasure, fierce(-ness), fury, (fierce) wrath(-ful).

H2741.gloss: a Charuphite or inhabitant of Charuph (or Chariph)
H2741.def: a patrial from (probably) a collateral form of H2756 (חָרִיף); a Charuphite or inhabitant of Charuph (or Chariph) KJV: Haruphite.

H2742.def: or חָרֻץ; passive participle of H2782 (חָרַץ); properly, incised or (active) incisive; hence (as noun masculine or feminine) a trench (as dug), gold (as mined), a threshing-sledge (having sharp teeth); (figuratively) determination; also eager KJV: decision, diligent, (fine) gold, pointed things, sharp, threshing instrument, wall.

H2743.def: the same as H2742 (חֲרוּץ); earnest; Charuts, an Israelite KJV: Haruz.

H2744.def: a fuller form of H2746 (חַרְחֻר); inflammation; Charchur, one of the Nethinim KJV: Harhur.

H2745.def: from the same as H2775 (חֶרֶס); perhaps shining; Charchas, an Israelite KJV: Harhas.

H2746.def: from H2787 (חָרַר); fever (as hot) KJV: extreme burning.

H2747.def: from a primitive root meaning to engrave; a chisel or graver; also a style forwriting KJV: graving tool, pen.

H2748.gloss: a horoscopist (as drawing magical lines or circles)
H2748.def: from the same as H2747 (חֶרֶט); a horoscopist (as drawing magical lines or circles) KJV: magician.

H2749.gloss: {a horoscopist (as drawing magical lines or circles)}
H2749.def: (Aramaic) the same as H2748 (חַרְטֹם) {a horoscopist (as drawing magical lines or circles)} KJV: magician.

H2750.def: from H2734 (חָרָה); a burning (i.e. intense) anger KJV: fierce, [idiom] great, heat.

H2751.def: from the same as H2353 (חוּר); white bread KJV: white.

H2752.def: from H2356 (חוֹר); cave-dweller or troglodyte; a Chorite or aboriginal Idumaean KJV: Horims, Horites.

H2753.gloss: Chori, the name of two men
H2753.def: or חוֹרִי; the same as H2752 (חֹרִי); Chori, the name of two men KJV: Hori.

H2754.def: or חָרִט; from the same as H2747 (חֶרֶט); properly, cut out (or hollow), i.e. (by implication) a pocket KJV: bag, crisping pin.

H2755.def: from the plural of H2716 (חֶרֶא) and the plural of H3123 (יוֹנָה); or perhaps rather the plural of a single word חֲרָאיוֹן, probably a kind of vegetable excrements of doves {or a vegetable} KJV: doves' dung.

H2756.gloss: Chariph, the name of two Israelites
H2756.def: from H2778 (חָרַף); autumnal; Chariph, the name of two Israelites KJV: Hariph.

H2757.def: or חֲרִץ; from H2782 (חָרַץ); (compare H2742 (חֲרוּץ)) properly, incisure or (passively) incised; hence, a threshing-sledge (with sharp teeth); also a slice (as cut) KJV: [phrase] cheese, harrow.

H2758.def: from H2790 (חָרַשׁ); ploughing or its season KJV: earing (time), ground.

H2759.def: from H2790 (חָרַשׁ) in the sense of silence; quiet, i.e. sultry (as feminine noun, the sirocco or hot east wind) KJV: vehement.

H2760.def: a primitive root; to braid (i.e. to entangle or snare) or catch (game) in anet KJV: roast.

H2761.def: (Aramaic) a root probably allied to the equivalent of H2787 (חָרַר); to scorch KJV: singe.

H2762.def: from H2760 (חָרַךְ); properly, a net, i.e. (by analogy) lattice KJV: lattice.

H2763.def: a primitive root; to seclude; specifically (by a ban) to devote to religious uses (especially destruction); physical and reflexive, to be blunt as to the nose KJV: make accursed, consecrate, (utterly) destroy, devote, forfeit, have a flat nose, utterly (slay, make away).

H2764.gloss: physical (as shutting in) a net (either literally or figuratively)
H2764.def: or (Zechariah 14:11) חֶרֶם; from H2763 (חָרַם); physical (as shutting in) a net (either literally or figuratively); usually a doomed object; abstractly extermination KJV: (ac-) curse(-d, -d thing), dedicated thing, things which should have been utterly destroyed, (appointed to) utter destruction, devoted (thing), net.

H2765.def: from H2763 (חָרַם); devoted; Chorem, a place in Palestine KJV: Horem.

H2766.def: from H2763 (חָרַם); snub-nosed; Charim, an Israelite KJV: Harim.

H2767.def: from H2763 (חָרַם); devoted; Chormah, a place in Palestine KJV: Hormah.

H2768.def: from H2763 (חָרַם); abrupt; Chermon, a mount of Palestine KJV: Hermon.

H2769.def: plural of H2768 (חֶרְמוֹן); Hermons, i.e. its peaks KJV: the Hermonites.

H2770.def: from H2763 (חָרַם); a sickle (as cutting) KJV: sickle.

H2771.gloss: Charan, the name of a man and also of a place
H2771.def: from H2787 (חָרַר); parched; Charan, the name of a man and also of a place KJV: Haran.

H2772.gloss: a Choronite or inhabitant of Choronaim
H2772.def: patrial from H2773 (חֹרֹנַיִם); a Choronite or inhabitant of Choronaim KJV: Horonite.

H2773.def: dual of a derivative from H2356 (חוֹר); double cave-town; Choronajim, a place in Moab KJV: Horonaim.

H2774.def: of uncertain derivation; Charnepher, an Israelite KJV: Harnepher.

H2775.def: or (with a directive enclitic) חַרְסָה; from an unused root meaning to scrape; also perhaps from the mediating idea of H2777 (חַרְסוּת) the itch; the sun KJV: itch, sun.

H2776.def: the same as H2775 (חֶרֶס); shining; Cheres, a mountain in Palestine KJV: Heres.

H2777.def: from H2775 (חֶרֶס) (apparently in the sense of a red tile used for scraping); a potsherd, i.e. (by implication) a pottery; the name of a gate at Jerusalem KJV: east.

H2778.def: a primitive root; also  denominative (from H2779 (חֹרֶף)) to pull off, i.e. (by implication) to expose (as by stripping); specifically, to betroth (as if a surrender); figuratively, to carp at, i.e. defame; to spend the winter KJV: betroth, blaspheme, defy, jeopard, rail, reproach, upbraid.

H2779.def: from H2778 (חָרַף); properly, the crop gathered, i.e. (by implication) the autumn (and winter) season; figuratively, ripeness of age KJV: cold, winter (-house), youth.

H2780.def: from H2778 (חָרַף); reproachful; Chareph, an Israelite KJV: Hareph.

H2781.def: from H2778 (חָרַף); contumely, disgrace, the pudenda KJV: rebuke, reproach(-fully), shame.

H2782.def: a primitive root; properly, to point sharply, i.e. (literally) to wound; figuratively, to be alert, to decide KJV: bestir self, decide, decree, determine, maim, move.

H2783.gloss: the loin (as the seat of strength)
H2783.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H2782 (חָרַץ) in the sense of vigor; the loin (as the seat of strength) KJV: loin.

H2784.def: of uncertain derivation; a fetter; figuratively, a pain KJV: band.

H2785.gloss: a sour grape (as sharp in taste)
H2785.def: from H2782 (חָרַץ); a sour grape (as sharp in taste) KJV: kernel.

H2786.def: a primitive root; to grate the teeth KJV: gnash.

H2787.def: a primitive root; to glow, i.e. literally (to melt, burn, dry up) or figuratively (to show or incite passion) KJV: be angry, burn, dry, kindle.

H2788.def: from H2787 (חָרַר); arid KJV: parched place.

H2789.def: a collateral form mediating between H2775 (חֶרֶס) and H2791 (חֶרֶשׁ); a piece of pottery KJV: earth(-en), (pot-) sherd, [phrase] stone.

H2790.def: a primitive root; to scratch, i.e. (by implication) to engrave, plough; hence (from the use of tools) to fabricate (of any material); figuratively, to devise (in a bad sense); hence (from the idea of secrecy) to be silent, to let alone; hence (by implication) to be deaf (as an accompaniment of dumbness) KJV: [idiom] altogether, cease, conceal, be deaf, devise, ear, graven, imagine, leave off speaking, hold peace, plow(-er, man), be quiet, rest, practise secretly, keep silence, be silent, speak not a word, be still, hold tongue, worker.

H2791.def: from H2790 (חָרַשׁ); magical craft; also silence KJV: cunning, secretly.

H2792.def: the same as H2791 (חֶרֶשׁ) Cheresh, a Levite KJV: Heresh.

H2793.gloss: a forest (perhaps as furnishing the material for fabric)
H2793.def: from H2790 (חָרַשׁ); a forest (perhaps as furnishing the material for fabric) KJV: bough, forest, shroud, wood.

H2794.def: active participle of H2790 (חָרַשׁ); a fabricator or mechanic KJV: artificer.

H2795.def: from H2790 (חָרַשׁ); deaf (whether literally or spiritual) KJV: deaf.

H2796.def: from H2790 (חָרַשׁ); a fabricator or any material KJV: artificer, ([phrase]) carpenter, craftsman, engraver, maker, [phrase] mason, skilful, ([phrase]) smith, worker, workman, such as wrought.

H2797.def: from H2792 (חֶרֶשׁ); magician; Charsha, one of the Nethinim KJV: Harsha.

H2798.gloss: mechanics, the name of a valley in Jerusalem
H2798.def: plural of H2796 (חָרָשׁ); mechanics, the name of a valley in Jerusalem KJV: Charashim, craftsmen.

H2799.def: from H2790 (חָרַשׁ); mechanical work KJV: carving, cutting.

H2800.def: the same as H2799 (חֲרֹשֶׁת); Charosheth, a place in Palestine KJV: Harosheth.

H2801.def: a primitive root; to engrave KJV: graven.

H2802.def: from H2801 (חָרַת) (but equivalent to H2793 (חֹרֶשׁ)); forest; Chereth, a thicket in Palestine KJV: Hereth.

H2803.gloss: properly, to plait or interpenetrate, i
H2803.def: a primitive root; properly, to plait or interpenetrate, i.e. (literally) to weave or (generally) to fabricate; figuratively, to plot or contrive (usually in a malicious sense); hence (from the mental effort) to think, regard, value, compute KJV: (make) account (of), conceive, consider, count, cunning (man, work, workman), devise, esteem, find out, forecast, hold, imagine, impute, invent, be like, mean, purpose, reckon(-ing be made), regard, think.

H2804.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H2803 (חָשַׁב); to regard KJV: repute.

H2805.gloss: a belt or strap (as being interlaced)
H2805.def: from H2803 (חָשַׁב); a belt or strap (as being interlaced) KJV: curious girdle.

H2806.def: from H2803 (חָשַׁב) and H1777 (דִּין); considerate judge; Chasbaddanah, an Israelite KJV: Hasbadana.

H2807.def: from H2803 (חָשַׁב); estimation; Cashubah, an Israelite KJV: Hashubah.

H2808.def: from H2803 (חָשַׁב); properly, contrivance; by implication, intelligence KJV: account, device, reason.

H2809.gloss: Cheshbon, a place East of the Jordan
H2809.def: the same as H2808 (חֶשְׁבּוֹן); Cheshbon, a place East of the Jordan KJV: Heshbon.

H2810.def: from H2803 (חָשַׁב); a contrivance, i.e. actual (a warlike machine) or mental (a machination) KJV: engine, invention.

H2811.gloss: Chashabjah, the name of nine Israelites
H2811.def: or חֲשַׁבְיָהוּ; from H2803 (חָשַׁב) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has regarded; Chashabjah, the name of nine Israelites KJV: Hashabiah.

H2812.def: feminine of H2808 (חֶשְׁבּוֹן); inventiveness; Chashnah, an Israelite KJV: Hashabnah.

H2813.gloss: Chashabnejah, the name of two Israelites
H2813.def: from H2808 (חֶשְׁבּוֹן) and H3050 (יָהּ); thought of Jah; Chashabnejah, the name of two Israelites KJV: Hashabniah.

H2814.def: a primitive root; to hush or keep quiet KJV: hold peace, keep silence, be silent, (be) still.

H2815.gloss: Chashshub, the name of two or three Israelites
H2815.def: from H2803 (חָשַׁב); intelligent; Chashshub, the name of two or three Israelites KJV: Hashub, Hasshub.

H2816.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H2821 (חָשַׁךְ); the dark KJV: darkness.

H2975.def: of Egyptian origin; a channel, e.g. a fosse, canal, shaft; specifically the Nile, as the one river of Egypt, including its collateral trenches; also the Tigris, as the main river of Assyria KJV: brook, flood, river, stream.

H2976.def: a primitive root; to desist, i.e. (figuratively) to despond KJV: (cause to) despair, one that is desperate, be no hope.

H2977.gloss: Joshijah, the name of two Israelites
H2977.def: or יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ; from the same root as H803 (אֲשׁוּיָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); founded of Jah; Joshijah, the name of two Israelites KJV: Josiah.

H2978.def: from H857 (אָתָה); an entry KJV: entrance.

H2979.def: from the same as H871 (אֲתָרִים); stepping; Jeatherai, an Israelite KJV: Jeaterai.

H2980.def: a primitive root; to bawl KJV: cry out.

H2981.def: from H2986 (יָבַל); produce, i.e. a crop or (figuratively) wealth KJV: fruit, increase.

H2982.gloss: Jebus, the original name of Jerusalem
H2982.def: from H947 (בּוּס); trodden, i.e. threshing-place; Jebus, the original name of Jerusalem KJV: Jebus.

H2983.gloss: a Jebusite or inhabitant of Jebus
H2983.def: patrial from H2982 (יְבוּס); a Jebusite or inhabitant of Jebus KJV: Jebusite(-s).

H2984.def: from H977 (בָּחַר); choice; Jibchar, an Israelite KJV: Ibhar.

H2985.gloss: Jabin, the name of two Canaanitish kings
H2985.def: from H995 (בִּין); intelligent; Jabin, the name of two Canaanitish kings KJV: Jabin.

H2986.def: a primitive root; properly, to flow; causatively, to bring (especially with pomp) KJV: bring (forth), carry, lead (forth).

H2987.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H2986 (יָבַל); to bring KJV: bring, carry.

H2988.def: from H2986 (יָבַל); a stream KJV: (water-) course, stream.

H2989.def: the same as H2988 (יָבָל); Jabal, an antediluvian KJV: Jabal.

H2990.def: from H2986 (יָבַל); having running sores KJV: wen.

H2991.def: from H1104 (בָּלַע) and H5971 (עַם); devouring people; Jibleam, a place in Palestine KJV: Ibleam.

H2992.def: a primitive root of doubtful meaning; used only as a denominative from H2993 (יָבָם); to marry a (deceased) brother's widow KJV: perform the duty of a husband's brother, marry.

H2993.def: from (the orig. of) H2992 (יָבַם); a brotherin-law KJV: husband's brother.

H2994.def: feminine participle of H2992 (יָבַם); a sister-in-law KJV: brother's wife, sister in law.

H2995.gloss: Jabneel, the name of two places in Palestine
H2995.def: from H1129 (בָּנָה) and H410 (אֵל); built of God; Jabneel, the name of two places in Palestine KJV: Jabneel.

H2996.def: from H1129 (בָּנָה); a building; Jabneh, a place in Palestine KJV: Jabneh.

H2997.def: from H1129 (בָּנָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); built of Jah; Jibnejah, an Israelite KJV: Ibneiah.

H2998.def: from H1129 (בָּנָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); building of Jah; Jibnijah, an Israelite KJV: Ibnijah.

H2999.gloss: Jabbok, a river east of the Jordan
H2999.def: probably from H1238 (בָּקַק); pouring forth; Jabbok, a river east of the Jordan KJV: Jabbok.

H3000.def: from H1288 (בָרַךְ) and H3050 (יָהּ); blessed of Jah; Jeberekjah, an Israelite KJV: Jeberechiah.

H3001.gloss: to be ashamed, confused or disappointed
H3001.def: a primitive root; to be ashamed, confused or disappointed; also (as failing) to dry up (as water) or wither (as herbage) KJV: be ashamed, clean, be confounded, (make) dry (up), (do) shame(-fully), [idiom] utterly, wither (away).

H3002.def: from H3001 (יָבֵשׁ); dry KJV: dried (away), dry.

H3003.gloss: Jobesh, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine
H3003.def: the same as H3002 (יָבֵשׁ) (also יָבֵישׁ; often with the addition of H1568 (גִּלְעָד), i.e. Jabesh of Gilad); Jobesh, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine KJV: Jobesh (-Gilead).

H3004.def: from H3001 (יָבֵשׁ); dry ground KJV: dry (ground, land).

H3005.def: from the same as H1314 (בֶּשֶׂם); fragrant; Jibsam, an Israelite KJV: Jibsam.

H3006.def: a variation of H3004 (יַבָּשָׁה); dry ground KJV: dry land.

H3007.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3006 (יַבֶּשֶׁת); dry land KJV: earth.

H3008.gloss: Jigal, the name of three Israelites
H3008.def: from H1350 (גָּאַל); avenger; Jigal, the name of three Israelites KJV: Igal, Igeal.

H3009.def: a primitive root; to dig or plow KJV: husbandman.

H3010.def: from H3009 (יָגַב); a plowed field KJV: field.

H3011.gloss: Jogbehah, a place East of the Jordan
H3011.def: feminine from H1361 (גָּבַהּ); hillock; Jogbehah, a place East of the Jordan KJV: Jogbehah.

H3012.def: from H1431 (גָּדַל) and H3050 (יָהּ); magnified of Jah; Jigdaljah, an Israelite KJV: Igdaliah.

H3013.def: a primitive root; to grieve KJV: afflict, cause grief, grieve, sorrowful, vex.

H3014.def: a primitive root (probably rather the same as H3013 (יָגָה) through the common idea of dissatisfaction); to push away KJV: be removed.

H3015.def: from H3013 (יָגָה); affliction KJV: grief, sorrow.

H3016.def: from H3025 (יָגֹר); fearful KJV: afraid, fearest.

H3017.def: probably from H1481 (גּוּר); a lodging; Jagur, a place in Palestine KJV: Jagur.

H3018.def: from H3021 (יָגַע); toil; hence, a work, produce, property (as the result of labor) KJV: labour, work.

H3020.def: from H1540 (גָּלָה); exiled; Jogli, an Israelite KJV: Jogli.

H3021.def: a primitive root; properly, to gasp; hence, to be exhausted, to tire, to toil KJV: faint, (make to) labour, (be) weary.

H3022.def: from H3021 (יָגַע); earnings (as the product of toil) KJV: that which he laboured for.

H3023.def: from H3021 (יָגַע); tired; hence (transitive) tiresome KJV: full of labour, weary.

H3024.def: feminine of H3019 (יָגִיעַ); fatigue KJV: weariness.

H3025.def: a primitive root; to fear KJV: be afraid, fear.

H3026.gloss: Jegar-Sahadutha, a cairn East of the Jordan
H3026.def: (Aramaic) from a word derived from an unused root (meaning to gather) and a derivation of a root corresponding to H7717 (שָׂהֵד); heap of the testimony; Jegar-Sahadutha, a cairn East of the Jordan KJV: Jegar-Sahadutha.

H3027.gloss: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc
H3027.def: a primitive word; in distinction from H3709 (כַּף), the closed one); used (as noun, adverb, etc.) in a great variety of applications, both literally and figuratively, both proximate and remote (as follows) a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.), KJV: ([phrase] be) able, [idiom] about, [phrase] armholes, at, axletree, because of, beside, border, [idiom] bounty, [phrase] broad, (broken-) handed, [idiom] by, charge, coast, [phrase] consecrate, [phrase] creditor, custody, debt, dominion, [idiom] enough, [phrase] fellowship, force, [idiom] from, hand(-staves, -y work), [idiom] he, himself, [idiom] in, labour, [phrase] large, ledge, (left-) handed, means, [idiom] mine, ministry, near, [idiom] of, [idiom] order, ordinance, [idiom] our, parts, pain, power, [idiom] presumptuously, service, side, sore, state, stay, draw with strength, stroke, [phrase] swear, terror, [idiom] thee, [idiom] by them, [idiom] themselves, [idiom] thine own, [idiom] thou, through, [idiom] throwing, [phrase] thumb, times, [idiom] to, [idiom] under, [idiom] us, [idiom] wait on, (way-) side, where, [phrase] wide, [idiom] with (him, me, you), work, [phrase] yield, [idiom] yourselves.

H3028.gloss: {a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc
H3028.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3027 (יָד) {a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.)} KJV: hand, power.

H3029.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3034 (יָדָה); to praise KJV: (give) thank(-s).

H3030.def: of uncertain derivation; Jidalah, a place in Palestine KJV: Idalah.

H3031.def: from the same as H1706 (דְּבַשׁ); perhaps honeyed; Jidbash, an Israelite KJV: Idbash.

H3032.def: a primitive root; (compare H3034 (יָדָה)) properly, to handle, i.e. to throw, e.g. lots KJV: cast.

H3033.def: from H3039 (יְדִיד); properly, affection; concretely, a darling object KJV: dearly beloved.

H3034.gloss: physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away
H3034.def: a primitive root; used only as denominative from H3027 (יָד); literally, to use (i.e. hold out) the hand; physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively, to bemoan (by wringing the hands) KJV: cast (out), (make) confess(-ion), praise, shoot, (give) thank(-ful, -s, -sgiving).

H3035.def: from H3034 (יָדָה); praised; Jiddo, an Israelite KJV: Iddo.

H3036.def: from H3034 (יָדָה); thankful; Jadon, an Israelite KJV: Jadon.

H3037.gloss: Jaddua, the name of two Israelites
H3037.def: from H3045 (יָדַע); knowing; Jaddua, the name of two Israelites KJV: Jaddua.

H3038.def: or יְדֻתוּן; or יְדִיתוּן; probably from H3034 (יָדָה); laudatory; Jeduthun, an Israelite KJV: Jeduthun.

H3039.def: from the same as H1730 (דּוֹד); loved KJV: amiable, (well-) beloved, loves.

H3040.def: feminine of H3039 (יְדִיד); beloved; Jedidah, an Israelitess KJV: Jedidah.

H3041.def: from H3039 (יְדִיד) and H3050 (יָהּ); beloved of Jah; Jedidejah, a name of Solomon KJV: Jedidiah.

H3042.gloss: Jedajah, the name of two Israelites
H3042.def: from H3034 (יָדָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); praised of Jah; Jedajah, the name of two Israelites KJV: Jedaiah.

H3043.gloss: Jediael, the name of three Israelites
H3043.def: from H3045 (יָדַע) and H410 (אֵל); knowing God; Jediael, the name of three Israelites KJV: Jediael.

H3044.def: from H1811 (דָּלַף); tearful; Jidlaph, a Mesopotamian KJV: Jidlaph.

H3045.gloss: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing)
H3045.def: a primitive root; to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.) KJV: acknowledge, acquaintance(-ted with), advise, answer, appoint, assuredly, be aware, (un-) awares, can(-not), certainly, comprehend, consider, [idiom] could they, cunning, declare, be diligent, (can, cause to) discern, discover, endued with, familiar friend, famous, feel, can have, be (ig-) norant, instruct, kinsfolk, kinsman, (cause to let, make) know, (come to give, have, take) knowledge, have (knowledge), (be, make, make to be, make self) known, [phrase] be learned, [phrase] lie by man, mark, perceive, privy to, [idiom] prognosticator, regard, have respect, skilful, shew, can (man of) skill, be sure, of a surety, teach, (can) tell, understand, have (understanding), [idiom] will be, wist, wit, wot.

H3046.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3045 (יָדַע) {to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)} KJV: certify, know, make known, teach.

H3047.def: from H3045 (יָדַע); knowing; Jada, an Israelite KJV: Jada.

H3048.gloss: Jedajah, the name of two Israelites
H3048.def: from H3045 (יָדַע) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has known; Jedajah, the name of two Israelites KJV: Jedaiah.

H3049.def: from H3045 (יָדַע); properly, a knowing one; specifically, a conjurer; (by impl) a ghost KJV: wizard.

H3050.def: contraction for H3068 (יְהֹוָה), and meaning the same; Jah, the sacred name KJV: Jah, the Lord, most vehement. Compare names in '-iah,' '-jah.'

H3051.def: a primitive root; to give (whether literal or figurative); generally, to put; imperatively (reflexive) come KJV: ascribe, bring, come on, give, go, set, take.

H3052.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3051 (יָהַב) {to give (whether literal or figurative); generally, to put; imperatively (reflexive) come} KJV: deliver, give, lay, [phrase] prolong, pay, yield.

H3053.gloss: properly, what is given (by Providence), i
H3053.def: from H3051 (יָהַב); properly, what is given (by Providence), i.e. a lot KJV: burden.

H3054.def: denominative from a form corresponding to H3061 (יְהוּד)lemma יְהיּד yod, corrected to יְהוּד; to Judaize, i.e. become Jewish KJV: become Jews.

H3055.def: a briefer form of one corresponding to H3061 (יְהוּד)lemma יְהיּד yod, corrected to יְהוּד; Jehud, a place in Palestine KJV: Jehud.

H3056.def: perhaps from a form corresponding to H3061 (יְהוּד)lemma יְהיּד yod, corrected to יְהוּד; Judaistic; Jehdai, an Israelite KJV: Jehdai.

H3057.def: feminine of H3064 (יְהוּדִי); Jehudijah, a Jewess KJV: Jehudijah.

H3058.gloss: Jehu, the name of five Israelites
H3058.def: from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H1931 (הוּא); Jehovah (is) He; Jehu, the name of five Israelites KJV: Jehu.

H3059.gloss: Jehoachaz, the name of three Israelites
H3059.def: from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H270 (אָחַז); Jehovah-seized; Jehoachaz, the name of three Israelites KJV: Jehoahaz. Compare H3099 (יוֹאָחָז).

H3060.gloss: Jehoash, the name of two Israelite kings
H3060.def: from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and (perhaps) H784 (אֵשׁ); Jehovah-fired; Jehoash, the name of two Israelite kings KJV: Jehoash. Compare H3101 (יוֹאָשׁ).

H3061.def: (Aramaic) contracted from a form corresponding to H3063 (יְהוּדָה); properly, Judah, hence, Judaea KJV: Jewry, Judah, Judea.

H3062.def: (Aramaic) patrial from H3061 (יְהוּד)lemma יְהיּד yod, corrected to יְהוּד; a Jehudaite (or Judaite), i.e. Jew KJV: Jew.

H3063.gloss: Jehudah (or Judah), the name of five Israelites
H3063.def: from H3034 (יָדָה); celebrated; Jehudah (or Judah), the name of five Israelites; also of the tribe descended from the first, and of its territory KJV: Judah.

H3064.def: patronymically from H3063 (יְהוּדָה); a Jehudite (i.e. Judaite or Jew), or descendant of Jehudah (i.e. Judah) KJV: Jew.

H3065.def: the same as H3064 (יְהוּדִי); Jehudi, an Israelite KJV: Jehudi.

H3066.def: feminine of H3064 (יְהוּדִי); the Jewish (used adverbially) language KJV: in the Jews' language.

H3067.def: the same as H3066 (יְהוּדִית); Jewess; Jehudith, a Canaanitess KJV: Judith.

H3068.gloss: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H3068.def: from H1961 (הָיָה); (the) self-Existent or Eternal; Jehovah, Jewish national name of God KJV: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).

H3069.def: a variation of H3068 (יְהֹוָה) (used after H136 (אֲדֹנָי), and pronounced by Jews as H430 (אֱלֹהִים), in order to prevent the repetition of the same sound, since they elsewhere pronounce H3068 (יְהֹוָה) as H136 (אֲדֹנָי)) {YHWH} KJV: God.

H3070.gloss: Jehovah-Jireh, a symbolical name for Mount Moriah
H3070.def: from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H7200 (רָאָה); Jehovah will see (to it); Jehovah-Jireh, a symbolical name for Mount Moriah KJV: Jehovah-jireh.

H3071.gloss: Jehovah-Nissi, a symbolical name of an altar in the Desert
H3071.def: from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H5251 (נֵס) with the prononimal suffix; Jehovah (is) my banner; Jehovah-Nissi, a symbolical name of an altar in the Desert KJV: Jehovah-nissi.

H3072.gloss: Jehovah-Tsidkenu, a symbolical epithet of the Messiah and of Jerusalem
H3072.def: from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H6664 (צֶדֶק) with pronominal suffix; Jehovah (is) our right; Jehovah-Tsidkenu, a symbolical epithet of the Messiah and of Jerusalem KJV: the Lord our righteousness.

H3073.gloss: Jehovah-Shalom, a symbolical name of an altar in Palestine
H3073.def: from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H7965 (שָׁלוֹם); Jehovah (is) peace; Jehovah-Shalom, a symbolical name of an altar in Palestine KJV: Jehovah-shalom.

H3074.gloss: Jehovah-Shammah, a symbolic title of Jerusalem
H3074.def: from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H8033 (שָׁם) with directive enclitic; Jehovah (is) thither; Jehovah-Shammah, a symbolic title of Jerusalem KJV: Jehovahshammah.

H3075.gloss: Jehozabad, the name of three Israelites
H3075.def: from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H2064 (זָבַד); Jehovah-endowed; Jehozabad, the name of three Israelites KJV: Jehozabad. Compare H3107 (יוֹזָבָד).

H3076.gloss: Jehochanan, the name of eight Israelites
H3076.def: from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H2603 (חָנַן); Jehovah-favored; Jehochanan, the name of eight Israelites KJV: Jehohanan, Johanan. Compare H3110 (יוֹחָנָן).

H3077.gloss: Jehojada, the name of three Israelites
H3077.def: from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H3045 (יָדַע); Jehovah-known; Jehojada, the name of three Israelites KJV: Jehoiada. Compare H3111 (יוֹיָדָע).

H3078.def: from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H3559 (כּוּן); Jehovah will establish; Jehojakin, a Jewish king KJV: Jehoiachin. Compare H3112 (יוֹיָכִין).

H3079.def: from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) abbreviated and H6965 (קוּם); Jehovah will raise; Jehojakim, a Jewish king KJV: Jehoiakim. Compare H3113 (יוֹיָקִים).

H3080.gloss: Jehojarib, the name of two Israelites
H3080.def: from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H7378 (רִיב); Jehovah will contend; Jehojarib, the name of two Israelites KJV: Jehoiarib. Compare H3114 (יוֹיָרִיב).

H3081.def: from H3201 (יָכֹל); potent; Jehukal, an Israelite KJV: Jehucal. Compare H3116 (יוּכַל).

H3082.gloss: Jehonadab, the name of an Israelite and of an Arab
H3082.def: from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H5068 (נָדַב); Jehovah-largessed; Jehonadab, the name of an Israelite and of an Arab KJV: Jehonadab, Jonadab. Compare H3122 (יוֹנָדָב).

H3083.gloss: Jehonathan, the name of four Israelites
H3083.def: from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H5414 (נָתַן); Jehovah-given; Jehonathan, the name of four Israelites KJV: Jonathan. Compare H3129 (יוֹנָתָן).

H3084.def: a fuller form of H3130 (יוֹסֵף); Jehoseph (i.e. Joseph), a son of Jacob KJV: Joseph.

H3085.def: from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H5710 (עָדָה); Jehovah-adorned; Jehoaddah, an Israelite KJV: Jehoada.

H3086.def: or יְהוֹעַדָּן; from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H5727 (עָדַן); Jehovahpleased; Jehoaddin or Jehoaddan, an Israelitess KJV: Jehoaddan.

H3087.def: from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H6663 (צָדַק); Jehovah-righted; Jehotsadak, an Israelite KJV: Jehozadek, Josedech. Compare H3136 (יוֹצָדָק).

H3088.gloss: Jehoram, the name of a Syrian and of three Israelites
H3088.def: from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H7311 (רוּם); Jehovah-raised; Jehoram, the name of a Syrian and of three Israelites KJV: Jehoram, Joram. Compare H3141 (יוֹרָם).

H3089.def: from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H7650 (שָׁבַע); Jehovah-sworn; Jehosheba, an Israelitess KJV: Jehosheba. Compare H3090 (יְהוֹשַׁבְעַת).

H3090.def: a form of H3089 (יְהוֹשֶׁבַע); Jehoshabath, an Israelitess KJV: Jehoshabeath.

H3091.def: or יְהוֹשֻׁעַ; from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H3467 (יָשַׁע); Jehovah-saved; Jehoshua (i.e. Joshua), the Jewish leader KJV: Jehoshua, Jehoshuah, Joshua. Compare H1954 (הוֹשֵׁעַ), H3442 (יֵשׁוּעַ).

H3092.gloss: Jehoshaphat, the name of six Israelites
H3092.def: from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H8199 (שָׁפַט); Jehovah-judged; Jehoshaphat, the name of six Israelites; also of a valley near Jerusalem KJV: Jehoshaphat. Compare H3146 (יוֹשָׁפָט).
