H3479.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3478 (יִשְׂרָאֵל) {Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity} KJV: Israel.

H3480.def: by variation from H3477 (יָשָׁר) and H410 (אֵל) with directive enclitic; right towards God; Jesarelah, an Israelite KJV: Jesharelah.

H3481.gloss: a Jisreelite or descendant of Jisrael
H3481.def: patronymically from H3478 (יִשְׂרָאֵל); a Jisreelite or descendant of Jisrael KJV: of Israel, Israelite.

H3482.gloss: a Jisreelitess or female descendant of Jisrael
H3482.def: feminine of H3481 (יִשְׂרְאֵלִי); a Jisreelitess or female descendant of Jisrael KJV: Israelitish.

H3483.def: feminine of H3477 (יָשָׁר); rectitude KJV: uprightness.

H3484.gloss: Jeshurun, a symbolic name for Israel
H3484.def: from H3474 (יָשַׁר); upright; Jeshurun, a symbolic name for Israel KJV: Jeshurun.

H3485.def: (strictly yis-saws-kawr'); from H5375 (נָשָׂא) and H7939 (שָׂכָר); he will bring a reward; Jissaskar, a son of Jacob KJV: Issachar.

H3486.def: from an unused root meaning to blanch; gray-haired, i.e. an aged man KJV: stoop for age.

H3487.gloss: a sign of the object of a verb
H3487.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H853 (אֵת); a sign of the object of a verb KJV: [phrase] whom.

H3488.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3427 (יָשַׁב); to sit or dwell KJV: dwell, (be) set, sit.

H3489.def: from an unused root meaning to pin through or fast; a peg KJV: nail, paddle, pin, stake.

H3490.def: from an unused root meaning to be lonely; a bereaved person KJV: fatherless (child), orphan.

H3491.def: passive participle of H3498 (יָתַר); properly, what is left, i.e. (by implication) a gleaning KJV: range.

H3492.def: from H3498 (יָתַר); redundant; Jattir, a place in Palestine KJV: Jattir.

H3493.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3492 (יַתִּיר); preeminent; as an adverb, very KJV: exceeding(-ly), excellent.

H3494.def: probably from H8518 (תָּלָה); it will hang, i.e. be high; Jithlah, a place in Palestine KJV: Jethlah.

H3495.def: from the same as H3490 (יָתוֹם); orphanage; Jithmah, an Israelite KJV: Ithmah.

H3496.def: from an unused root meaning to endure, and H410 (אֵל); continued of God; Jathniel, an Israelite KJV: Jathniel.

H3497.def: from the same as H8577 (תַּנִּין); extensive; Jithnan, a place in Palestine KJV: Ithnan.

H3498.def: a primitive root; to jut over or exceed; by implication, to excel; (intransitively) to remain or be left; causatively, to leave, cause to abound, preserve KJV: excel, leave (a remnant), left behind, too much, make plenteous, preserve, (be, let) remain(-der, -ing, -nant), reserve, residue, rest.

H3499.def: from H3498 (יָתַר); properly, an overhanging, i.e. (by implication) an excess, superiority, remainder; also a small rope (as hanging free) KJV: [phrase] abundant, cord, exceeding, excellancy(-ent), what they leave, that hath left, plentifully, remnant, residue, rest, string, with.

H3500.gloss: Jether, the name of five or six Israelites and of one Midianite
H3500.def: the same as H3499 (יֶתֶר); Jether, the name of five or six Israelites and of one Midianite KJV: Jether, Jethro. Compare H3503 (יִתְרוֹ).

H3501.def: by variation for H3502 (יִתְרָה); Jithra, an Israelite (or Ishmaelite) KJV: Ithra.

H3502.def: feminine of H3499 (יֶתֶר); properly, excellence, i.e. (by implication) wealth KJV: abundance, riches.

H3503.def: from H3499 (יֶתֶר) with pron. suffix; his excellence; Jethro, Moses' father-in-law KJV: Jethro. Compare H3500 (יֶתֶר).

H3504.def: from H3498 (יָתַר); preeminence, gain KJV: better, excellency(-leth), profit(-able).

H3505.gloss: a Jithrite or descendant of Jether
H3505.def: patronymically from H3500 (יֶתֶר); a Jithrite or descendant of Jether KJV: Ithrite.

H3506.gloss: Jithran, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite
H3506.def: from H3498 (יָתַר); excellent; Jithran, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite KJV: Ithran.

H3507.def: from H3499 (יֶתֶר) and H5971 (עַם); excellence of people; Jithream, a son of David KJV: Ithream.

H3508.gloss: the lobe or flap of the liver (as if redundant or outhanging)
H3508.def: feminine active participle of H3498 (יָתַר); the lobe or flap of the liver (as if redundant or outhanging) KJV: caul.

H3509.def: of uncertain derivation; Jetheth, an Edomite KJV: Jetheth. k

H3510.def: a primitive root; properly, to feel pain; by implication, to grieve; figuratively, to spoil KJV: grieving, mar, have pain, make sad (sore), (be) sorrowful.

H3511.def: from H3510 (כָּאַב); suffering (physical or mental), adversity KJV: grief, pain, sorrow.

H3512.def: a primitive root; to despond; causatively, to deject KJV: broken, be grieved, make sad.

H3513.def: or כָּבֵד; a primitive root; to be heavy, i.e. in a bad sense (burdensome, severe, dull) or in a good sense (numerous, rich, honorable; causatively, to make weighty (in the same two senses) KJV: abounding with, more grievously afflict, boast, be chargeable, [idiom] be dim, glorify, be (make) glorious (things), glory, (very) great, be grievous, harden, be (make) heavy, be heavier, lay heavily, (bring to, come to, do, get, be had in) honour (self), (be) honourable (man), lade, [idiom] more be laid, make self many, nobles, prevail, promote (to honour), be rich, be (go) sore, stop.

H3514.def: from H3513 (כָּבַד); weight, multitude, vehemence KJV: grievousness, heavy, great number.

H3515.def: from H3513 (כָּבַד); heavy; figuratively in a good sense (numerous) or in a bad sense (severe, difficult, stupid) KJV: (so) great, grievous, hard(-ened), (too) heavy(-ier), laden, much, slow, sore, thick.

H3516.gloss: the liver (as the heaviest of the viscera)
H3516.def: the same as H3515 (כָּבֵד); the liver (as the heaviest of the viscera) KJV: liver.

H3517.def: feminine of H3515 (כָּבֵד); difficulty KJV: [idiom] heavily.

H3518.gloss: to expire or (causatively) to extinguish (fire, light, anger)
H3518.def: a primitive root; to expire or (causatively) to extinguish (fire, light, anger) KJV: go (put) out, quench.

H3519.gloss: properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness
H3519.def: rarely כָּבֹד; from H3513 (כָּבַד); properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness KJV: glorious(-ly), glory, honour(-able).

H3520.def: irregular feminine passive participle of H3513 (כָּבַד); weightiness, i.e. magnificence, wealth KJV: carriage, all glorious, stately.

H3521.gloss: Cabul, the name of two places in Palestine
H3521.def: from the same as H3525 (כֶּבֶל) in the sense of limitation; sterile; Cabul, the name of two places in Palestine KJV: Cabul.

H3522.def: from an unused root meaning to heap up; hilly; Cabon, a place in Palestine KJV: Cabbon.

H3523.def: from H3527 (כָּבַר) in the original sense of plaiting; a matrass (of intertwined materials) KJV: pillow.

H3524.gloss: vast, whether in extent (figuratively, of power, mighty
H3524.def: from H3527 (כָּבַר); vast, whether in extent (figuratively, of power, mighty; of time, aged), or in number, many KJV: [phrase] feeble, mighty, most, much, strong, valiant.

H3525.def: from an unused root meaning to twine or braid together; a fetter KJV: fetter.

H3526.def: a primitive root; to trample; hence, to wash (properly, by stamping with the feet), whether literal (including the fulling process) or figurative KJV: fuller, wash(-ing).

H3527.def: a primitive root; properly, to plait together, i.e. (figuratively) to augment (especially in number or quantity, to accumulate) KJV: in abundance, multiply.

H3528.def: from H3527 (כָּבַר); properly, extent of time, i.e. a great while; hence, long ago, formerly, hitherto KJV: already, (seeing that which), now.

H3529.def: the same as H3528 (כְּבָר); length; Kebar, a river of Mesopotamia KJV: Chebar. Compare H2249 (חָבוֹר).

H3530.def: feminine of H3528 (כְּבָר); properly, length, i.e. a measure (of uncertain dimension) KJV: [idiom] little.

H3531.def: from H3527 (כָּבַר) in its original sense; a sieve (as netted) KJV: sieve.

H3532.gloss: a ram (just old enough to butt)
H3532.def: from an unused root meaning to dominate; a ram (just old enough to butt) KJV: lamb, sheep.

H3533.def: a primitive root; to tread down; hence, negatively, to disregard; positively, to conquer, subjugate, violate KJV: bring into bondage, force, keep under, subdue, bring into subjection.

H3534.def: from H3533 (כָּבַשׁ); a footstool (as trodden upon) KJV: footstool.

H3535.def: or כַּבְשָׂה; feminine of H3532 (כֶּבֶשׂ); a ewe KJV: (ewe) lamb.

H3536.def: from H3533 (כָּבַשׁ); a smelting furnace (as reducing metals) KJV: furnace.

H3537.def: from an unused root meaning to deepen; properly, a pail; but generally of earthenware; a jar  for domestic purposes KJV: barrel, pitcher.

H3538.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H3576 (כָּזַב); false KJV: lying.

H3539.gloss: a sparkling gem, probably the ruby
H3539.def: from the same as H3537 (כַּד) in the sense of striking fire from a metal forged; a sparkling gem, probably the ruby KJV: agate.

H3540.def: of foreign origin; Kedorlaomer, an early Persian king KJV: Chedorlaomer.

H3541.def: from the prefix k and H1931 (הוּא); properly, like this, i.e. by implication, (of manner) thus (or so); also (of place) here (or hither); or (of time) now KJV: also, here, + hitherto, like, on the other side, so (and much), such, on that manner, (on) this (manner, side, way, way and that way), + mean while, yonder.

H3542.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3541 (כֹּה) {properly, like this, i.e. by implication, (of manner) thus (or so); also (of place) here (or hither); or (of time) now} KJV: hitherto.

H3543.def: a primitive root; to be weak, i.e. (figuratively) to despond (causatively, rebuke), or (of light, the eye) to grow dull KJV: darken, be dim, fail, faint, restrain, [idiom] utterly.

H3544.def: from H3543 (כָּהָה); feeble, obscure KJV: somewhat dark, darkish, wax dim, heaviness, smoking.

H3545.def: feminine of H3544 (כֵּהֶה); properly, a weakening; figuratively, alleviation, i.e. cure KJV: healing.

H3546.def: (Aramaic) a root corresponding to and H3557 (כּוּל); to be able KJV: be able, could.

H3547.def: a primitive root, apparently meaning to mediate in religious services; but used only as denominative from H3548 (כֹּהֵן); to officiate as a priest; figuratively, to put on regalia KJV: deck, be (do the office of a, execute the, minister in the) priest('s office).

H3548.def: active participle of H3547 (כָּהַן); literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman) KJV: chief ruler, [idiom] own, priest, prince, principal officer.

H3549.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3548 (כֹּהֵן) {one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman)} KJV: priest.

H3550.def: from H3547 (כָּהַן); priesthood KJV: priesthood, priest's office.

H3551.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H3854 (לַהַג) in the sense of piercing; a window (as a perforation) KJV: window.

H3552.def: of foreign derivation; Kub, a country near Egypt KJV: Chub.

H3553.def: from an unused root meaning to be high or rounded; a helmet (as arched) KJV: helmet. Compare H6959 (קוֹבַע).

H3554.def: a primitive root; properly, to prick or penetrate; hence, to blister (as smarting or eating into) KJV: burn.

H3555.def: from H3554 (כָּוָה); a branding KJV: burning.

H3556.gloss: a star (as round or as shining)
H3556.def: probably from the same as H3522 (כַּבּוֹן) (in the sense of rolling) or H3554 (כָּוָה) (in the sense of blazing); a star (as round or as shining); figuratively, a prince KJV: star(-gazer).

H3557.def: a primitive root; properly, to keep in; hence, to measure; figuratively, to maintain (in various senses) KJV: (be able to, can) abide, bear, comprehend, contain, feed, forbearing, guide, hold(-ing in), nourish(-er), be present, make provision, receive, sustain, provide sustenance (victuals).

H3558.def: from an unused root meaning to store away; a jewel (probably gold beads) KJV: tablet.

H3559.def: a primitive root; properly, to be erect (i.e. stand perpendicular); hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative (appoint, render sure, proper or prosperous) KJV: certain(-ty), confirm, direct, faithfulness, fashion, fasten, firm, be fitted, be fixed, frame, be meet, ordain, order, perfect, (make) preparation, prepare (self), provide, make provision, (be, make) ready, right, set (aright, fast, forth), be stable, (e-) stablish, stand, tarry, [idiom] very deed.

H3560.def: probably from H3559 (כּוּן); established; Kun, a place in Syria KJV: Chun.

H3561.def: from H3559 (כּוּן); something prepared, i.e. a sacrificial wafer KJV: cake.

H3562.gloss: Conanjah, the name of two Israelites
H3562.def: from H3559 (כּוּן) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has sustained; Conanjah, the name of two Israelites KJV: Conaniah, Cononiah. Compare H3663 (כְּנַנְיָה).

H3563.gloss: a cup (as a container), often figuratively, a lot (as if a potion)
H3563.def: from an unused root meaning to hold together; a cup (as a container), often figuratively, a lot (as if a potion); also some unclean bird, probably an owl (perhaps from the cup-like cavity of its eye) KJV: cup, (small) owl. Compare H3599 (כִּיס).

H3564.gloss: a pot or furnace (as if excavated)
H3564.def: from an unused root meaning properly, to dig through; a pot or furnace (as if excavated) KJV: furnace. Compare H3600 (כִּיר).

H3565.def: from H3564 (כּוּר) and H6227 (עָשָׁן); furnace of smoke; Cor-Ashan, a place in Palestine KJV: Chorashan.

H3566.def: or (Ezra 1:1 (last time),2) כֹּרֶשׁ; from the Persians; Koresh (or Cyrus), the Persian king KJV: Cyrus.

H3567.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3566 (כּוֹרֶשׁ) {Koresh (or Cyrus), the Persian king} KJV: Cyrus.

H3568.gloss: Cush (or Ethiopia), the name of a son of Ham, and of his territory
H3568.def: probably of foreign origin; Cush (or Ethiopia), the name of a son of Ham, and of his territory; also of an Israelite KJV: Chush, Cush, Ethiopia.

H3569.gloss: a Cushite, or descendant of Cush
H3569.def: patronymically from H3568 (כּוּשׁ); a Cushite, or descendant of Cush KJV: Cushi, Cushite, Ethiopian(-s).

H3570.gloss: Cushi, the name of two Israelites
H3570.def: the same as H3569 (כּוּשִׁי); Cushi, the name of two Israelites KJV: Cushi.

H3571.def: feminine of H3569 (כּוּשִׁי); a Cushite woman KJV: Ethiopian.

H3572.def: perhaps from H3568 (כּוּשׁ); Cushan, a region of Arabia KJV: Cushan.

H3573.def: apparently from H3572 (כּוּשָׁן) and the dual of H7564 (רִשְׁעָה); Cushan of double wickedness; Cushan-Rishathajim, a Mesopotamian king KJV: Chushan-rishathayim.

H3574.def: from H3787 (כָּשֵׁר); prosperity; in plural freedom KJV: [idiom] chain.

H3575.gloss: Cuth or Cuthah, a province of Assyria
H3575.def: or (feminine) כּוּתָה; of foreign origin; Cuth or Cuthah, a province of Assyria KJV: Cuth.

H3576.def: a primitive root; to lie (i.e. deceive), literally or figuratively KJV: fail, (be found a, make a) liar, lie, lying, be in vain.

H3577.def: from H3576 (כָּזַב); falsehood; literally (untruth) or figuratively (idol) KJV: deceitful, false, leasing, + liar, lie, lying.

H3578.def: from H3576 (כָּזַב); fallacious; Cozeba, a place in Palestine KJV: Choseba.

H3579.def: from H3576 (כָּזַב); false; Cozbi, a Midianitess KJV: Cozbi.

H3580.def: from H3576 (כָּזַב); falsified; Kezib, a place in Palestine KJV: Chezib.

H3581.gloss: vigor, literally (force, in a good or a bad sense) or figuratively (capacity, means, produce)
H3581.def: or (Daniel 11:6) כּוֹחַ; from an unused root meaning to be firm; vigor, literally (force, in a good or a bad sense) or figuratively (capacity, means, produce); also (from its hardiness) a large lizard KJV: ability, able, chameleon, force, fruits, might, power(-ful), strength, substance, wealth.

H3582.gloss: to secrete, by act or word
H3582.def: a primitive root; to secrete, by act or word; hence (intensively) to destroy KJV: conceal, cut down (off), desolate, hide.

H3583.def: a primitive root; to paint (with stibium) KJV: paint.

H3584.gloss: to be untrue, in word (to lie, feign, disown) or deed (to disappoint, fail, cringe)
H3584.def: a primitive root; to be untrue, in word (to lie, feign, disown) or deed (to disappoint, fail, cringe) KJV: deceive, deny, dissemble, fail, deal falsely, be found liars, (be-) lie, lying, submit selves.

H3585.gloss: literally a failure of flesh, i
H3585.def: from H3584 (כָּחַשׁ); literally a failure of flesh, i.e. emaciation; figuratively, hypocrisy KJV: leanness, lies, lying.

H3587.def: from H3554 (כָּוָה); a brand or scar KJV: burning.

H3588.gloss: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below)
H3588.def: a primitive particle (the full form of the prepositional prefix) indicating causal relations of all kinds, antecedent or consequent; (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed KJV: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.

H3589.def: from a primitive root meaning to strike; a crushing; figuratively, calamity KJV: destruction.

H3590.def: from the same as H3589 (כִּיד) (compare H3539 (כַּדְכֹּד)); properly, something struck off, i.e. a spark (as struck) KJV: spark.

H3591.gloss: properly, something to strike with, i
H3591.def: from the same as H3589 (כִּיד); (perhaps smaller than H2595 (חֲנִית)lemma חֲניִת second vowel, corrected to חֲנִית) properly, something to strike with, i.e. a dart KJV: lance, shield, spear, target.

H3592.def: the same as H3591 (כִּידוֹן); Kidon, a place in Palestine KJV: Chidon.

H3593.def: of uncertain derivation; perhaps tumult KJV: battle.

H3594.def: from H3559 (כּוּן); properly, a statue, i.e. idol; but used (by euphemism) forsome heathen deity (perhaps corresponding to Priapus or Baal-peor) KJV: Chiun.

H3595.gloss: properly, something round (as excavated or bored), i
H3595.def: or כִּיֹּר; from the same as H3564 (כּוּר); properly, something round (as excavated or bored), i.e. a chafing-dish forcoals or a caldron forcooking; hence (from similarity of form) a washbowl; also (for the same reason) a pulpit or platform KJV: hearth, laver, pan, scaffold.

H3596.def: or כֵּלַי; from H3557 (כּוּל) in the sense of withholding; niggardly KJV: churl.

H3597.def: from an unused root meaning to clap or strike with noise; a club or sledge-hammer KJV: hammer.

H3598.def: from the same as H3558 (כּוּמָז); a cluster of stars, i.e. the Pleiades KJV: Pleiades, seven stars.

H3599.def: a form for H3563 (כּוֹס); a cup; also a bag formoney or weights KJV: bag, cup, purse.

H3600.gloss: a cooking range (consisting of two parallel stones, across which the boiler is set)
H3600.def: a form for H3564 (כּוּר) (only in the dual); a cooking range (consisting of two parallel stones, across which the boiler is set) KJV: ranges for pots.

H3601.def: from H3787 (כָּשֵׁר); compare H6418 (פֶּלֶךְ) literally a director, i.e. the spindle or shank of adistaff, by which it is twirled KJV: spindle.

H3602.gloss: just so, referring to the previous or following context
H3602.def: from H3541 (כֹּה); just so, referring to the previous or following context KJV: after that (this) manner, this matter, (even) so, in such a case, thus.

H3603.def: from H3769 (כָּרַר); a circle, i.e. (by implication) a circumjacent tract or region, especially the Ghor or valley of the Jordan; also a (round) loaf; also a talent (or large [round] coin) KJV: loaf, morsel, piece, plain, talent.

H3604.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3603 (כִּכָּר); a talent KJV: talent.

H3605.def: or (Jeremiah 33:8) כּוֹל; from H3634 (כָּלַל); properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense) KJV: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

H3606.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3605 (כֹּל) {properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)} KJV: all, any, + (forasmuch) as, + be-(for this) cause, every, + no (manner, -ne), + there (where) -fore, + though, what (where, who) -soever, (the) whole.

H3607.gloss: to restrict, by act (hold back or in) or word (prohibit)
H3607.def: a primitive root; to restrict, by act (hold back or in) or word (prohibit) KJV: finish, forbid, keep (back), refrain, restrain, retain, shut up, be stayed, withhold.

H3608.def: from H3607 (כָּלָא); a prison KJV: prison. Compare H3610 (כִּלְאַיִם), H3628 (כְּלִיא).

H3609.def: apparently from H3607 (כָּלָא) and H1 (אָב); restraint of (his) father; Kilab, an Israelite KJV: Chileab.

H3610.def: dual of H3608 (כֶּלֶא) in the original sense of separation; two heterogeneities KJV: divers seeds (-e kinds), mingled (seed).

H3611.def: from an unused root means. to yelp, or else to attack; a dog; hence (by euphemism) a male prostitute KJV: dog.

H3612.gloss: Caleb, the name of three Israelites
H3612.def: perhaps a form of H3611 (כֶּלֶב), or else from the same root in the sense of forcible; Caleb, the name of three Israelites KJV: Caleb.

H3613.gloss: Caleb-Ephrathah, a place in Egypt (if the text is correct)
H3613.def: from H3612 (כָּלֵב) and H672 (אֶפְרָת); Caleb-Ephrathah, a place in Egypt (if the text is correct) KJV: Caleb-ephrathah.

H3614.gloss: a Calebite or descendant of Caleb
H3614.def: probably by erroneous transcription for כָּלֵבִי; patronymically from H3612 (כָּלֵב); a Calebite or descendant of Caleb KJV: of the house of Caleb.

H3615.gloss: to end, whether intransitive (to cease, be finished, perish) or transitived (to complete, prepare, consume)
H3615.def: a primitive root; to end, whether intransitive (to cease, be finished, perish) or transitived (to complete, prepare, consume) KJV: accomplish, cease, consume (away), determine, destroy (utterly), be (when... were) done, (be an) end (of), expire, (cause to) fail, faint, finish, fulfil, [idiom] fully, [idiom] have, leave (off), long, bring to pass, wholly reap, make clean riddance, spend, quite take away, waste.

H3617.def: from H3615 (כָּלָה); a completion; adverb, completely; also destruction KJV: altogether, (be, utterly) consume(-d), consummation(-ption), was determined, (full, utter) end, riddance.

H3618.def: from H3634 (כָּלַל); a bride (as if perfect); hence, a son's wife KJV: bride, daughter-in-law, spouse.

H3619.gloss: a bird-trap (as furnished with a clap-stick or treadle to spring it)
H3619.def: from the same as H3611 (כֶּלֶב); a bird-trap (as furnished with a clap-stick or treadle to spring it); hence, a basket (as resembling a wicker cage) KJV: basket, cage.

H3620.gloss: Kelub, the name of two Israelites
H3620.def: the same as H3619 (כְּלוּב)xlit kᵉlûb corrected to kᵉlûwb; Kelub, the name of two Israelites KJV: Chelub.

H3621.def: a form of H3612 (כָּלֵב); Kelubai, an Israelite KJV: Chelubai.

H3622.def: from H3615 (כָּלָה); completed; Keluhai, an Israelite KJV: Chelluh.

H3623.def: denominative passive participle from H3618 (כַּלָּה)lemma כַּלָה missing dagesh, corrected to כַּלָּה; bridehood (only in the plural) KJV: espousal.

H3624.def: from an unused root meaning to be complete; maturity KJV: full (old) age.

H3625.def: the same as H3624 (כֶּלַח); Kelach, a place in Assyria KJV: Calah.

H3626.def: from H3605 (כֹּל) and H2374 (חֹזֶה); every seer; Col-Chozeh, an Israelite KJV: Col-hozeh.

H3627.def: from H3615 (כָּלָה); something prepared, i.e. any apparatus (as an implement, utensil, dress, vessel or weapon) KJV: armour(-bearer), artillery, bag, carriage, [phrase] furnish, furniture, instrument, jewel, that is made of, [idiom] one from another, that which pertaineth, pot, [phrase] psaltery, sack, stuff, thing, tool, vessel, ware, weapon, [phrase] whatsoever.

H3628.def: or כְּלוּא; from H3627 (כְּלִי) (compare H3608 (כֶּלֶא)); a prison KJV: prison.

H3629.def: feminine of H3627 (כְּלִי) (only in the plural); a kidney (as an essential organ); figuratively, the mind (as the interior self) KJV: kidneys, reins.

H3630.def: a form of H3631 (כִּלָּיוֹן); Kiljon, an Israelite KJV: Chilion.

H3631.def: from H3615 (כָּלָה); pining, destruction KJV: consumption, failing.

H3632.def: from H3634 (כָּלַל); complete; as noun, the whole (specifically, a sacrifice entirely consumed); as adverb, fully KJV: all, every whit, flame, perfect(-ion), utterly, whole burnt offering (sacrifice), wholly.

H3633.def: from H3557 (כּוּל); sustenance; Calcol, an Israelite KJV: Calcol, Chalcol.

H3634.def: a primitive root; to complete KJV: (make) perfect.

H3635.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3634 (כָּלַל); to complete KJV: finish, make (set) up.

H3636.def: from H3634 (כָּלַל); complete; Kelal, an Israelite KJV: Chelal.

H3637.def: a primitive root; properly, to wound; but only figuratively, to taunt or insult KJV: be (make) ashamed, blush, be confounded, be put to confusion, hurt, reproach, (do, put to) shame.

H3638.gloss: Kilmad, a place apparently in the Assyrian empire
H3638.def: of foreign derivation; Kilmad, a place apparently in the Assyrian empire KJV: Chilmad.

H3639.def: from H3637 (כָּלַם); disgrace KJV: confusion, dishonour, reproach, shame.

H3641.gloss: Calneh or Calno, a place in the Assyrian empire
H3641.def: or כַּלְנֵה; also כַּלְנוֹ; of foreign derivation; Calneh or Calno, a place in the Assyrian empire KJV: Calneh, Calno. Compare H3656 (כַּנֶּה).

H3642.def: a primitive root; to pine after KJV: long.

H3643.def: from H3642 (כָּמַהּ); pining; Kimham, an Israelite KJV: Chimham.

H3644.gloss: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as, thus, so
H3644.def: or כָּמוֹ; (compare H3651 (כֵּן)); a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as, thus, so KJV: according to, (such) as (it were, well as), in comparison of, like (as, to, unto), thus, when, worth.

H3645.gloss: Kemosh, the god of the Moabites
H3645.def: or (Jeremiah 48:7) כְּמִישׁ; from an unused root meaning to subdue; the powerful; Kemosh, the god of the Moabites KJV: Chemosh.

H3646.def: from an unused root meaning to store up or preserve; 'cummin' (from its use as a condiment) KJV: cummin.

H3647.def: a primitive root; to store away, i.e. (figuratively) in the memory KJV: lay up in store.

H3648.gloss: properly, to intertwine or contract, i
H3648.def: a primitive root; properly, to intertwine or contract, i.e. (by implication) to shrivel (as with heat); figuratively, to be deeply affected with passion (love or pity) KJV: be black, be kindled, yearn.

H3649.gloss: properly, an ascetic (as if shrunk with self-maceration), i
H3649.def: from H3648 (כָּמַר); properly, an ascetic (as if shrunk with self-maceration), i.e. an idolatrous priest (only in plural) KJV: Chemarims (idolatrous) priests.

H3650.gloss: obscuration (as if from shrinkage of light, i
H3650.def: redupl. from H3648 (כָּמַר); obscuration (as if from shrinkage of light, i.e. an eclipse (only in plural) KJV: blackness.

H3651.def: from H3559 (כּוּן); properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles) KJV: [phrase] after that (this, -ward, -wards), as... as, [phrase] (for-) asmuch as yet, [phrase] be (for which) cause, [phrase] following, howbeit, in (the) like (manner, -wise), [idiom] the more, right, (even) so, state, straightway, such (thing), surely, [phrase] there (where) -fore, this, thus, true, well, [idiom] you.

H3652.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3651 (כֵּן); so KJV: thus.

H3653.def: the same as H3651 (כֵּן), used as a noun; a stand, i.e. pedestal or station KJV: base, estate, foot, office, place, well.

H3654.def: from H3661 (כָּנַן) in the sense of fastening; (from infixing its sting; used only in plural (and irregular in Exodus 8:17,18; Hebrews 13:14)) a gnat KJV: lice, [idiom] manner.

H3655.gloss: to address by an additional name
H3655.def: a primitive root; to address by an additional name; hence, to eulogize KJV: give flattering titles, surname (himself).

H3656.def: for H3641 (כַּלְנֶה); Canneh, a place in Assyria KJV: Canneh.

H3657.def: from H3661 (כָּנַן); a plant (as set) KJV: [idiom] vineyard.

H3658.def: from a unused root meaning to twang; a harp KJV: harp.

H3659.def: for H3204 (יְכׇנְיָה); Conjah, an Israelite king KJV: Coniah.

H3660.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3644 (כְּמוֹ); so or thus KJV: so, (in) this manner (sort), thus.

H3661.def: a primitive root; to set out, i.e. plant KJV: [idiom] vineyard.

H3662.def: from H3661 (כָּנַן); planted; Kenani, an Israelite KJV: Chenani.

H3663.def: or כְּנַנְיָהוּ; from H3661 (כָּנַן) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has planted; Kenanjah, an Israelite KJV: Chenaniah.

H3664.def: a primitive root; to collect; hence, to enfold KJV: gather (together), heap up, wrap self.

H3665.def: a primitive root; properly, to bend the knee; hence, to humiliate, vanquish KJV: bring down (low), into subjection, under, humble (self), subdue.

H3666.def: from H3665 (כָּנַע) in the sense of folding (compare H3664 (כָּנַס)); a package KJV: wares.

H3667.def: from H3665 (כָּנַע); humiliated; Kenaan, a son a Ham; also the country inhabited by him KJV: Canaan, merchant, traffick.

H3668.gloss: Kenaanah, the name of two Israelites
H3668.def: feminine of H3667 (כְּנַעַן); Kenaanah, the name of two Israelites KJV: Chenaanah.

H3669.gloss: a Kenaanite or inhabitant of Kenaan
H3669.def: patrial from H3667 (כְּנַעַן); a Kenaanite or inhabitant of Kenaan; by implication, a pedlar (the Canaanites standing for their neighbors the Ishmaelites, who conducted mercantile caravans) KJV: Canaanite, merchant, trafficker.

H3670.def: a primitive root; properly, to project laterally, i.e. probably (reflexive) to withdraw KJV: be removed.

H3671.def: from H3670 (כָּנַף); an edge or extremity; specifically (of a bird or army) a wing, (of a garment or bedclothing) a flap, (of the earth) a quarter, (of a building) a pinnacle KJV: [phrase] bird, border, corner, end, feather(-ed), [idiom] flying, [phrase] (one an-) other, overspreading, [idiom] quarters, skirt, [idiom] sort, uttermost part, wing(-ed).

H3672.gloss: Kinneroth or Kinnereth, a place in Palestine
H3672.def: or כִּנֶּרֶתlemma כִּנֶרֶת missing dagesh, corrected to כִּנֶּרֶת; respectively plural and singular feminine from the same as H3658 (כִּנּוֹר); perhaps harp-shaped; Kinneroth or Kinnereth, a place in Palestine KJV: Chinnereth, Chinneroth, Cinneroth.

H3673.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3664 (כָּנַס); to assemble KJV: gather together.

H3674.gloss: a colleague (as having the same title)
H3674.def: from H3655 (כָּנָה); a colleague (as having the same title) KJV: companion.

H3675.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3674 (כְּנָת) {a colleague (as having the same title)} KJV: companion.

H3676.def: apparently a contraction for H3678 (כִּסֵּא), but probably by erroneous transcription for H5251 (נֵס) {a flag; also a sail; by implication, a flagstaff; generally a signal; figuratively, a token} KJV: sworn.

H3677.gloss: properly, fulness or the full moon, i
H3677.def: or כֶּסֶה; apparently from H3680 (כָּסָה); properly, fulness or the full moon, i.e. its festival KJV: (time) appointed.

H3678.def: or כִּסֵּה; from H3680 (כָּסָה); properly, covered, i.e. a throne (as canopied) KJV: seat, stool, throne.

H3679.def: for H3778 (כַּשְׂדִּי) {a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed; by implication, a Chaldaean (as if so descended); also an astrologer (as if proverbial of that people} KJV: Chaldean.

H3680.def: a primitive root; properly, to plump, i.e. fill up hollows; by implication, to cover (for clothing or secrecy) KJV: clad self, close, clothe, conceal, cover (self), (flee to) hide, overwhelm. Compare H3780 (כָּשָׂה).

H3681.def: passive participle of H3680 (כָּסָה); properly, covered, i.e. (as noun) a covering KJV: covering.

H3682.def: from H3680 (כָּסָה); a cover (garment); figuratively, a veiling KJV: covering, raiment, vesture.

H3683.def: a primitive root; to cut off KJV: cut down (up).

H3684.def: from H3688 (כָּסַל); properly, fat, i.e. (figuratively) stupid or silly KJV: fool(-ish).

H3685.def: the same as H3684 (כְּסִיל); any notable constellation; specifically Orion (as if a burly one) KJV: constellation, Orion.

H3686.def: the same as H3684 (כְּסִיל); Kesil, a place in Palestine KJV: Chesil.

H3688.def: a primitive root; properly, to be fat, i.e. (figuratively) silly KJV: be foolish.

H3689.def: from H3688 (כָּסַל); properly, fatness, i.e. by implication (literally) the loin (as the seat of the leaf fat) or (generally) the viscera; also (figuratively) silliness or (in a good sense) trust KJV: confidence, flank, folly, hope, loin.

H3690.def: feminine of H3689 (כֶּסֶל); in a good sense, trust; in a bad one, silliness KJV: confidence, folly.

H3691.def: probably of foreign origin; Kisleu, the 9th Hebrew month KJV: Chisleu.

H3692.def: from H3688 (כָּסַל); hopeful; Kislon, an Israelite KJV: Chislon.

H3693.def: from H3688 (כָּסַל); fertile; Kesalon, a place in Palestine KJV: Chesalon.

H3694.def: feminine plural of passive participle of H3688 (כָּסַל); fattened; Kesulloth, a place in Palestine KJV: Chesulloth.

H3695.gloss: Casluchim, a people cognate to the Egyptians
H3695.def: a plural probably of foreign derivation; Casluchim, a people cognate to the Egyptians KJV: Casluhim.

H3696.def: from the feminine plural of H3689 (כֶּסֶל) and H8396 (תָּבוֹר); flanks of Tabor; Kisloth-Tabor, a place in Palestine KJV: Chisloth-tabor.

H3697.def: a primitive root; to shear KJV: [idiom] only, poll. Compare H3765 (כִּרְסֵם).

H3698.gloss: spelt (from its bristliness as if just shorn)
H3698.def: from H3697 (כָּסַם); spelt (from its bristliness as if just shorn) KJV: fitches, rie.

H3699.def: a primitive root; to estimate KJV: make count.

H3700.def: a primitive root; properly, to become pale, i.e. (by implication) to pine after; also to fear KJV: (have) desire, be greedy, long, sore.

H3701.def: from H3700 (כָּסַף); silver (from its pale color); by implication, money KJV: money, price, silver(-ling).

H3702.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3701 (כֶּסֶף) {silver (from its pale color); by implication, money} KJV: money, silver.

H3703.def: perhaps from H3701 (כֶּסֶף); silvery; Casiphja, a place in Babylon KJV: Casiphia.

H3704.gloss: a cushion or pillow (as covering a seat or bed)
H3704.def: from H3680 (כָּסָה); a cushion or pillow (as covering a seat or bed) KJV: pillow.

H3705.def: (Aramaic) probably from H3652 (כֵּן); now KJV: now.

H3706.gloss: thus (only in the formula 'and so forth')
H3706.def: (Aramaic) or כְּעֶת; (Aramaic), feminine of H3705 (כְּעַן); thus (only in the formula 'and so forth') KJV: at such a time.

H3707.def: a primitive root; to trouble; by implication, to grieve, rage, be indignant KJV: be angry, be grieved, take indignation, provoke (to anger, unto wrath), have sorrow, vex, be wroth.

H3708.def: or (in Job) כַּעַשׂ; from H3707 (כַּעַס); vexation KJV: anger, angry, grief, indignation, provocation, provoking, [idiom] sore, sorrow, spite, wrath.

H3709.gloss: the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree)
H3709.def: from H3721 (כָּפַף); the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree); figuratively, power KJV: branch, [phrase] foot, hand((-ful), -dle, (-led)), hollow, middle, palm, paw, power, sole, spoon.

H3710.def: from H3721 (כָּפַף); a hollow rock KJV: rock.

H3711.def: a primitive root; properly, to bend, i.e. (figuratively) to tame or subdue KJV: pacify.

H3712.def: feminine of H3709 (כַּף); a leaf of a palmtree KJV: branch.

H3713.def: from H3722 (כָּפַר); properly, a cover, i.e. (by implication) a tankard (or covered goblet); also white frost (as covering the ground) KJV: bason, hoar(-y) frost.

H3714.def: from an unused root meaning to connect; a girder KJV: beam.

H3715.gloss: a village (as covered in by walls)
H3715.def: from H3722 (כָּפַר); a village (as covered in by walls); also a young lion (perhaps as covered with a mane) KJV: (young) lion, village. Compare H3723 (כָּפָר).

H3716.def: feminine of H3715 (כְּפִיר); the village (always with the art.); Kephirah, a place in Palestine KJV: Chephirah.

H3717.def: a primitive root; to fold together; figuratively, to repeat KJV: double.

H3718.def: from H3717 (כָּפַל); a duplicate KJV: double.

H3719.def: a primitive root; to bend KJV: bend.

H3720.gloss: hunger (as making to stoop with emptiness and pain)
H3720.def: from H3719 (כָּפַן); hunger (as making to stoop with emptiness and pain) KJV: famine.

H3721.def: a primitive root; to curve KJV: bow down (self).

H3722.def: a primitive root; to cover (specifically with bitumen); figuratively, to expiate or condone, to placate or cancel KJV: appease, make (an atonement, cleanse, disannul, forgive, be merciful, pacify, pardon, purge (away), put off, (make) reconcile(-liation).

H3723.def: from H3722 (כָּפַר); a village (as protected by walls) KJV: village. Compare H3715 (כְּפִיר).

H3724.def: from H3722 (כָּפַר); properly, a cover, i.e. (literally) a village (as covered in); (specifically) bitumen (as used for coating), and the henna plant (as used for dyeing); figuratively, a redemption-price KJV: bribe, camphire, pitch, ransom, satisfaction, sum of money, village.

H3725.def: from H3722 (כָּפַר); expiation (only in plural) KJV: atonement.

H3726.def: from H3723 (כָּפָר) and H5984 (עַמּוֹנִי), with the article interposed; village of the Ammonite; Kefar-ha-Ammoni, a place in Palestine KJV: Chefarhaamonai.

H3727.gloss: a lid (used only of the cover of the sacred Ark)
H3727.def: from H3722 (כָּפַר); a lid (used only of the cover of the sacred Ark) KJV: mercy seat.

H3728.def: a primitive root; to tread down; figuratively, to humiliate KJV: cover.

H3729.def: (Aramaic) a root of uncertain correspondence; to fetter KJV: bind.

H3730.def: or (Amos 9:1) כַּפְתּוֹר; probably from an unused root meaning to encircle; a chaplet; but used only in an architectonic sense, i.e. the capital of acolumn, or a wreath-like button or disk on the candelabrum KJV: knop, (upper) lintel.

H3731.def: or (Amos 9:7) כַּפְתּוֹר; apparently the same as H3730 (כַּפְתֹּר); Caphtor (i.e. a wreath-shaped island), the original seat of the Philistines KJV: Caphtor.

H3732.gloss: a Caphtorite (collectively) or native of Caphtor
H3732.def: patrial from H3731 (כַּפְתֹּר); a Caphtorite (collectively) or native of Caphtor KJV: Caphthorim, Caphtorim(-s).

H3733.gloss: a ram (as full-grown and fat), including a battering-ram (as butting)
H3733.def: from H3769 (כָּרַר) in the sense of plumpness; a ram (as full-grown and fat), including a battering-ram (as butting); hence, a meadow (as for sheep); also a pad or camel's saddle (as puffed out) KJV: captain, furniture, lamb, (large) pasture, ram. See also H1033 (בֵּית כַּר), H3746 (כָּרִי).

H3734.gloss: properly, a deep round vessel, i
H3734.def: from the same as H3564 (כּוּר); properly, a deep round vessel, i.e. (specifically) a cor or measure for things dry KJV: cor, measure. Aramaic the same.

H3735.def: (Aramaic) probably corresponding to H3738 (כָּרָה) in the sense of piercing(figuratively); to grieve KJV: be grieved.

H3736.def: from the same as H3525 (כֶּבֶל); to gird or clothe KJV: clothed.

H3737.def: (Aramaic) from a verb corresponding to that of H3736 (כַּרְבֵּל); a mantle KJV: hat.

H3738.def: a primitive root; properly, to dig; figuratively, to plot; generally, to bore or open KJV: dig, [idiom] make (a banquet), open.

H3739.def: usually assigned as a primitive root, but probably only a special application of H3738 (כָּרָה) (through the common idea of planning implied in a bargain); to purchase KJV: buy, prepare.

H3740.def: from H3739 (כָּרָה); a purchase KJV: provision.

H3741.def: feminine of H3733 (כַּר); a meadow KJV: cottage.

H3742.def: of uncertain derivation; a cherub or imaginary figure KJV: cherub, (plural) cherubims.

H3743.def: the same as H3742 (כְּרוּב); Kerub, a place in Babylon KJV: Cherub.

H3744.def: (Aramaic) from H3745 (כְּרַז); a herald KJV: herald.

H3745.def: (Aramaic) probably of Greek origin; to proclaim KJV: make a proclamation.

H3746.def: perhaps an abridged plural of H3733 (כַּר) in the sense of leader (of the flock); a life-guardsman KJV: captains, Cherethites (from the margin).

H3747.def: from H3772 (כָּרַת); a cut; Kerith, a brook of Palestine KJV: Cherith.

H3748.gloss: a cutting (of the matrimonial bond), i
H3748.def: from H3772 (כָּרַת); a cutting (of the matrimonial bond), i.e. divorce KJV: divorce(-ment).

H3749.def: expanded from the same as H3522 (כַּבּוֹן); a rim or top margin KJV: compass.

H3750.def: probably of foreign origin; the crocus KJV: saffron.

H3751.def: of foreign derivation; Karkemish, a place in Syria KJV: Carchemish.

H3752.def: of Persian origin; Karkas, a eunuch of Xerxes KJV: Carcas.

H3753.gloss: a dromedary (from its rapid motion as if dancing)

H3754.def: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a garden or vineyard KJV: vines, (increase of the) vineyard(-s), vintage. See also H1021 (בֵּית הַכֶּרֶם).

H3756.gloss: Karmi, the name of three Israelites
H3756.def: from H3754 (כֶּרֶם); gardener; Karmi, the name of three Israelites KJV: Carmi.

H3757.gloss: a Karmite or descendant of Karmi
H3757.def: patronymically from H3756 (כַּרְמִי); a Karmite or descendant of Karmi KJV: Carmites.

H3758.def: probably of foreign origin; carmine, a deep red KJV: crimson.

H3759.gloss: a planted field (garden, orchard, vineyard or park)

H3760.gloss: Karmel, the name of a hill and of a town in Palestine
H3760.def: the same as H3759 (כַּרְמֶל); Karmel, the name of a hill and of a town in Palestine KJV: Carmel, fruitful (plentiful) field, (place).

H3761.gloss: a Karmelite or inhabitant of Karmel (the town)
H3761.def: patron from H3760 (כַּרְמֶל); a Karmelite or inhabitant of Karmel (the town) KJV: Carmelite.

H3762.gloss: a Karmelitess or female inhabitant of Karmel
H3762.def: feminine of H3761 (כַּרְמְלִי); a Karmelitess or female inhabitant of Karmel KJV: Carmelitess.

H3763.def: of uncertain derivation; Keran, an aboriginal Idumaean KJV: Cheran.

H3764.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3678 (כִּסֵּא); a throne KJV: throne.

H3765.def: from H3697 (כָּסַם); to lay waste KJV: waste.

H3766.def: a primitive root; to bend the knee; by implication, to sink, to prostrate KJV: bow (down, self), bring down (low), cast down, couch, fall, feeble, kneeling, sink, smite (stoop) down, subdue, [idiom] very.

H3767.gloss: the leg (from the knee to the ankle) of men or locusts (only in the dual)

H3768.def: of foreign origin; byssus or fine vegetable wool KJV: green.

H3769.def: a primitive root; to dance (i.e. whirl) KJV: dance(-ing).

H3770.gloss: the paunch or belly (as swelling out)

H3772.def: a primitive root; to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication, to destroy or consume; specifically, to covenant (i.e. make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces) KJV: be chewed, be con-(feder-) ate, covenant, cut (down, off), destroy, fail, feller, be freed, hew (down), make a league (covenant), [idiom] lose, perish, [idiom] utterly, [idiom] want.

H3773.def: passive participle feminine of H3772 (כָּרַת); something cut, i.e. a hewn timber KJV: beam.

H3774.def: probably from H3772 (כָּרַת) in the sense of executioner; (compare H2876 (טַבָּח)) (only collectively in the singular as plural) a Kerethite or life-guardsman KJV: Cherethims, Cherethites.

H3777.def: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Kesed, a relative of Abraham KJV: Chesed.

H3778.gloss: a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed

H3781.def: from H3782 (כָּשַׁל); properly, a feller, i.e. an axe KJV: ax.

H3782.gloss: to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs, especially the ankle)
H3782.def: a primitive root; to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs, especially the ankle); by implication, to falter, stumble, faint or fall KJV: bereave (from the margin), cast down, be decayed, (cause to) fail, (cause, make to) fall (down, -ing), feeble, be (the) ruin(-ed, of), (be) overthrown, (cause to) stumble, [idiom] utterly, be weak.

H3783.def: from H3782 (כָּשַׁל); properly, a tottering, i.e. ruin KJV: fall.

H3785.def: from H3784 (כָּשַׁף); magic KJV: sorcery, witchcraft.

H3787.def: a primitive root properly, to be straight or right; by implication, to be acceptable; also to succeed or prosper KJV: direct, be right, prosper.

H3789.gloss: to grave, by implication, to write (describe, inscribe, prescribe, subscribe)

H3790.gloss: {to grave, by implication, to write (describe, inscribe, prescribe, subscribe)}

H3791.def: from H3789 (כָּתַב); something written, i.e. a writing, record or book KJV: register, scripture, writing.

H3792.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3791 (כָּתָב) {something written, i.e. a writing, record or book} KJV: prescribing, writing(-ten).

H3793.gloss: a letter or other mark branded on the skin
H3793.def: from H3789 (כָּתַב); a letter or other mark branded on the skin KJV: [idiom] any (mark).

H3794.def: or כִּתִּיִּי; patrial from an unused name denoting Cyprus (only in the plural); a Kittite or Cypriote; hence, an islander in general, i.e. the Greeks or Romans on the shores opposite Palestine KJV: Chittim, Kittim.

H3795.def: from H3807 (כָּתַת); beaten, i.e. pure (oil) KJV: beaten.

H3796.def: from an unused root meaning to compact; a wall (as gathering inmates) KJV: wall.

H3797.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3796 (כֹּתֶל) {a wall (as gathering inmates)} KJV: wall.

H3798.def: from H3796 (כֹּתֶל) and H376 (אִישׁ); wall of a man; Kithlish, a place in Palestine KJV: Kithlish.

H3800.def: from H3799 (כָּתַם); properly, something carved out, i.e. ore; hence, gold (pure as originally mined) KJV: ((most) fine, pure) gold(-en wedge).

H3801.def: or כֻּתֹּנֶת; from an unused root meaning to cover (compare H3802 (כָּתֵף)); a shirt KJV: coat, garment, robe.

H3802.def: from an unused root meaning to clothe; the shoulder (proper, i.e. upper end of the arm; as being the spot where the garments hang); figuratively, side-piece or lateral projection of anything KJV: arm, corner, shoulder(-piece), side, undersetter.

H3803.def: a primitive root; to enclose; hence (in a friendly sense) to crown, (in a hostile one) to besiege; also to wait (as restraining oneself) KJV: beset round, compass about, be crowned inclose round, suffer.

H3804.def: from H3803 (כָּתַר); properly, a circlet, i.e. a diadem KJV: crown.

H3805.def: feminine active participle of H3803 (כָּתַר); the capital of a column KJV: chapiter.

H3806.def: a primitive root; to butt or pound KJV: bray.

H3807.def: a primitive root; to bruise or violently strike KJV: beat (down, to pieces), break in pieces, crushed, destroy, discomfit, smite, stamp. l

H3821.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3820 (לֵב) {the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything} KJV: heart.

H3846.def: patronymically from H3845 (לִבְנִי); a Libnite or descendants of Libni (collectively) KJV: Libnites.

H3847.def: or לָבֵשׁ; a primitive root; properly, wrap around, i.e. (by implication) to put on agarment or clothe (oneself, or another), literally or figuratively KJV: (in) apparel, arm, array (self), clothe (self), come upon, put (on, upon), wear.

H3850.def: from an unused root of uncertain signification; Lod, a place in Palestine KJV: Lod.

H3869.def: probably of foreign origin; some kind of nuttree, perhaps the almond KJV: hazel.

H3875.def: from H3874 (לוּט); a veil KJV: covering.

H3876.def: the same as H3875 (לוֹט); Lot, Abraham's nephew KJV: Lot.

H3887.def: a primitive root; properly, to make mouths at, i.e. to scoff; hence (from the effort to pronounce a foreign language) to interpret, or (generally) intercede KJV: ambassador, have in derision, interpreter, make a mock, mocker, scorn(-er, -ful), teacher.

H3888.def: a primitive root; to knead KJV: knead.

H3889.def: from H3888 (לוּשׁ); kneading; Lush, a place in Palestine KJV: Laish (from the margin). Compare H3919 (לַיִשׁ).

H3890.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H3867 (לָוָה); properly, adhesion, i.e. (as preposition) with KJV: [idiom] thee.

H3892.def: from an unused root meaning to be new; fresh, i.e. unused or undried KJV: green, moist.

H3893.def: from the same as H3892 (לַח); freshness, i.e. vigor KJV: natural force.

H3894.def: or לָחֻם; passive participle of H3898 (לָחַם); properly, eaten, i.e. food; also flesh, i.e. body KJV: while...is eating, flesh.

H3895.def: from an unused root meaning to be soft; the cheek (from its fleshiness); hence, the jaw-bone KJV: cheek (bone), jaw (bone).

H3896.def: a form of H3895 (לְחִי); Lechi, a place in Palestine KJV: Lehi. Compare also H7437 (רָמַת לֶחִי).

H3897.def: a primitive root; to lick KJV: lick (up).

H3898.def: a primitive root; to feed on; figuratively, to consume; by implication, to battle (as destruction) KJV: devour, eat, [idiom] ever, fight(-ing), overcome, prevail, (make) war(-ring).

H3899.gloss: food (for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it)
H3899.def: from H3898 (לָחַם); See also H1036 (בֵּית לְעַפְרָה) food (for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it) KJV: (shew-) bread, [idiom] eat, food, fruit, loaf, meat, victuals.

H3900.gloss: {(for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it)}
H3900.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3899 (לֶחֶם) {(for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it)} KJV: feast.

H3902.def: from H3899 (לֶחֶם); foodful; (or perhaps erroneous transcription) for H1022 (בֵּית הַלַּחְמִי) Lachmi, an Israelite; or rather probably a brief form KJV: Lahmi. See also H3433 (יָשֻׁבִי לֶחֶם).

H3903.gloss: Lachmam or Lachmas, a place in Palestine
H3903.def: probably by erroneous transcription for לַחְמָם; from H3899 (לֶחֶם); food-like; Lachmam or Lachmas, a place in Palestine KJV: Lahmam.

H3904.def: (Aramaic) from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a concubine KJV: concubine.

H3905.def: a primitive root; properly, to press, i.e. (figuratively) to distress KJV: afflict, crush, force, hold fast, oppress(-or), thrust self.

H3906.def: from H3905 (לָחַץ); distress KJV: affliction, oppression.

H3907.def: a primitive root; to whisper; by implication, to mumble aspell (as a magician) KJV: charmer, whisper (together).

H3908.def: from H3907 (לָחַשׁ); properly, a whisper, i.e. by implication, (in a good sense) a private prayer, (in a bad one) an incantation; concretely, an amulet KJV: charmed, earring, enchantment, orator, prayer.

H3909.def: a form of H3814 (לָאט) or else participle from H3874 (לוּט); properly, covered, i.e. secret; by implication, incantation; also secrecy or (adverb) covertly KJV: enchantment, privily, secretly, softly.

H3910.gloss: a gum (from its sticky nature), probably ladanum
H3910.def: probably from H3874 (לוּט); a gum (from its sticky nature), probably ladanum KJV: myrrh.

H3911.gloss: a kind of lizard (from its covert habits)
H3911.def: from an unused root meaning to hide; a kind of lizard (from its covert habits) KJV: lizard.

H3912.def: masculine plural of passive participle of H3913 (לָטַשׁ); hammered (i.e. oppressed) ones; Letushim, an Arabian tribe KJV: Letushim.

H3913.gloss: properly, to hammer out (an edge), i
H3913.def: a primitive root; properly, to hammer out (an edge), i.e. to sharpen KJV: instructer, sharp(-en), whet.

H3914.def: a form of H3880 (לִוְיָה); a wreath KJV: addition.

H3915.gloss: properly, a twist (away of the light), i
H3915.def: or (Isaiah 21:11) לֵיל; also לַיְלָה; from the same as H3883 (לוּל); properly, a twist (away of the light), i.e. night; figuratively, adversity KJV: (mid-)night (season).

H3916.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3815 (לָאֵל) {Lael an Israelite} KJV: night.

H3917.def: from H3915 (לַיִל); a night spectre KJV: screech owl.

H3918.def: from H3888 (לוּשׁ) in the sense of crushing; a lion (from his destructive blows) KJV: (old) lion.

H3919.gloss: Laish, the name of two places in Palestine
H3919.def: the same as H3918 (לַיִשׁ); Laish, the name of two places in Palestine KJV: Laish. Compare H3889 (לוּשׁ).

H3920.gloss: to catch (in a net, trap or pit)
H3920.def: a primitive root; to catch (in a net, trap or pit); generally, to capture or occupy; also to choose (by lot); figuratively, to cohere KJV: [idiom] at all, catch (self), be frozen, be holden, stick together, take.

H3921.def: from H3920 (לָכַד); something to capture with, i.e. a noose KJV: being taken.

H3922.def: from H3212 (יָלַךְ); a journey; Lekah, a place in Palestine KJV: Lecah.

H3923.def: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Lakish, a place in Palestine KJV: Lachish.

H3924.def: from the same as H3883 (לוּל); a loop KJV: loop.

H3925.def: a primitive root; properly, to goad, i.e. (by implication) to teach (the rod being an Oriental incentive) KJV: (un-) accustomed, [idiom] diligently, expert, instruct, learn, skilful, teach(-er, -ing).

H3926.def: a prolonged and separable form of the prepositional prefix; to or for KJV: at, for, to, upon.

H3927.gloss: Lemuel or Lemoel, a symbolic name of Solomon
H3927.def: or לְמוֹאֵל; from H3926 (לְמוֹ) and H410 (אֵל); (belonging) to God; Lemuel or Lemoel, a symbolic name of Solomon KJV: Lemuel.

H3928.def: or לִמֻּד; from H3925 (לָמַד); instructed KJV: accustomed, disciple, learned, taught, used.

H3929.gloss: Lemek, the name of two antediluvian patriarchs
H3929.def: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Lemek, the name of two antediluvian patriarchs KJV: Lamech.

H3930.def: from H3886 (לוּעַ); the gullet KJV: throat.

H3931.def: a primitive root; to deride KJV: mock.

H3932.def: a primitive root; to deride; by implication (as if imitating a foreigner) to speak unintelligibly KJV: have in derision, laugh (to scorn), mock (on), stammering.

H3933.def: from H3932 (לָעַג); derision, scoffing KJV: derision, scorn (-ing).

H3934.def: from H3932 (לָעַג); a buffoon; also a foreigner KJV: mocker, stammering.

H3935.def: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Ladah, an Israelite KJV: Laadah.

H3936.gloss: Ladan, the name of two Israelites
H3936.def: from the same as H3935 (לַעְדָּה); Ladan, the name of two Israelites KJV: Laadan.

H3937.gloss: to speak in a foreign tongue
H3937.def: a primitive root; to speak in a foreign tongue KJV: strange language.

H3938.def: a primitive root; to swallow greedily; causatively, to feed KJV: feed.

H3939.gloss: wormwood (regarded as poisonous, and therefore accursed)
H3939.def: from an unused root supposed to mean to curse; wormwood (regarded as poisonous, and therefore accursed) KJV: hemlock, wormwood.

H3940.def: or לַפִּד; from an unused root probably meaning to shine; a flambeau, lamp or flame KJV: (fire-) brand, (burning) lamp, lightning, torch.

H3941.def: feminine plural of H3940 (לַפִּיד); Lappidoth, the husband of Deborah KJV: Lappidoth.

H3942.def: from the prepositional prefix (to or for) and H6440 (פָּנִים); anterior KJV: before.

H3943.def: a primitive root; properly, to bend, i.e. (by implication) to clasp; also (reflexively) to turn around or aside KJV: take hold, turn aside (self).

H3945.def: a primitive root; to deride KJV: scorn.

H3946.def: from an unused root thought to mean to stop up by a barricade; perhaps fortification; Lakkum, a place in Palestine KJV: Lakum.

H3947.gloss: to take (in the widest variety of applications)
H3947.def: a primitive root; to take (in the widest variety of applications) KJV: accept, bring, buy, carry away, drawn, fetch, get, infold, [idiom] many, mingle, place, receive(-ing), reserve, seize, send for, take (away, -ing, up), use, win.

H3948.def: from H3947 (לָקַח); properly, something received, i.e. (mentally) instruction (whether on the part of the teacher or hearer); also (in an active and sinister sense) inveiglement KJV: doctrine, learning, fair speech.

H3949.def: from H3947 (לָקַח); learned; Likchi, an Israelite KJV: Likhi.

H3950.def: a primitive root; properly, to pick up, i.e. (generally) to gather; specifically, to glean KJV: gather (up), glean.

H3951.def: from H3950 (לָקַט); the gleaning KJV: gleaning.

H3952.def: a primitive root; to lick or lap KJV: lap, lick.

H3953.def: a primitive root; to gather the after crop KJV: gather.

H3954.def: from H3953 (לָקַשׁ); the after crop KJV: latter growth.

H3955.def: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; apparently juice, i.e. (figuratively) vigor; also a sweet or fat cake KJV: fresh, moisture.

H3956.gloss: the tongue (of man or animals), used literally (as the instrument of licking, eating, or speech), and figuratively (speech, an ingot, a fork of flame, a cove of water)
H3956.def: or לָשֹׁן; also (in plural) feminine לְשֹׁנָה; from H3960 (לָשַׁן); the tongue (of man or animals), used literally (as the instrument of licking, eating, or speech), and figuratively (speech, an ingot, a fork of flame, a cove of water) KJV: [phrase] babbler, bay, [phrase] evil speaker, language, talker, tongue, wedge.

H3957.gloss: a room in a building (whether for storage, eating, or lodging)
H3957.def: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a room in a building (whether for storage, eating, or lodging) KJV: chamber, parlour. Compare H5393 (נִשְׁכָּה).

H3958.def: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a gem, perhaps the jacinth KJV: ligure.

H3959.def: the same as H3958 (לֶשֶׁם); Leshem, a place in Palestine KJV: Leshem.

H3960.def: a primitive root; properly, to lick; but used only as a denominative from H3956 (לָשׁוֹן); to wag the tongue, i.e. to calumniate KJV: accuse, slander.

H3961.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3956 (לָשׁוֹן); speech, i.e. a nation KJV: language.

H3962.gloss: Lesha, a place probably East of the Jordan
H3962.def: from an unused root thought to mean to break through; a boiling spring; Lesha, a place probably East of the Jordan KJV: Lasha.

H3963.def: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a measure for things dry KJV: half homer. m

H3964.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H4100 (מָה); (as indefinitely) that KJV: [phrase] what.

H3965.def: from H75 (אָבַס); a granary KJV: storehouse.

H3966.def: from the same as H181 (אוּד); properly, vehemence, i.e. (with or without preposition) vehemently; by implication, wholly, speedily, etc. (often with other words as an intensive or superlative; especially when repeated) KJV: diligently, especially, exceeding(-ly), far, fast, good, great(-ly), [idiom] louder and louder, might(-ily, -y), (so) much, quickly, (so) sore, utterly, very ([phrase] much, sore), well.

H3967.def: or מֵאיָה; properly, a primitive numeral a hundred; also as a multiplicative and a fraction KJV: hundred((-fold), -th), [phrase] sixscore.

H3968.def: the same as H3967 (מֵאָה); Meah, a tower in Jerusalem KJV: Meah.

H3969.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3967 (מֵאָה); properly, a primitive numeral a hundred; also as a multiplicative and a fraction} KJV: hundred.

H3970.def: from H183 (אָוָה); a desire KJV: desire.

H3971.def: usually מוּם; as if passive participle from an unused root probably meaning to stain; a blemish (physically or morally) KJV: blemish, blot, spot.

H3972.gloss: properly, a speck or point, i
H3972.def: apparently a form of H3971 (מאוּם); properly, a speck or point, i.e. (by implication) something; with negative, nothing KJV: fault, [phrase] no(-ught), ought, somewhat, any (no-)thing.

H3974.gloss: properly, a luminous body or luminary, i
H3974.def: or מָאֹר; also (in plural) feminine מְאוֹרָה; or מְאֹרָה; from H215 (אוֹר); properly, a luminous body or luminary, i.e. (abstractly) light (as an element); figuratively, brightness, i.e.cheerfulness; specifically, a chandelier KJV: bright, light.

H3975.def: feminine passive participle of H215 (אוֹר); something lighted, i.e. an aperture; by implication, a crevice or hole (of a serpent) KJV: den.

H3976.gloss: (only in the dual) a pair of scales
H3976.def: from H239 (אָזַן); (only in the dual) a pair of scales KJV: balances.

H3977.gloss: {(only in the dual) a pair of scales}
H3977.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3976 (מֹאזֵן) {(only in the dual) a pair of scales} KJV: balances.

H3978.def: from H398 (אָכַל); an eatable (includ. provender, flesh and fruit) KJV: food, fruit, (bake-)meat(-s), victual.

H3979.def: from H398 (אָכַל); something to eat with,i.e. a knife KJV: knife.

H3980.def: from H398 (אָכַל); something eaten (by fire), i.e. fuel KJV: fuel.

H3981.def: from H553 (אָמַץ); strength, i.e. (plural) resources KJV: force.

H3982.def: from H559 (אָמַר); something (authoritatively) said, i.e. an edict KJV: commandment, decree.

H3983.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3982 (מַאֲמַר) {something (authoritatively) said, i.e. an edict} KJV: appointment, word.

H3984.def: (Aramaic) probably from a root corresponding to H579 (אָנָה) in the sense of an inclosure by sides; a utensil KJV: vessel.

H3985.def: a primitive root; to refuse KJV: refuse, [idiom] utterly.

H3988.def: a primitive root; to spurn; also (intransitively) to disappear KJV: abhor, cast away (off), contemn, despise, disdain, (become) loathe(some), melt away, refuse, reject, reprobate, [idiom] utterly, vile person.

H3989.def: from H644 (אָפָה); something baked, i.e. a batch KJV: baken.

H3990.def: from the same as H651 (אָפֵל); something opaque KJV: darkness.

H3991.def: prolonged feminine of H3990 (מַאֲפֵל); opaqueness KJV: darkness.

H3992.gloss: to be bitter or (causatively) to embitter, i
H3992.def: a primitive root; to be bitter or (causatively) to embitter, i.e. be painful KJV: fretting, picking.

H3993.def: from H693 (אָרַב); an ambuscade KJV: lie in ambush, ambushment, lurking place, lying in wait.

H3994.def: from H779 (אָרַר); an execration KJV: curse.

H3995.def: from H914 (בָּדַל); a separation, i.e. (concretely) a separate place KJV: separate.

H3996.gloss: an entrance (the place or the act)
H3996.def: from H935 (בּוֹא); (with or without H8121 (שֶׁמֶשׁ)) an entrance (the place or the act); specifically sunset or the west; also (adverb with preposition) towards KJV: by which came, as cometh, in coming, as men enter into, entering, entrance into, entry, where goeth, going down, [phrase] westward. Compare H4126 (מוֹבָא).

H3997.def: feminine of H3996 (מָבוֹא); a haven KJV: entry.

H3999.def: from H2986 (יָבַל) in the sense of flowing; a deluge KJV: flood.

H4001.def: from H947 (בּוּס); a trampling KJV: treading (trodden) down (under foot).

H4002.def: from H5042 (נָבַע); a fountain KJV: fountain, spring.

H4003.def: from the same as H950 (בּוּקָה); emptiness KJV: void.

H4004.def: from H977 (בָּחַר); select, i.e. well fortified KJV: choice.

H4005.def: from H977 (בָּחַר); select, i.e. best KJV: choice(-st), chosen.

H4006.def: the same as H4005 (מִבְחָר); Mibchar, an Israelite KJV: Mibhar.

H4007.def: or מֶבָּט; from H5027 (נָבַט); something expected, i.e. (abstractly) expectation KJV: expectation.

H4008.def: from H981 (בָּטָא); a rash utterance (hasty vow) KJV: (that which...) uttered (out of).

H4009.def: from H982 (בָּטַח); properly, a refuge, i.e. (objective) security, or (subjective) assurance KJV: confidence, hope, sure, trust.

H4010.def: from H1082 (בָּלַג); desistance (or rather desolation) KJV: comfort self.

H4011.def: from H1129 (בָּנָה); a building KJV: frame.

H4012.def: from H1129 (בָּנָה); built up; Mebunnai, an Israelite KJV: Mebunnai.

H4013.gloss: a fortification, castle, or fortified city
H4013.def: also (in plural) feminine (Daniel 11:l5) מִבְצָרָה; from H1219 (בָּצַר); a fortification, castle, or fortified city; figuratively, a defender KJV: (de-, most) fenced, fortress, (most) strong (hold).

H4014.def: the same as H4013 (מִבְצָר); Mibtsar, an Idumaean KJV: Mibzar.

H4015.def: from H1272 (בָּרַח); a refugee KJV: fugitive.

H4016.def: from H954 (בּוּשׁ); (plural) the (male) pudenda KJV: secrets.

H4017.gloss: Mibsam, the name of an Ishmaelite and of an Israelite
H4017.def: from the same as H1314 (בֶּשֶׂם); fragrant; Mibsam, the name of an Ishmaelite and of an Israelite KJV: Mibsam.

H4018.def: from H1310 (בָּשַׁל); a cooking hearth KJV: boiling-place.

H4019.gloss: Magbish, an Israelite, or a place in Palestine
H4019.def: from the same as H1378 (גָּבִישׁ); stiffening; Magbish, an Israelite, or a place in Palestine KJV: Magbish.

H4020.def: from H1379 (גָּבַל); a border KJV: end.

H4021.def: from the same as H1389 (גִּבְעָה); a cap (as hemispherical) KJV: bonnet.

H4022.def: from an unused root probably meaning to be eminent; properly, a distinguished thing; hence something valuable, as aproduct or fruit KJV: pleasant, precious fruit (thing).

H4023.gloss: Megiddon or Megiddo, a place in Palestine
H4023.def: (Zechariah H12 (אַבְדָן)) or מְגִדּוֹ; from H1413 (גָּדַד); rendezvous; Megiddon or Megiddo, a place in Palestine KJV: Megiddo, Megiddon.

H4024.def: or מִגְדֹּל; probably of Egyptian origin; Migdol, a place in Egypt KJV: Migdol, tower.

H4025.def: from H4022 (מֶגֶד) and H410 (אֵל); preciousness of God; Magdiel, an Idumaean KJV: Magdiel.

H4026.gloss: a tower (from its size or height)
H4026.def: also (in plural) feminine מִגְדָּלָה; from H1431 (גָּדַל); a tower (from its size or height); by analogy, a rostrum; figuratively, a (pyramidal) bed of flowers KJV: castle, flower, tower. Compare the names following.

H4027.def: from H4026 (מִגְדָּל) and H410 (אֵל); tower of God; Migdal-El, a place in Palestine KJV: Migdal-el.

H4028.def: from H4026 (מִגְדָּל) and H1408 (גַּד); tower of Fortune; Migdal-Gad, a place in Palestine KJV: Migdal-gad.

H4029.def: from H4026 (מִגְדָּל) and H5739 (עֵדֶר); tower of a flock; Migdal-Eder, a place in Palestine KJV: Migdal-eder, tower of the flock.

H4030.def: from the same as H4022 (מֶגֶד); preciousness, i.e. a gem KJV: precious thing, present.

H4031.def: from H1463 (גּוֹג); Magog, a son of Japheth; also a barbarous northern region KJV: Magog.

H4032.def: or (Lamentations 2:22) מָגוּר; from H1481 (גּוּר) in the sense of fearing; a fright (objective or subjective) KJV: fear, terror. Compare H4036 (מָגוֹר מִסָּבִיב).

H4033.def: or מָגֻר; from H1481 (גּוּר) in the sense of lodging; a temporary abode; by extension, a permanent residence KJV: dwelling, pilgrimage, where sojourn, be a stranger. Compare H4032 (מָגוֹר).

H4034.def: feminine of H4032 (מָגוֹר); affright KJV: fear.

H4035.def: feminine of H4032 (מָגוֹר) or of H4033 (מָגוּר); a fright; also a granary KJV: barn, fear.

H4036.gloss: Magor-mis-Sabib, a symbolic name of Pashur
H4036.def: from H4032 (מָגוֹר) and H5439 (סָבִיב) with the preposition inserted; affright from around; Magor-mis-Sabib, a symbolic name of Pashur KJV: Magormissabib.

H4037.def: from H1504 (גָּזַר); a cutting implement, i.e. a blade KJV: axe.

H4038.def: from an unused root meaning to reap; a sickle KJV: sickle.

H4039.def: from H1556 (גָּלַל); a roll KJV: roll, volume.

H4040.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H4039 (מְגִלָּה) {a roll} KJV: roll.

H4041.def: from the same as H1571 (גַּם); properly, accumulation, i.e. impulse or direction KJV: sup up.

H4042.def: a denominative from H4043 (מָגֵן); properly, to shield; encompass with; figuratively, to rescue, to hand safely over (i.e. surrender) KJV: deliver.

H4043.def: also (in plural) feminine מְגִנָּה; from H1598 (גָּנַן); a shield (i.e. the small one or buckler); figuratively, a protector; also the scaly hide of the crocodile KJV: [idiom] armed, buckler, defence, ruler, [phrase] scale, shield.

H4044.gloss: a covering (in a bad sense), i
H4044.def: from H4042 (מָגַן); a covering (in a bad sense), i.e. blindness or obduracy KJV: sorrow. See also H4043 (מָגֵן).

H4045.def: from H1605 (גָּעַר); reproof (i.e. curse) KJV: rebuke.

H4046.def: from H5062 (נָגַף); a pestilence; by analogy, defeat KJV: ([idiom] be) plague(-d), slaughter, stroke.

H4653.def: from H6385 (פָּלַג); a classification KJV: division.

H4654.def: or מַפֵּלָה; from H5307 (נָפַל); something fallen, i.e. a ruin KJV: ruin(-ous).

H4659.def: or (feminine) מִפְעָלָה; from H6466 (פָּעַל); a performance KJV: work.

H4745.def: from H7136 (קָרָה); something met with, i.e. an accident or fortune KJV: something befallen, befalleth, chance, event, hap(-peneth).
