H5066.def: a primitive root; to be or come (causatively, bring) near (for any purpose); euphemistically, to lie with a woman; as an enemy, to attack; religious to worship; causatively, to present; figuratively, to adduce an argument; by reversal, to stand back KJV: (make to) approach (nigh), bring (forth, hither, near), (cause to) come (hither, near, nigh), give place, go hard (up), (be, draw, go) near (nigh), offer, overtake, present, put, stand.

H5067.def: from H5110 (נוּד) in the sense of piling up; a mound, i.e. wave KJV: heap.

H5068.def: a primitive root; to impel; hence, to volunteer (as a soldier), to present spontaneously KJV: offer freely, be (give, make, offer self) willing(-ly).

H5069.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H5068 (נָדַב); be (or give) liberal(-ly) KJV: (be minded of...own) freewill (offering), offer freely (willingly).

H5070.gloss: Nadab, the name of four Israelites
H5070.def: from H5068 (נָדַב); liberal; Nadab, the name of four Israelites KJV: Nadab.

H5071.def: from H5068 (נָדַב); properly (abstractly) spontaneity, or (adjectively) spontaneous; also (concretely) a spontaneous or (by inference, in plural) abundant gift KJV: free(-will) offering, freely, plentiful, voluntary(-ily, offering), willing(-ly), offering).

H5072.def: from H5068 (נָדַב) and H3050 (יָהּ); largess of Jah; Nedabjah, an Israelite KJV: Nedabiah.

H5073.def: (Aramaic) from a root meaning to stick; a layer (of building materials) KJV: row.

H5074.gloss: properly, to wave to and fro (rarely to flap up and down)
H5074.def: a primitive root; properly, to wave to and fro (rarely to flap up and down); figuratively, to rove, flee, or (causatively) to drive away KJV: chase (away), [idiom] could not, depart, flee ([idiom] apace, away), (re-) move, thrust away, wander (abroad, -er, -ing).

H5075.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H5074 (נָדַד); to depart KJV: go from.

H5076.def: passive participle of H5074 (נָדַד); properly, tossed; abstractly, a rolling (on the bed) KJV: tossing to and fro.

H5077.def: or נָדָא; (2 Kings 17:21), a primitive root; properly, to toss; figuratively, to exclude, i.e. banish, postpone, prohibit KJV: cast out, drive, put far away.

H5078.def: from H5077 (נָדָה) in the sense of freely flinging money; a bounty (for prostitution) KJV: gifts.

H5079.def: from H5074 (נָדַד); properly, rejection; by implication, impurity, especially personal (menstruation) or moral (idolatry, incest) KJV: [idiom] far, filthiness, [idiom] flowers, menstruous (woman), put apart, [idiom] removed (woman), separation, set apart, unclean(-ness, thing, with filthiness).

H5080.def: a primitive root; to push off; used in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (to expel, mislead, strike, inflict, etc.) KJV: banish, bring, cast down (out), chase, compel, draw away, drive (away, out, quite), fetch a stroke, force, go away, outcast, thrust away (out), withdraw.

H5081.def: from H5068 (נָדַב); properly, voluntary, i.e. generous; hence, magnanimous; as noun, a grandee (sometimes a tyrant) KJV: free, liberal (things), noble, prince, willing (hearted).

H5082.def: feminine of H5081 (נָדִיב); properly, nobility, i.e. reputation KJV: soul.

H5083.def: probably from an unused root meaning to give; a present (for prostitution) KJV: gift.

H5084.def: of uncertain derivation; a sheath (of a sword) KJV: sheath.

H5085.def: (Aramaic) from the same as H5084 (נָדָן); a sheath; figuratively, the body (as the receptacle of the soul) KJV: body.

H5086.def: a primitive root; to shove asunder, i.e. disperse KJV: drive (away, to and fro), thrust down, shaken, tossed to and fro.

H5087.def: a primitive root; to promise (pos., to do or give something to God) KJV: (make a) vow.

H5088.def: or נֵדֶר; from H5087 (נָדַר); a promise (to God); also (concretely) a thing promised KJV: vow(-ed).

H5089.def: from an unused root meaning to lament; lamentation KJV: wailing.

H5090.gloss: to drive forth (a person, an animal or chariot), i
H5090.def: a primitive root; to drive forth (a person, an animal or chariot), i.e. lead, carry away; reflexively, to proceed (i.e. impel or guide oneself); also (from the panting induced by effort), to sigh KJV: acquaint, bring (away), carry away, drive (away), lead (away, forth), (be) guide, lead (away, forth).

H5091.def: a primitive root; to groan, i.e. bewail; hence (through the idea of crying aloud), to assemble (as if on proclamation) KJV: lament, wail.

H5092.def: from H5091 (נָהָה); an elegy KJV: lamentation, wailing.

H5093.def: feminine of H5092 (נְהִי); lamentation KJV: doleful.

H5094.def: (Aramaic) or נְהִירוּ; (Aramaic), from the same as H5105 (נְהָרָה); illumination, i.e. (figuratively) wisdom KJV: light.

H5095.gloss: properly, to run with asparkle, i
H5095.def: a primitive root; properly, to run with asparkle, i.e. flow; hence (transitively), to conduct, and (by inference) to protect, sustain KJV: carry, feed, guide, lead (gently, on).

H5096.gloss: Nahalal or Nahalol, a place in Palestine
H5096.def: or נַהֲלֹל; the same as H5097 (נַהֲלֹל); Nahalal or Nahalol, a place in Palestine KJV: Nahalal, Nahallal, Nahalol.

H5098.def: a primitive root; to growl KJV: mourn, roar(-ing).

H5099.def: from H5098 (נָהַם); a snarl KJV: roaring.

H5100.def: feminine of H5099 (נַהַם); snarling KJV: disquietness, roaring.

H5101.gloss: to bray (as an ass), scream (from hunger)
H5101.def: a primitive root; to bray (as an ass), scream (from hunger) KJV: bray.

H5102.def: a primitive root; to sparkle, i.e. (figuratively) be cheerful; hence (from the sheen of a running stream) to flow, i.e. (figuratively) assemble KJV: flow (together), be lightened.

H5103.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H5102 (נָהַר); a river, especially the Euphrates KJV: river, stream.

H5104.def: from H5102 (נָהַר); a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile, Euphrates, etc.); figuratively, prosperity KJV: flood, river.

H5105.def: from H5102 (נָהַר) in its original sense; daylight KJV: light.

H5106.gloss: to refuse, forbid, dissuade, or neutralize
H5106.def: a primitive root; to refuse, forbid, dissuade, or neutralize KJV: break, disallow, discourage, make of none effect.

H5107.def: a primitive root; to germinate, i.e. (figuratively) to (causatively, make) flourish; also (of words), to utter KJV: bring forth (fruit), make cheerful, increase.

H5108.def: or נֵיב; from H5107 (נוּב); produce, literally or figuratively KJV: fruit.

H5109.def: from H5108 (נוֹב); fruitful; Nobai, an Israelite KJV: Nebai (from the margin).

H5110.def: a primitive root; to nod, i.e. waver; figuratively, to wander, flee, disappear; also (from shaking the head in sympathy), to console, deplore, or (from tossing the head in scorn) taunt KJV: bemoan, flee, get, mourn, make to move, take pity, remove, shake, skip for joy, be sorry, vagabond, way, wandering.

H5111.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H5116 (נָוֶה); to flee KJV: get away.

H5112.def: (only defective נֹד ); from H5110 (נוּד); exile KJV: wandering.

H5113.def: the same as H5112 (נוֹד)lemma נוֹדּ extra dagesh, corrected to נוֹד; vagrancy; Nod, the land of Cain KJV: Nod.

H5114.def: from H5068 (נָדַב); noble; Nodab, an Arab tribe KJV: Nodab.

H5115.def: a primitive root; (compare H5116 (נָוֶה)) to rest (as at home); causatively (through the implied idea of beauty ), to celebrate (with praises) KJV: keept at home, prepare an habitation.

H5116.def: or (feminine) נָוָה; from H5115 (נָוָה); (adjectively) at home; hence (by implication of satisfaction) lovely; also (noun) a home, of God (temple), men (residence), flocks (pasture), or wild animals (den) KJV: comely, dwelling (place), fold, habitation, pleasant place, sheepcote, stable, tarried.

H5117.def: a primitive root; to rest, i.e. settle down; used in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, intransitive, transitive and causative (to dwell, stay, let fall, place, let alone, withdraw, give comfort, etc.) KJV: cease, be confederate, lay, let down, (be) quiet, remain, (cause to, be at, give, have, make to) rest, set down. Compare H3241 (יָנִים).

H5118.def: or נוֹחַ; from H5117 (נוּחַ); quiet KJV: rest(-ed, -ing place).

H5119.def: feminine of H5118 (נוּחַ); quietude; Nochah, an Israelite KJV: Nohah.

H5121.def: from H5115 (נָוָה); residence; Navith, a place in Palestine KJV: Naioth (from the margin).

H5122.def: (Aramaic) or נְוָלִי; (Aramaic), from an unused root probably meaning to be foul; a sink KJV: dunghill.

H5123.def: a primitive root; to slumber (from drowsiness) KJV: sleep, slumber.

H5125.def: a primitive root; to resprout, i.e. propagate by shoots; figuratively, to be perpetual KJV: be continued.

H5126.gloss: Nun or Non, the father of Joshua
H5126.def: or נוֹן; (1 Chronicles 7:27), from H5125 (נוּן); perpetuity, Nun or Non, the father of Joshua KJV: Non, Nun.

H5127.def: a primitive root; to flit, i.e. vanish away (subside, escape; causatively, chase, impel, deliver) KJV: [idiom] abate, away, be displayed, (make to) flee (away, -ing), put to flight, [idiom] hide, lift up a standard.

H5128.gloss: to waver, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (as subjoined)
H5128.def: a primitive root; to waver, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (as subjoined) KJV: continually, fugitive, [idiom] make, to (go) up and down, be gone away, (be) move(-able, -d), be promoted, reel, remove, scatter, set, shake, sift, stagger, to and fro, be vagabond, wag, (make) wander (up and down).

H5129.gloss: Noadjah, the name of an Israelite, and a false prophetess
H5129.def: from H3259 (יָעַד) and H3050 (יָהּ); convened of Jah; Noadjah, the name of an Israelite, and a false prophetess KJV: Noadiah.

H5130.def: a primitive root; to quiver (i.e. vibrate up and down, or rock to and fro); used in a great variety of applications (including sprinkling, beckoning, rubbing, bastinadoing, sawing, waving, etc.) KJV: lift up, move, offer, perfume, send, shake, sift, strike, wave.

H5131.def: from H5130 (נוּף); elevation KJV: situation. Compare H5297 (נֹף).

H5132.def: a primitive root; properly, to flash; hence, to blossom (from the brilliancy of color); also, to fly away (from the quickness of motion) KJV: flee away, bud (forth).

H5133.def: or נֹצָה; feminine active participle of H5327 (נָצָה) in the sense of flying; a pinion (or wing feather); often (collectively) plumage KJV: feather(-s), ostrich.

H5134.def: a primitive root; to suckle KJV: nurse.

H5135.def: (Aramaic) from an unused root (corresponding to that of H5216 (נִיר)) meaning to shine; fire KJV: fiery, fire.

H5136.def: a primitive root; to be sick, i.e. (figuratively) distressed KJV: be full of heaviness.

H5137.def: a primitive root; to spirt, i.e. besprinkle (especially in expiation) KJV: sprinkle.

H5138.def: from H2102 (זוּד); something boiled, i.e. soup KJV: pottage.

H5139.def: or נָזִר; from H5144 (נָזַר); separate, i.e. consecrated (as prince, a Nazirite); hence (figuratively from the latter) an unpruned vine (like an unshorn Nazirite) KJV: Nazarite (by a false alliteration with Nazareth), separate(-d), vine undressed.

H5140.gloss: to drip, or shed by trickling
H5140.def: a primitive root; to drip, or shed by trickling KJV: distil, drop, flood, (cause to) flow(-ing), gush out, melt, pour (down), running water, stream.

H5141.def: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a nose-ring KJV: earring, jewel.

H5142.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to the root of H5143 (נֵזֶק); to suffer (causatively, inflict) loss KJV: have (en-) damage, hurt(-ful).

H5143.def: from an unused root meaning to injure; loss KJV: damage.

H5144.def: a primitive root; to hold aloof, i.e. (intransitivey) abstain (from food and drink, from impurity, and even from divine worship (i.e. apostatize)); specifically, to set apart (to sacred purposes), i.e. devote KJV: consecrate, separate(-ing, self).

H5145.def: or נֵזֶר; from H5144 (נָזַר); properly, something set apart, i.e. (abstractly) dedication (of a priet or Nazirite); hence (concretely) unshorn locks; also (by implication) a chaplet (especially of royalty) KJV: consecration, crown, hair, separation.

H5146.gloss: Noach, the patriarch of the flood
H5146.def: the same as H5118 (נוּחַ); rest; Noach, the patriarch of the flood KJV: Noah.

H5147.def: from H2247 (חָבָה); occult; Nachbi, an Israelite KJV: Nakbi.

H5148.def: a primitive root; to guide; by implication, to transport (into exile, or as colonists) KJV: bestow, bring, govern, guide, lead (forth), put, straiten.

H5149.def: from H5162 (נָחַם); comforted; Nechum, an Israelite KJV: Nehum.

H5150.def: or נִחֻם; from H5162 (נָחַם); properly, consoled; abstractly, solace KJV: comfort(-able), repenting.

H5151.def: from H5162 (נָחַם); comfortable; Nachum, an Israelite prophet KJV: Nahum.

H5152.gloss: Nochor, the name of the grandfather and a brother of Abraham
H5152.def: from the same as H5170 (נַחַר); snorer; Nochor, the name of the grandfather and a brother of Abraham KJV: Nahor.

H5153.def: apparently passive participle of H5172 (נָחַשׁ) (perhaps in the sense of ringing), i.e. bell-metal; or from the red color of the throat of a serpent (H5175 (נָחָשׁ), as denominative) when hissing); coppery, i.e. (figuratively) hard KJV: of brass.

H5154.def: or נְחֻשָׁה; feminine of H5153 (נָחוּשׁ); copper KJV: brass, steel. Compare H5176 (נָחָשׁ).

H5155.def: probably denominative from H2485 (חָלִיל); a flute KJV: (plural) Nehiloth.

H5156.def: from the same as H5170 (נַחַר); a nostril KJV: (dual) nostrils.

H5157.gloss: to inherit (as a (figurative) mode of descent), or (generally) to occupy
H5157.def: a primitive root; to inherit (as a (figurative) mode of descent), or (generally) to occupy; causatively, to bequeath, or (generally) distribute, instate KJV: divide, have (inheritance), take as a heritage, (cause to, give to, make to) inherit, (distribute for, divide (for, for an, by), give for, have, leave for, take (for)) inheritance, (have in, cause to, be made to) possess(-ion).

H5158.gloss: a stream, especially a winter torrent
H5158.def: or (feminine) נַחְלָה; (Psalm 124:4), or נַחֲלָה; (Ezekiel 47:19; Ezekiel 48:28), from H5157 (נָחַל) in its original sense; a stream, especially a winter torrent; (by implication) a (narrow) valley (in which a brook runs); also a shaft (of a mine) KJV: brook, flood, river, stream, valley.

H5159.def: from H5157 (נָחַל) (in its usual sense); properly, something inherited, i.e. (abstractly) occupancy, or (concretely) an heirloom; generally an estate, patrimony or portion KJV: heritage, to inherit, inheritance, possession. Compare H5158 (נַחַל).

H5160.gloss: Nachaliel, a place in the Desert
H5160.def: from H5158 (נַחַל) and H410 (אֵל); valley of God; Nachaliel, a place in the Desert KJV: Nahaliel.

H5161.gloss: a Nechelamite, or descendant of Nechlam
H5161.def: apparently a patronymic from an unused name (apparently passive participle of H2492 (חָלַם)); dreamed; a Nechelamite, or descendant of Nechlam KJV: Nehelamite.

H5162.def: a primitive root; properly, to sigh, i.e. breathe strongly; by implication, to be sorry, i.e. (in a favorable sense) to pity, console or (reflexively) rue; or (unfavorably) to avenge (oneself) KJV: comfort (self), ease (one's self), repent(-er,-ing, self).

H5163.def: from H5162 (נָחַם); consolation; Nacham, an Israelite KJV: Naham.

H5164.def: from H5162 (נָחַם); ruefulness, i.e. desistance KJV: repentance.

H5166.gloss: Nechemjah, the name of three Israelites
H5166.def: from H5162 (נָחַם) and H3050 (יָהּ); consolation of Jah; Nechemjah, the name of three Israelites KJV: Nehemiah.

H5167.def: from H5162 (נָחַם); consolatory; Nachamani, an Israelite KJV: Nahamani.

H5169.def: a primitive root; to be urgent KJV: require haste.

H5170.def: and (feminine) נַחֲרָה; from an unused root meaning to snort or snore; a snorting KJV: nostrils, snorting.

H5171.def: or נַחְרַי; from the same as H5170 (נַחַר); snorer; Nacharai or Nachrai, an Israelite KJV: Naharai, Nahari.

H5172.def: a primitive root; properly, to hiss, i.e. whisper a (magic) spell; generally, to prognosticate KJV: [idiom] certainly, divine, enchanter, (use) [idiom] enchantment, learn by experience, [idiom] indeed, diligently observe.

H5173.def: from H5172 (נָחַשׁ); an incantation or augury KJV: enchantment.

H5174.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H5154 (נְחוּשָׁה); copper KJV: brass.

H5175.def: from H5172 (נָחַשׁ); a snake (from its hiss) KJV: serpent.

H5176.gloss: Nachash, the name of two persons apparently non-Israelite
H5176.def: the same as H5175 (נָחָשׁ); Nachash, the name of two persons apparently non-Israelite KJV: Nahash.

H5177.def: from H5172 (נָחַשׁ); enchanter; Nachshon, an Israelite KJV: Naashon, Nahshon.

H5178.gloss: copper, hence, something made of that metal, i
H5178.def: for H5154 (נְחוּשָׁה); copper, hence, something made of that metal, i.e. coin, a fetter; figuratively, base (as compared with gold or silver) KJV: brasen, brass, chain, copper, fetter (of brass), filthiness, steel.

H5179.def: from H5178 (נְחֹשֶׁת); copper; Nechushta, an Israelitess KJV: Nehushta.

H5180.def: from H5178 (נְחֹשֶׁת); something made of copper, i.e. the copper serpent of the Desert KJV: Nehushtan.

H5181.def: a primitive root; to sink, i.e. descend; causatively, to press or lead down KJV: be broken, (cause to) come down, enter, go down, press sore, settle, stick fast.

H5182.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H5181 (נָחַת); to descend; causatively, to bring away, deposit, depose KJV: carry, come down, depose, lay up, place.

H5183.def: from H5182 (נְחַת); also (intransitively; perhaps from H5117 (נוּחַ)) a descent, i.e. imposition, unfavorable (punishment) or favorable (food); restfulness KJV: lighting down, quiet(-ness), to rest, be set on.

H5184.gloss: Nachath, the name of an Edomite and of two Israelites
H5184.def: the same as H5183 (נַחַת); quiet; Nachath, the name of an Edomite and of two Israelites KJV: Nahath.

H5185.def: from H5181 (נָחַת); descending KJV: come down.

H5186.def: a primitive root; to stretch or spread out; by implication, to bend away (including moral deflection); used in a great variety of application KJV: [phrase] afternoon, apply, bow (down, -ing), carry aside, decline, deliver, extend, go down, be gone, incline, intend, lay, let down, offer, outstretched, overthrown, pervert, pitch, prolong, put away, shew, spread (out), stretch (forth, out), take (aside), turn (aside, away), wrest, cause to yield.

H5187.def: from H5190 (נָטַל); laden KJV: that bear.

H5188.gloss: a pendant for the ears (especially of pearls)
H5188.def: from H5197 (נָטַף); a pendant for the ears (especially of pearls) KJV: chain, collar.

H5189.def: from H5203 (נָטַשׁ); a tendril (as an offshoot) KJV: battlement, branch, plant.

H5190.def: a primitive root; to lift; by implication, to impose KJV: bear, offer, take up.

H5191.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H5190 (נָטַל); to raise KJV: take up.

H5192.def: ; from H5190 (נָטַל); a burden KJV: weighty.

H5193.def: a primitive root; properly, to strike in, i.e. fix; specifically, to plant (literally or figuratively) KJV: fastened, plant(-er).

H5194.def: from H5193 (נָטַע); a plant; collectively, a plantation; abstractly, a planting KJV: plant.

H5195.def: from H5193 (נָטַע); a plant KJV: plant.

H5196.def: plural of H5194 (נֶטַע); Netaim, a place in Palestine KJV: plants.

H5197.def: a primitive root; to ooze, i.e. distil gradually; by implication, to fall in drops; figuratively, to speak by inspiration KJV: drop(-ping), prophesy(-et).

H5198.def: from H5197 (נָטַף); a drop; specifically, an aromatic gum (probably stacte) KJV: drop, stacte.

H5199.def: from H5197 (נָטַף); distillation; Netophah, a place in Palestine KJV: Netophah.

H5200.gloss: a Netophathite, or inhabitant of Netophah
H5200.def: patronymic from H5199 (נְטֹפָה); a Netophathite, or inhabitant of Netophah KJV: Netophathite.

H5201.def: a primitive root; to guard; figuratively, to cherish (anger) KJV: bear grudge, keep(-er), reserve.

H5202.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H5201 (נָטַר); to retain KJV: keep.

H5203.def: a primitive root; properly, to pound, i.e. smite; by implication (as if beating out, and thus expanding) to disperse; also, to thrust off, down, out or upon (inclusively, reject, let alone, permit, remit, etc.) KJV: cast off, drawn, let fall, forsake, join (battle), leave (off), lie still, loose, spread (self) abroad, stretch out, suffer.

H5204.def: a doubtful word; apparently from H5091 (נָהָה); lamentation KJV: wailing.

H5205.def: from H5110 (נוּד); motion (of the lips in speech) KJV: moving.

H5206.def: feminine of H5205 (נִיד); removal, i.e. exile KJV: removed.

H5207.def: or נִיחֹחַ; from H5117 (נוּחַ); properly, restful, i.e. pleasant; abstractly, delight KJV: sweet (odour).

H5208.def: (Aramaic) or נִיחֹחַ; (shorter) (Aramaic), corresponding to H5207 (נִיחוֹחַ); pleasure KJV: sweet odour (savour).

H5210.def: of foreign origin; Nineveh, the capital of Assyria KJV: Nineveh.

H5211.def: from H5127 (נוּס); fugitive KJV: that fleeth.

H5212.gloss: Nisan, the first month of the Jewish sacred year
H5212.def: probably of foreign origin; Nisan, the first month of the Jewish sacred year KJV: Nisan.

H5213.def: from H5340 (נָצַץ); a spark KJV: spark.

H5220.def: from an unused root meaning to propagate; offspring KJV: nephew, son's son.

H5222.def: from H5221 (נָכָה); a smiter, i.e. (figuratively) traducer KJV: abject.

H5225.def: from H3559 (כּוּן); prepared; Nakon, probably an Israelite KJV: Nachon.

H5228.def: from the same as H5226 (נֵכַח); straightforward, i.e. (figuratively), equitable, correct, or (abstractly), integrity KJV: plain, right, uprightness.

H5229.def: feminine of H5228 (נָכֹחַ); properly, straightforwardness, i.e. (figuratively) integrity, or (concretely) a truth KJV: equity, right (thing), uprightness.

H5234.def: a primitive root; properly, to scrutinize, i.e. look intently at; hence (with recognition implied), to acknowledge, be acquainted with, care for, respect, revere, or (with suspicion implied), to disregard, ignore, be strange toward, reject, resign, dissimulate (as if ignorant or disowning) KJV: acknowledge, [idiom] could, deliver, discern, dissemble, estrange, feign self to be another, know, take knowledge (notice), perceive, regard, (have) respect, behave (make) self strange(-ly).

H5236.def: ' from H5234 (נָכַר); foreign, or (concretely) a foreigner, or (abstractly) heathendom KJV: alien, strange ([phrase] -er).

H5237.def: from H5235 (נֶכֶר) (second form); strange, in a variety of degrees and applications (foreign, non-relative, adulterous, different, wonderful) KJV: alien, foreigner, outlandish, strange(-r, woman).

H5238.def: probably for H5219 (נְכֹאת); spicery, i.e. (generally) valuables KJV: precious things.

H5241.gloss: Nemuel, the name of two Israelites

H5242.def: from H5241 (נְמוּאֵל); a Nemuelite, or descendant of Nemuel KJV: Nemuelite.

H5243.def: a primitive root; to become clipped or (specifically) circumcised KJV: (branch to) be cut down (off), circumcise.

H5244.gloss: an ant (probably from its almost bisected form)
H5244.def: feminine from H5243 (נָמַל); an ant (probably from its almost bisected form) KJV: ant.

H5252.def: feminine participle passive of H5437 (סָבַב); properly, an environment, i.e. circumstance or turn of affairs KJV: cause.

H5256.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H5255 (נָסַח) {to tear away} KJV: pull down.

H5258.gloss: to pour out, especially a libation, or to cast (metal)
H5258.def: a primitive root; to pour out, especially a libation, or to cast (metal); by analogy, to anoint aking KJV: cover, melt, offer, (cause to) pour (out), set (up).

H5267.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H5266 (נָסַק) {to go up} KJV: take up.

H5298.def: from an unused root probably meaning to spring forth; a sprout; Nepheg, the name of two Israelites KJV: Nepheg.

H5347.def: from H5344 (נָקַב); female (from the sexual form) KJV: female.

H5348.def: from an unused root meaning to mark (by puncturing or branding); spotted KJV: speckled.

H5351.def: feminine of H5348 (נָקֹד); a boss KJV: stud.

H7713.def: from an unused root meaning to regulate; a row, i.e. rank (of soldiers), story (of rooms) KJV: board, range.

H7715.gloss: {Shadrak, the Babylonian name of one of Daniel's companions}
H7715.def: (Aramaic) the same as H7714 (שַׁדְרַךְ) {Shadrak, the Babylonian name of one of Daniel's companions} KJV: Shadrach.

H7716.gloss: a member of a flock, i
H7716.def: or שֵׂי; probably from H7582 (שָׁאָה) through the idea of pushing out to graze; a member of a flock, i.e. a sheep or goat KJV: (lesser, small) cattle, ewe, goat, lamb, sheep. Compare H2089 (זֶה).

H7717.def: from an unused root meaning to testify; a witness KJV: record.

H7718.gloss: a gem, probably the beryl (from its pale green color)
H7718.def: from an unused root probably mean to blanch; a gem, probably the beryl (from its pale green color) KJV: onyx.

H7719.def: the same as H7718 (שֹׁהַם); Shoham, an Israelite KJV: Shoham.

H7720.gloss: a round pendant for the neck
H7720.def: from the same as H5469 (סַהַר); a round pendant for the neck KJV: ornament, round tire like the moon.

H7721.def: from an unused root (akin to H5375 (נָשָׂא) and H7722 (שׁוֹא)) meaning to rise; a rising KJV: arise.

H7722.def: or (feminine) שׁוֹאָה; or שֹׁאָה; from an unused root meaning to rush over; a tempest; by implication, devastation KJV: desolate(-ion), destroy, destruction, storm, wasteness.

H7723.gloss: evil (as destructive), literally (ruin) or morally (especially guile)
H7723.def: or שַׁו; from the same as H7722 (שׁוֹא) in the sense of desolating; evil (as destructive), literally (ruin) or morally (especially guile); figuratively idolatry (as false, subjective), uselessness (as deceptive, objective; also adverbially, in vain) KJV: false(-ly), lie, lying, vain, vanity.

H7724.def: from the same as H7723 (שָׁוְא); false; Sheva, an Israelite KJV: Sheva.

H7725.gloss: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point)
H7725.def: a primitive root; to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again KJV: ((break, build, circumcise, dig, do anything, do evil, feed, lay down, lie down, lodge, make, rejoice, send, take, weep)) [idiom] again, (cause to) answer ([phrase] again), [idiom] in any case (wise), [idiom] at all, averse, bring (again, back, home again), call (to mind), carry again (back), cease, [idiom] certainly, come again (back), [idiom] consider, [phrase] continually, convert, deliver (again), [phrase] deny, draw back, fetch home again, [idiom] fro, get (oneself) (back) again, [idiom] give (again), go again (back, home), (go) out, hinder, let, (see) more, [idiom] needs, be past, [idiom] pay, pervert, pull in again, put (again, up again), recall, recompense, recover, refresh, relieve, render (again), requite, rescue, restore, retrieve, (cause to, make to) return, reverse, reward, [phrase] say nay, send back, set again, slide back, still, [idiom] surely, take back (off), (cause to, make to) turn (again, self again, away, back, back again, backward, from, off), withdraw.

H7726.def: from H7725 (שׁוּב); apostate, i.e. idolatrous KJV: backsliding, frowardly, turn away (from margin).

H7727.gloss: Shobab, the name of two Israelites
H7727.def: the same as H7726 (שׁוֹבָב); rebellious; Shobab, the name of two Israelites KJV: Shobab.

H7728.def: from H7725 (שׁוּב); apostate, i.e. heathenish or (actually) heathen KJV: backsliding.

H7729.def: from H7725 (שׁוּב); a return KJV: returning.

H7730.def: for H5441 (סֹבֶךְ); a thicket, i.e. interlaced branches KJV: thick boughs.

H7731.def: perhaps for H7730 (שׂוֹבֶךְ); Shobak, a Syrian KJV: Shobach.

H7732.gloss: Shobal, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites
H7732.def: from the same as H7640 (שֹׁבֶל); overflowing; Shobal, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites KJV: Shobal.

H7733.def: active participle from a primitive root meaning to leave (compare H7662 (שְׁבַק)); forsaking; Shobek, an Israelite KJV: Shobek.

H7734.def: a primitive root; to retreat KJV: turn back.

H7735.def: a primitive root; to hedge in KJV: make to grow.

H7736.def: a primitive root; properly, to swell up, i.e. figuratively (by implication of insolence) to devastate KJV: waste.

H7737.def: a primitive root; properly, to level, i.e. equalize; figuratively, to resemble; by implication, to adjust (i.e. counterbalance, be suitable, compose, place, yield, etc.) KJV: avail, behave, bring forth, compare, countervail, (be, make) equal, lay, be (make, a-) like, make plain, profit, reckon.

H7738.def: a primitive root; to destroy KJV: [idiom] substance (from the margin).

H7739.def: (Aramaic); corresponding to H7737 (שָׁוָה); to resemble KJV: make like.

H7740.def: from H7737 (שָׁוָה); plain; Shaveh, a place in Palestine KJV: Shaveh.

H7741.gloss: Shaveh-Kirjathajim, a place East of the Jordan
H7741.def: from the same as H7740 (שָׁוֵה) and the dual of H7151 (קִרְיָה); plain of a double city; Shaveh-Kirjathajim, a place East of the Jordan KJV: Shaveh Kiriathaim.

H7742.def: a primitive root; to muse pensively KJV: meditate.

H7743.def: a primitive root; to sink, literally or figuratively KJV: bow down, incline, humble.

H7744.def: from H7743 (שׁוּחַ); dell; Shuach, a son of Abraham KJV: Shuah.

H7745.def: from H7743 (שׁוּחַ); a chasm KJV: ditch, pit.

H7746.def: the same as H7745 (שׁוּחָה); Shuchah, an Israelite KJV: Shuah.

H7747.gloss: a Shuchite or descendant of Shuach
H7747.def: patronymic from H7744 (שׁוּחַ); a Shuchite or descendant of Shuach KJV: Shuhite.

H7748.def: from H7743 (שׁוּחַ); humbly; Shucham, an Israelite KJV: Shuham.

H7749.def: patronymic from H7748 (שׁוּחָם); a Shuchamite (collectively) KJV: Shuhamites.

H7750.def: or (by permutation) סוּט; a primitive root; to detrude, i.e. (intransitively and figuratively) become derelict (wrongly practise; namely, idolatry) KJV: turn aside to.

H7751.def: a primitive root; properly, to push forth; (but used only figuratively) to lash, i.e. (the sea with oars) to row; by implication, to travel KJV: go (about, through, to and fro), mariner, rower, run to and fro.

H7752.def: from H7751 (שׁוּט); a lash (literally or figuratively) KJV: scourge, whip.

H7753.def: a primitive root; to entwine, i.e. shut in (for formation, protection or restraint) KJV: fence, (make an) hedge (up).

H7754.def: or (feminine) שׂוֹכָה; from H7753 (שׂוּךְ); a branch (as interleaved) KJV: bough.

H7755.gloss: Sokoh or Soko, the name of two places in Palestine
H7755.def: or שֹׂכֹה; or שׂוֹכוֹ; from H7753 (שׂוּךְ); Sokoh or Soko, the name of two places in Palestine KJV: Shocho, Shochoh, Sochoh, Soco, Socoh.

H7756.gloss: a Sukathite or descendant of an unknown Israelite named Sukah
H7756.def: probably patronymic from a name corresponding to H7754 (שׂוֹךְ) (feminine); a Sukathite or descendant of an unknown Israelite named Sukah KJV: Suchathite.

H7757.def: from an unused root meaning to hang down; a skirt; by implication, a bottom edge KJV: hem, skirt, train.

H7758.def: or שֵׁילָל; (Micah 1:8), from H7997 (שָׁלַל); nude (especially bare-foot); by implication, captive KJV: spoiled, stripped.

H7759.gloss: peaceful (with the article always prefixed, making it a pet name)

H7760.gloss: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
H7760.def: or שִׂים; a primitive root; to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically) KJV: [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring, call (a name), care, cast in, change, charge, commit, consider, convey, determine, [phrase] disguise, dispose, do, get, give, heap up, hold, impute, lay (down, up), leave, look, make (out), mark, [phrase] name, [idiom] on, ordain, order, [phrase] paint, place, preserve, purpose, put (on), [phrase] regard, rehearse, reward, (cause to) set (on, up), shew, [phrase] stedfastly, take, [idiom] tell, [phrase] tread down, (over-)turn, [idiom] wholly, work.

H7761.gloss: {to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)}
H7761.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7760 (שׂוּם) {to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)} KJV: [phrase] command, give, lay, make, [phrase] name, [phrase] regard, set.

H7762.def: from an unused root meaning to exhale; garlic (from its rank odor) KJV: garlic.

H7763.gloss: Shomer, the name of two Israelites
H7763.def: or שֹׁמֵר; active participle of H8104 (שָׁמַר); keeper; Shomer, the name of two Israelites KJV: Shomer.

H7765.gloss: a Shunite (collectively) or descendants of Shuni
H7765.def: patronymic from H7764 (שׁוּנִי); a Shunite (collectively) or descendants of Shuni KJV: Shunites.

H7767.gloss: a Shunammitess, or female inhabitant of Shunem
H7767.def: patrial from H7766 (שׁוּנֵם); a Shunammitess, or female inhabitant of Shunem KJV: Shunamite.

H7768.def: a primitive root; properly, to be free; but used only causatively and reflexively, to halloo (for help, i.e. freedom from some trouble) KJV: cry (aloud, out), shout.

H7769.def: from H7768 (שָׁוַע); a halloo KJV: cry, riches.

H7770.def: the same as H7769 (שׁוּעַ); Shua, a Canaanite KJV: Shua, Shuah.

H7771.def: from H7768 (שָׁוַע) in the original sense of freedom; a noble, i.e. liberal, opulent; also (as noun in the derived sense) a halloo KJV: bountiful, crying, rich.

H7772.def: the same as H7771 (שׁוֹעַ); rich; Shoa, an Oriental people KJV: Shoa.

H7773.def: from H7768 (שָׁוַע); a halloo KJV: cry.

H7774.def: from H7768 (שָׁוַע); wealth; Shua, an Israelitess KJV: Shua.

H7775.def: feminine of H7773 (שֶׁוַע); a hallooing KJV: crying.

H7777.gloss: Shual, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine
H7777.def: the same as H7776 (שׁוּעָל); Shual, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine KJV: Shual.

H7778.def: or שֹׁעֵר active participle of H8176 (שָׁעַר) (as denominative from H8179 (שַׁעַר)); a janitor KJV: doorkeeper, porter.

H7780.def: from H8210 (שָׁפַךְ); poured; Shophak, a Syrian KJV: Shophach.

H7781.gloss: a Shuphamite (collectively) or descendants of Shephupham
H7781.def: patronymic from H8197 (שְׁפוּפָם); a Shuphamite (collectively) or descendants of Shephupham KJV: Shuphamite.

H7784.def: from H7783 (שׁוּק); a street (as run over) KJV: street.

H7792.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7791 (שׁוּר) {a wall (as going about)} KJV: wall.

H7796.def: the same as H8321 (שֹׂרֵק); a vine; Sorek, a valley in Palestine KJV: Sorek.

H7798.def: from H7797 (שׂוּשׂ); joyful; Shavsha, an Israelite KJV: Shavsha.

H7799.gloss: a lily (from its whiteness), as aflower of architectural ornament

H7806.def: a primitive root; to twist (a thread of straw) KJV: twine.

H7807.def: from H7817 (שָׁחַח); sunk, i.e. downcast KJV: [phrase] humble.

H7808.def: for H7879 (שִׂיחַ); communion, i.e. (reflexively) meditation KJV: thought.

H7809.def: a primitive root; to donate, i.e. bribe KJV: hire, give a reward.

H7810.def: from H7809 (שָׁחַד); a donation (venal or redemptive) KJV: bribe(-ry), gift, present, reward.

H7811.def: a primitive root; to swim; causatively, to inundate KJV: (make to) swim.

H7814.def: or שְׂחֹק; from H7832 (שָׂחַק); laughter (in merriment or defiance) KJV: derision, laughter(-ed to scorn, -ing), mocked, sport.

H7815.def: from H7835 (שָׁחַר); dinginess, i.e. perhaps soot KJV: coal.

H7820.def: a primitive root (identical with H7819 (שָׁחַט) through the idea of striking); to hammer out KJV: beat.

H7822.def: from an unused root probably meaning to burn; inflammation, i.e. an ulcer KJV: boil, botch.

H7823.def: or סָחִישׁ; from an unused root apparently meaning to sprout; aftergrowth KJV: (that) which springeth of the same.

H7824.def: from the same as H7828 (שַׁחַף); a board (as chipped thin) KJV: cieled with.

H7825.def: from H7812 (שָׁחָה); a pit-fall (literally or figuratively) KJV: destruction, pit.

H7826.def: from an unused root probably meaning to roar; a lion (from his characteristic roar) KJV: (fierce) lion.

H7830.def: from an unused root apparently meaning to strut; haughtiness (as evinced by the attitude) KJV: [idiom] lion, pride.

H7831.def: from the same as H7830 (שַׁחַץ); proudly; Shachatsom, a place in Palestine KJV: Shahazimah (from the margin).

H7832.def: a primitive root; to laugh (in pleasure or detraction); by implication, to play KJV: deride, have in derision, laugh, make merry, mock(-er), play, rejoice, (laugh to) scorn, be in (make) sport.

H7837.def: from H7836 (שָׁחַר); dawn (literal, figurative or adverbial) KJV: day(-spring), early, light, morning, whence riseth.

H7839.def: from H7836 (שָׁחַר); a dawning, i.e. (figuratively) juvenescence KJV: youth.

H7842.def: dual of H7837 (שַׁחַר); double dawn; Shacharajim, an Israelite KJV: Shaharaim.

H7844.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7843 (שָׁחַת) {to decay, i.e. (causatively) ruin (literally or figuratively)} KJV: corrupt, fault.

H7847.def: a primitive root; to deviate from duty KJV: decline, go aside, turn.

H7851.gloss: Shittim, a place East of the Jordan

H7852.def: a primitive root; properly, to lurk for, i.e. persecute KJV: hate, oppose self against.

H7853.def: a primitive root; to attack, (figuratively) accuse KJV: (be an) adversary, resist.

H7854.def: from H7853 (שָׂטַן); an opponent; especially (with the article prefixed) Satan, the arch-enemy of good KJV: adversary, Satan, withstand.

H7855.def: from H7853 (שָׂטַן); opposition (by letter) KJV: accusation.

H7856.gloss: Sitnah, the name of a well in Pal
H7856.def: the same as H7855 (שִׂטְנָה); Sitnah, the name of a well in Pal KJV: Sitnah.

H7857.def: a primitive root; to gush; by implication, to inundate, cleanse; by analogy, to gallop, conquer KJV: drown, (over-) flow(-whelm, rinse, run, rush, (throughly) wash (away).

H7858.def: or שֵׁטֶף; from H7857 (שָׁטַף); a deluge (literally or figuratively) KJV: flood, outrageous, overflowing.

H7859.def: (Aramaic) of uncertain derivation; a side KJV: side.

H7860.def: active participle of an otherwise unused root probably meaning to write; properly, a scribe, i.e. (by analogy or implication) an official superintendent or magistrate KJV: officer, overseer, ruler.

H7861.def: from the same as H7860 (שֹׁטֵר); magisterial; Shitrai, an Israelite KJV: Shitrai.

H7862.def: probably from H7737 (שָׁוָה); a gift (as available) KJV: present.

H7863.def: from the same as H7721 (שׂוֹא) by permutation; elevation KJV: excellency.

H7864.def: for H7724 (שְׁוָא); Sheja, an Israelite KJV: Sheva (from the margin).

H7865.gloss: Sion, the summit of Mount Hermon
H7865.def: from H7863 (שִׂיא); peak; Sion, the summit of Mount Hermon KJV: Sion.

H7866.def: from the same as H7722 (שׁוֹא); ruin; Shijon, a place in Palestine KJV: Shihon.

H7867.def: a primitive root; properly, to become aged, i.e. (by implication) to grow gray KJV: (be) grayheaded.

H7868.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7867 (שִׂיב) {properly, to become aged, i.e. (by implication) to grow gray} KJV: elder.

H7869.def: from H7867 (שִׂיב); old age KJV: age.

H7870.def: by permutation from H7725 (שׁוּב); a return (of property) KJV: captivity.

H7872.def: feminine of H7869 (שֵׂיב); old age KJV: (be) gray (grey hoar,-y) hairs (head,-ed), old age.

H7873.def: from H7734 (שׂוּג); a withdrawal (into a private place) KJV: pursuing.

H7874.def: a primitive root probably meaning to boil up (compare H7736 (שׁוּד)); used only as denominative from H7875 (שִׂיד); to plaster KJV: plaister.

H7875.def: from H7874 (שִׂיד)lemma שׂיד missing vowel, corrected to שִׂיד; lime (as boiling when slacked) KJV: lime, plaister.

H7876.def: a primitive root; to keep in memory KJV: be unmindful. (Render Deuteronomy 32:18, 'A Rock bore thee, thou must recollect; and (yet) thou hast forgotten,' etc.)

H7877.def: of unknown derivation; Shiza, an Israelite KJV: Shiza.

H7878.def: a primitive root; to ponder, i.e. (by implication) converse (with oneself, and hence, aloud) or (transitively) utter KJV: commune, complain, declare, meditate, muse, pray, speak, talk (with).

H7879.def: from H7878 (שִׂיחַ); a contemplation; by implication, an utterance KJV: babbling, communication, complaint, meditation, prayer, talk.

H7880.gloss: a shoot (as if uttered or put forth), i
H7880.def: from H7878 (שִׂיחַ); a shoot (as if uttered or put forth), i.e. (generally) shrubbery KJV: bush, plant, shrub.

H7881.def: feminine of H7879 (שִׂיחַ); reflection; be extension, devotion KJV: meditation, prayer.

H7882.def: for H7745 (שׁוּחָה); a pit-fall KJV: pit.

H7883.def: or שִׁחוֹר; or שִׁחֹר; probably from H7835 (שָׁחַר); dark, i.e. turbid; Shichor, a stream of Egypt KJV: Shihor, Sihor.

H7884.def: from the same as H7883 (שִׁיחוֹר) and H3835 (לָבַן); darkish whiteness; Shichor-Libnath, a stream of Palestine KJV: Shihor-libnath.

H7885.def: from H7751 (שׁוּט); also compare H7752 (שׁוֹט) an oar; a scourge (figuratively) KJV: oar, scourge.

H7886.gloss: Shiloh, an epithet of the Messiah
H7886.def: from H7951 (שָׁלָה); tranquil; Shiloh, an epithet of the Messiah KJV: Shiloh.

H7887.def: or שִׁלֹה; or שִׁילוֹ; or שִׁלוֹ; from the same as H7886 (שִׁילֹה); Shiloh, a place in Palestine KJV: Shiloh.

H7888.gloss: a Shilonite or inhabitant of Shiloh
H7888.def: or שִׁילֹנִי; or שִׁלֹנִי; from H7887 (שִׁילֹה); a Shilonite or inhabitant of Shiloh KJV: Shilonite.

H7889.def: apparently for H3452 (יְשִׁימוֹן); desert; Shimon, an Israelite KJV: Shimon.

H7890.def: from an unused root meaning to urinate; urine KJV: piss.

H7891.def: or (the original form) שׁוּר; (1 Samuel 18:6), a primitive root (rather identical with H7788 (שׁוּר) through the idea of strolling minstrelsy); to sing KJV: behold (by mistake for H7789 (שׁוּר)), sing(-er, -ing man, -ing woman).

H7892.def: or feminine שִׁירָה; from H7891 (שִׁיר); a song; abstractly, singing KJV: musical(-ick), [idiom] sing(-er, -ing), song.

H7893.def: from an unused root meaning to bleach, i.e. whiten;  See H8336 (שֵׁשׁ). white, i.e. marble.

H7894.def: from the same as H7893 (שַׁיִשׁ); whiteness; Shisha, an Israelite KJV: Shisha.

H7895.def: or שׁוּשַׁק; of Egyptian derivation; Shishak, an Egyptian king KJV: Shishak.

H7896.gloss: to place (in a very wide application)
H7896.def: a primitive root; to place (in a very wide application) KJV: apply, appoint, array, bring, consider, lay (up), let alone, [idiom] look, make, mark, put (on), [phrase] regard, set, shew, be stayed, [idiom] take.

H7897.def: from H7896 (שִׁית); a dress (as put on) KJV: attire.

H7898.def: from H7896 (שִׁית); scrub or trash, i.e. wild growth of weeds or briers (as if put on the field) KJV: thorns.

H7899.def: from H5526 (סָכַךְ) in the sense of H7753 (שׂוּךְ); a brier (as of a hedge) KJV: prick.

H7900.def: from H5526 (סָכַךְ) in the sense of H7753 (שׂוּךְ); a booth (as interlaced) KJV: tabernacle.

H7901.gloss: to lie down (for rest, sexual connection, decease or any other purpose)
H7901.def: a primitive root; to lie down (for rest, sexual connection, decease or any other purpose) KJV: [idiom] at all, cast down, (lover-)lay (self) (down), (make to) lie (down, down to sleep, still with), lodge, ravish, take rest, sleep, stay.

H7902.gloss: a lying down (of dew, or for the sexual act)
H7902.def: from H7901 (שָׁכַב); a lying down (of dew, or for the sexual act) KJV: [idiom] carnally, copulation, [idiom] lay, seed.

H7903.def: from H7901 (שָׁכַב); a (sexual) lying with KJV: [idiom] lie.

H7904.def: a primitive root; to roam (through lust) KJV: in the morning (by mistake for H7925 (שָׁכַם)).

H7905.gloss: a dart (as pointed like a thorn)
H7905.def: feminine of H7900 (שֹׂךְ) in the sense of H7899 (שֵׂךְ); a dart (as pointed like a thorn) KJV: barbed iron.

H7906.def: from an unused root apparently meaning to surmount; an observatory (with the article); Seku, a place in Palestine KJV: Sechu.

H7907.def: from the same as H7906 (שֵׂכוּ); observant, i.e. (concretely) the mind KJV: heart.

H7908.def: infinitive of H7921 (שָׁכֹל); bereavement KJV: loss of children, spoiling.

H7909.def: or שַׁכֻּל; from H7921 (שָׁכֹל); bereaved KJV: barren, bereaved (robbed) of children (whelps).

H7910.gloss: intoxicated, as astate or a habit
H7910.def: or שִׁכֹּר; from H7937 (שָׁכַר); intoxicated, as astate or a habit KJV: drunk(-ard, -en, -en man).

H7911.def: or שָׁכֵחַ; a primitive root; to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of, from want of memory or attention KJV: [idiom] at all, (cause to) forget.

H7912.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7911 (שָׁכַח) through the idea of disclosure of a covered or forgotten thing; to discover (literally or figuratively) KJV: find.

H7914.def: feminine from the same as H7906 (שֵׂכוּ); a conspicuous object KJV: picture.

H7915.def: intensive perhaps from the same as H7906 (שֵׂכוּ) in the sense of H7753 (שׂוּךְ); a knife (as pointed or edged) KJV: knife.

H7916.gloss: a man at wages  by the day or year
H7916.def: from H7936 (שָׂכַר); a man at wages  by the day or year KJV: hired (man, servant), hireling.

H7917.def: feminine of H7916 (שָׂכִיר); a hiring KJV: that is hired.

H7918.def: a primitive root; to weave (i.e. lay) a trap; figuratively, (through the idea of secreting) to allay (passions; physically, abate a flood) KJV: appease, assuage, make to cease, pacify, set.

H7919.gloss: to be (causatively, make or act) circumspect and hence, intelligent
H7919.def: a primitive root; to be (causatively, make or act) circumspect and hence, intelligent KJV: consider, expert, instruct, prosper, (deal) prudent(-ly), (give) skill(-ful), have good success, teach, (have, make to) understand(-ing), wisdom, (be, behave self, consider, make) wise(-ly), guide wittingly.

H7920.gloss: {to be (causatively, make or act) circumspect and hence, intelligent}
H7920.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7919 (שָׂכַל) {to be (causatively, make or act) circumspect and hence, intelligent} KJV: consider.

H7921.def: a primitive root; properly, to miscarry, i.e. suffer abortion; by analogy, to bereave (literally or figuratively) KJV: bereave (of children), barren, cast calf (fruit, young), be (make) childless, deprive, destroy, [idiom] expect, lose children, miscarry, rob of children, spoil.

H7922.def: or שֵׂכֶל; from H7919 (שָׂכַל); intelligence; by implication, success KJV: discretion, knowledge, policy, prudence, sense, understanding, wisdom, wise.

H7923.def: plural from H7921 (שָׁכֹל); childlessness (by continued bereavements) KJV: to have after loss of others.

H7925.gloss: literally, to load up (on the back of man or beast), i
H7925.def: a primitive root; properly, to incline (the shoulder to a burden); but used only as denominative from H7926 (שְׁכֶם); literally, to load up (on the back of man or beast), i.e. to start early in the morning KJV: (arise, be up, get (oneself) up, rise up) early (betimes), morning.

H7926.gloss: the neck (between the shoulders) as the place of burdens
H7926.def: from H7925 (שָׁכַם); the neck (between the shoulders) as the place of burdens; figuratively, the spur of ahill KJV: back, [idiom] consent, portion, shoulder.

H7927.def: the same as H7926 (שְׁכֶם); ridge; Shekem, a place in Palestine KJV: Shechem.

H7928.gloss: Shekem, the name of a Hivite and two Israelites
H7928.def: for H7926 (שְׁכֶם); Shekem, the name of a Hivite and two Israelites KJV: Shechem.

H7929.def: feminine of H7926 (שְׁכֶם); the shoulderbone KJV: shoulder blade.

H7930.gloss: a Shikmite (collectively), or descendants of Shekem
H7930.def: patronymic from H7928 (שֶׁכֶם); a Shikmite (collectively), or descendants of Shekem KJV: Shichemites.

H7931.gloss: to reside or permanently stay (literally or figuratively)
H7931.def: a primitive root (apparently akin (by transmission) to H7901 (שָׁכַב) through the idea of lodging; compare H5531 (סִכְלוּת), H7925 (שָׁכַם)); to reside or permanently stay (literally or figuratively) KJV: abide, continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-er), have habitation, inhabit, lay, place, (cause to) remain, rest, set (up).

H7932.gloss: {to reside or permanently stay (literally or figuratively)}
H7932.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7931 (שָׁכַן) {to reside or permanently stay (literally or figuratively)} KJV: cause to dwell, have habitation.

H7933.def: from H7931 (שָׁכַן); a residence KJV: habitation.

H7934.def: from H7931 (שָׁכַן); a resident; by extension, a fellow-citizen KJV: inhabitant, neighbour, nigh.

H7935.gloss: Shekanjah, the name of nine Israelites
H7935.def: or (prolonged) שְׁכַנְיָהוּ; from H7931 (שָׁכַן) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has dwelt; Shekanjah, the name of nine Israelites KJV: Shecaniah, Shechaniah.

H7936.def: or (by permutation) סָכַר; (Ezra 4:5), a primitive root (apparently akin (by prosthesis) to H3739 (כָּרָה) through the idea of temporary purchase; compare H7937 (שָׁכַר)); to hire KJV: earn wages, hire (out self), reward, [idiom] surely.

H7937.def: a primitive root; to become tipsy; in a qualified sense, to satiate with astimulating drink or (figuratively) influence KJV: (be filled with) drink (abundantly), (be, make) drunk(-en), be merry. (Superlative of H8248 (שָׁקָה).)

H7938.def: from H7936 (שָׂכַר); wages KJV: reward, sluices.

H7939.def: from H7936 (שָׂכַר); payment of contract; concretely, salary, fare, maintenance; by implication, compensation, benefit KJV: hire, price, reward(-ed), wages, worth.

H7940.gloss: Sakar, the name of two Israelites
H7940.def: the same as H7939 (שָׂכָר); recompense; Sakar, the name of two Israelites KJV: Sacar.

H7941.def: from H7937 (שָׁכַר); an intoxicant, i.e. intensely alcoholic liquor KJV: strong drink, [phrase] drunkard, strong wine.

H7942.gloss: drunkenness, Shikkeron, a place in Palestine
H7942.def: for H7943 (שִׁכָּרוֹן); drunkenness, Shikkeron, a place in Palestine KJV: Shicron.

H7944.def: from H7952 (שָׁלָה) abbreviated form; a fault KJV: error.

H7945.def: for the rel. H834 (אֲשֶׁר); used with prepositional prefix, and often followed by some pronominal affix; on account of, whatsoever, whichsoever KJV: cause, sake.

H7946.def: for H7600 (שַׁאֲנָן); tranquil KJV: being at ease.

H7947.def: a primitive root; to space off; intensive (evenly) to make equidistant KJV: equally distant, set in order.

H7948.gloss: a spacer or raised interval, i
H7948.def: from H7947 (שָׁלַב); a spacer or raised interval, i.e. the stile in aframe or panel KJV: ledge.

H7949.gloss: to be snow-white (with the linen clothing of the slain)
H7949.def: a primitive root; properly, meaning to be white; used only as denominative from H7950 (שֶׁלֶג); to be snow-white (with the linen clothing of the slain) KJV: be as snow.

H7950.def: from H7949 (שָׁלַג); snow (probably from its whiteness) KJV: snow(-y).

H7951.def: or שָׁלַו; (Job 3:26), a primitive root; to be tranquil, i.e. secure or successful KJV: be happy, prosper, be in safety.

H7952.def: a primitive root (probably identical with H7953 (שָׁלָה) through the idea of educing); to mislead KJV: deceive, be negligent.

H7953.gloss: to draw out or off, i
H7953.def: a primitive root (rather cognate (by contraction) to the base of H5394 (נָשַׁל), H7997 (שָׁלַל) and their congeners through the idea of extracting); to draw out or off, i.e. remove (the soul by death) KJV: take away.

H7954.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7951 (שָׁלָה); to be secure KJV: at rest.

H7955.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H7952 (שָׁלָה); a wrong KJV: thing amiss.

H7956.gloss: Shelah, the name of a postdiluvian patriarch and of an Israelite
H7956.def: the same as H7596 (שְׁאֵלָה) (shortened); request; Shelah, the name of a postdiluvian patriarch and of an Israelite KJV: Shelah.

H7957.def: from the same as H3851 (לַהַב) with sibilant prefix; a flare of fire KJV: (flaming) flame.

H7958.gloss: the quail collectively (as slow in flight from its weight)
H7958.def: or שְׂלָיו; by orthographical variation from H7951 (שָׁלָה) through the idea of sluggishness; the quail collectively (as slow in flight from its weight) KJV: quails.

H7960.def: (Aramaic) or שָׁלוּת; (Aramaic), from the same as H7955 (שָׁלָה); a fault KJV: error, [idiom] fail, thing amiss.

H7961.def: or שָׁלֵיו; feminine שְׁלֵוָה; from H7951 (שָׁלָה); tranquil; (in a bad sense) careless; abstractly, security KJV: (being) at ease, peaceable, (in) prosper(-ity), quiet(-ness), wealthy.

H7962.def: from H7951 (שָׁלָה); security (genuine or false) KJV: abundance, peace(-ably), prosperity, quietness.

H7963.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7962 (שַׁלְוָה); safety KJV: tranquillity. See also H7961 (שָׁלֵו).

H7964.def: or שִׁלֻּחַ; from H7971 (שָׁלַח); (only in plural) a dismissal, i.e. (of a wife) divorce (especially the document); also (of a daughter) dower KJV: presents, have sent back.

H7965.def: or שָׁלֹם; from H7999 (שָׁלַם); safe, i.e. (figuratively) well, happy, friendly; also (abstractly) welfare, i.e. health, prosperity, peace KJV: [idiom] do, familiar, [idiom] fare, favour, [phrase] friend, [idiom] great, (good) health, ([idiom] perfect, such as be at) peace(-able, -ably), prosper(-ity, -ous), rest, safe(-ty), salute, welfare, ([idiom] all is, be) well, [idiom] wholly.

H7966.def: or שִׁלֻּם; from H7999 (שָׁלַם); a requital, i.e. (secure) retribution, (venal) a fee KJV: recompense, reward.

H7967.gloss: Shallum, the name of fourteen Israelites
H7967.def: or (shorter) שַׁלֻּם; the same as H7966 (שִׁלּוּם); Shallum, the name of fourteen Israelites KJV: Shallum.

H7968.def: probably for H7967 (שַׁלּוּם); Shallun, an Israelite KJV: Shallum.

H7969.def: or שָׁלֹשׁ; masculine שְׁלוֹשָׁה; or שְׁלֹשָׁה; a primitive number; three; occasionally (ordinal) third, or (multiple) thrice KJV: [phrase] fork, [phrase] often(-times), third, thir(-teen, -teenth), three, [phrase] thrice. Compare H7991 (שָׁלִישׁ).

H7970.def: or שְׁלֹשִׁים; multiple of H7969 (שָׁלוֹשׁ); thirty; or (ordinal) thirtieth KJV: thirty, thirtieth. Compare H7991 (שָׁלִישׁ).

H7971.gloss: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
H7971.def: a primitive root; to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications) KJV: [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring (on the way), cast (away, out), conduct, [idiom] earnestly, forsake, give (up), grow long, lay, leave, let depart (down, go, loose), push away, put (away, forth, in, out), reach forth, send (away, forth, out), set, shoot (forth, out), sow, spread, stretch forth (out).

H7972.gloss: {to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)}
H7972.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7971 (שָׁלַח) {to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)} KJV: put, send.

H7973.def: from H7971 (שָׁלַח); a missile of attack, i.e. spear; also (figuratively) a shoot of growth; i.e. branch KJV: dart, plant, [idiom] put off, sword, weapon.

H7974.def: the same as H7973 (שֶׁלַח); Shelach, a postdiluvian patriarch KJV: Salah, Shelah. Compare H7975 (שִׁלֹחַ)lemma שִׁלֹּחַ extra dagesh, corrected to שִׁלֹחַ.

H7975.def: or (in imitation of H7974 (שֶׁלַח)) שֶׁלַח; (Nehemiah 3:15), from H7971 (שָׁלַח); rill; Shiloach, a fountain of Jerusalem KJV: Shiloah, Siloah.

H7976.def: feminine of H7964 (שִׁלּוּחַ); a shoot KJV: branch.

H7977.def: from H7973 (שֶׁלַח); missive, i.e. armed; Shilchi, an Israelite KJV: Shilhi.

H7978.def: plural of H7973 (שֶׁלַח); javelins or sprouts; Shilchim, a place in Palestine KJV: Shilhim.

H7979.def: from H7971 (שָׁלַח); a table (as spread out); by implication, a meal KJV: table.

H7980.def: a primitive root; to dominate, i.e. govern; by implication, to permit KJV: (bear, have) rule, have dominion, give (have) power.

H7981.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7980 (שָׁלַט) {to dominate, i.e. govern; by implication, to permit} KJV: have the mastery, have power, bear rule, be (make) ruler.

H7982.def: from H7980 (שָׁלַט); probably a shield (as controlling, i.e. protecting the person) KJV: shield.

H7984.def: (Aramaic) or שִׁלְטֹןlemma שִׁלְטן missing vowel, corrected to שִׁלְטֹן; corresponding to H7983 (שִׁלְטוֹן) {a potentate} KJV: ruler.

H7985.def: (Aramaic) from H7981 (שְׁלֵט); empire (abstractly or concretely) KJV: dominion.

H7986.def: feminine from H7980 (שָׁלַט); a vixen KJV: imperious.

H7988.gloss: a fetus or babe (as extruded in birth)
H7988.def: feminine from H7953 (שָׁלָה); a fetus or babe (as extruded in birth) KJV: young one.

H8564.def: from the same root as H8558 (תָּמָר); an erection, i.e. pillar (probably for a guide-board) KJV: high heap.

H8565.def: from an unused root probably meaning to elongate; a monster (as preternaturally formed), i.e. a sea-serpent (or other huge marine animal); also a jackal (or other hideous land animal) KJV: dragon, whale. Compare H8577 (תַּנִּין).

H8566.def: a primitive root; to present (a mercenary inducement), i.e. bargain with (a harlot) KJV: hire.

H8567.def: a primitive root (identical with through the idea of attributing honor); to ascribe (praise), i.e. celebrate, commemorate KJV: lament, rehearse.

H8568.def: probably feminine of H8565 (תַּן); a female jackal KJV: dragon.

H8569.def: from H5106 (נוּא); alienation; by implication, enmity KJV: breach of promise, occasion.

H8570.def: from H5107 (נוּב); produce KJV: fruit, increase.

H8571.def: perhaps from the same as H594 (אֲנָךְ) through the idea of protraction; a pinnacle, i.e. extremity KJV: tip.

H8572.def: from H5123 (נוּם); drowsiness, i.e. sleep KJV: slumber(-ing).

H8573.def: from H5130 (נוּף); a brandishing (in threat); by implication, tumult; specifically, the official undulation of sacrificial offerings KJV: offering, shaking, wave (offering).

H8574.def: from H5216 (נִיר); a fire-pot KJV: furnace, oven.

H8575.def: or תַּנְחֻם; and (feminine) תַּנְחוּמָה; from H5162 (נָחַם); compassion, solace KJV: comfort, consolation.

H8576.def: for H8575 (תַּנְחוּם) (feminine); Tanchumeth, an Israelite KJV: Tanhumeth.

H8577.gloss: a marine or land monster, i
H8577.def: or תַּנִּים; (Ezekiel 29:3), intensive from the same as H8565 (תַּן); a marine or land monster, i.e. sea-serpent or jackal KJV: dragon, sea-monster, serpent, whale.

H8578.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H8147 (שְׁנַיִם); second KJV: second.

H8579.def: (Aramaic) from H8578 (תִּנְיָן); a second time KJV: again.

H8580.def: from H5395 (נָשַׁם); properly, a hard breather, i.e. the name of two unclean creatures, a lizard and abird (both perhaps from changing color through their irascibility), probably the tree-toad and the water-hen KJV: mole, swan.

H8581.def: a primitive root; to loathe, i.e. (morally) detest KJV: (make to be) abhor(-red), (be, commit more, do) abominable(-y), [idiom] utterly.

H8582.def: a primitive root; to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray (literally or figuratively); also causative of both KJV: (cause to) go astray, deceive, dissemble, (cause to, make to) err, pant, seduce, (make to) stagger, (cause to) wander, be out of the way.

H8583.gloss: Tou or Toi, a Syrian king
H8583.def: or תֹּעִי; from H8582 (תָּעָה); error Tou or Toi, a Syrian king KJV: Toi, Tou.

H8584.def: from H5749 (עוּד); attestation, i.e. a precept, usage KJV: testimony.

H8585.gloss: a channel (into which water is raised for irrigation)
H8585.def: from H5927 (עָלָה); a channel (into which water is raised for irrigation); also a bandage or plaster (as placed upon a wound) KJV: conduit, cured, healing, little river, trench, watercourse.

H8586.gloss: caprice (as a fit coming on), i
H8586.def: from H5953 (עָלַל); caprice (as a fit coming on), i.e. vexation; concretely a tyrant KJV: babe, delusion.

H8587.def: from H5956 (עָלַם); a secret KJV: thing that is hid, secret.

H8588.def: or תַּעֲנֻג; and (feminine) תַּעֲנֻגָה; from H6026 (עָנַג); luxury KJV: delicate, delight, pleasant.

H8589.def: from H6031 (עָנָה); affliction (of self), i.e. fasting KJV: heaviness.

H8590.gloss: Taanak or Tanak, a place in Palestine
H8590.def: or תַּעְנָךְ; of uncertain derivation; Taanak or Tanak, a place in Palestine KJV: Taanach, Tanach.

H8591.def: a primitive root; to cheat; by analogy, to maltreat KJV: deceive, misuse.

H8592.def: from H6105 (עָצַם); might (plural collective) KJV: power.

H8593.gloss: a knife or razor (as making bare)
H8593.def: from H6168 (עָרָה); a knife or razor (as making bare); also a scabbard (as being bare, i.e. empty) KJV: (pen-) knife, razor, scabbard, shave, sheath.

H8594.def: from H6148 (עָרַב); suretyship, i.e. (concretely) a pledge KJV: [phrase] hostage.

H8595.def: from H8591 (תָּעַע); a fraud KJV: error.

H8596.def: from H8608 (תָּפַף) contracted; a tambourine KJV: tabret, timbrel.

H8597.gloss: ornament (abstractly or concretely, literally or figuratively)
H8597.def: or תִּפְאֶרֶת; from H6286 (פָּאַר); ornament (abstractly or concretely, literally or figuratively) KJV: beauty(-iful), bravery, comely, fair, glory(-ious), honour, majesty.

H8598.def: from H5301 (נָפַח); an apple (from its fragrance), i.e. the fruit or the tree (probably includ. others of the pome order, as the quince, the orange, etc.) KJV: apple (tree). See also H1054 (בֵּית תַּפּוּחַ).

H8599.gloss: Tappuach, the name of two places in Palestine, also of an Israelite
H8599.def: the same as H8598 (תַּפּוּחַ); Tappuach, the name of two places in Palestine, also of an Israelite KJV: Tappuah.

H8600.def: from H6327 (פּוּץ); a dispersal KJV: dispersion.

H8601.def: from H644 (אָפָה); cookery, i.e. (concretely) a cake KJV: baked piece.

H8602.def: from an unused root meaning to smear; plaster (as gummy) or slime; (figuratively) frivolity KJV: foolish things, unsavoury, untempered.

H8603.gloss: Tophel, a place near the Desert
H8603.def: from the same as H8602 (תָּפֵל); quagmire; Tophel, a place near the Desert KJV: Tophel.

H8604.def: from the same as H8602 (תָּפֵל); frivolity KJV: folly, foolishly.

H8605.def: from H6419 (פָּלַל); intercession, supplication; by implication, a hymn KJV: prayer.

H8607.def: from H6452 (פָּסַח); ford; Tiphsach, a place in Mesopotamia KJV: Tipsah.

H8608.def: a primitive root; to drum, i.e. play (as) on the tambourine KJV: taber, play with timbrels.

H8609.def: a primitive root; to sew KJV: (women that) sew (together).

H8610.def: a primitive root; to manipulate, i.e. seize; chiefly to capture, wield, specifically, to overlay; figuratively, to use unwarrantably KJV: catch, handle, (lay, take) hold (on, over), stop, [idiom] surely, surprise, take.

H8611.def: from the base of H8608 (תָּפַף); a smiting, i.e. (figuratively) contempt KJV: tabret.

H8612.def: the same as H8611 (תֹּפֶת); Topheth, a place near Jerusalem KJV: Tophet, Topheth.

H8613.def: probably a form of H8612 (תֹּפֶת); Tophteh, a place of cremation KJV: Tophet.

H8614.def: (Aramaic) perhaps from H8199 (שָׁפַט); judicial, i.e. a lawyer KJV: sheriff.

H8615.def: from H6960 (קָוָה); (compare H6961 (קָוֶה)) literally a cord (as an attachment); figuratively, expectancy KJV: expectation(-ted), hope, live, thing that I long for.

H8616.gloss: Tikvah, the name of two Israelites
H8616.def: the same as H8615 (תִּקְוָה); Tikvah, the name of two Israelites KJV: Tikvah.

H8617.def: from H6965 (קוּם); resistfulness KJV: power to stand.

H8618.def: from H6965 (קוּם); an opponent KJV: rise up against.

H8619.def: from H8628 (תָּקַע) (in the musical sense); a trumpet KJV: trumpet.

H8620.def: a form of H8619 (תָּקוֹעַ); Tekoa, a place in Palestine KJV: Tekoa, Tekoah.

H8621.gloss: a Tekoite or inhabitant of Tekoah
H8621.def: or תְּקֹעִי; patronymically from H8620 (תְּקוֹעַ); a Tekoite or inhabitant of Tekoah KJV: Tekoite.

H8622.def: or תְּקֻפָה; from H5362 (נָקַף); a revolution, i.e. (of the sun) course, (of time) lapse KJV: circuit, come about, end.

H8624.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H8623 (תַּקִּיף) {powerful} KJV: mighty, strong.

H8625.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H8254 (שָׁקַל); to balance KJV: Tekel, be weighed.

H8626.def: a primitive root; to equalize, i.e. straighten (intransitive or transitive); figuratively, to compose KJV: set in order, make straight.

H8627.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H8626 (תָּקַן); to straighten up, i.e. confirm KJV: establish.

H8628.def: a primitive root; to clatter, i.e. slap (the hands together), clang (an instrument); by analogy, to drive (a nail or tent-pin, a dart, etc.); by implication, to become bondsman by handclasping) KJV: blow (a trumpet), cast, clap, fasten, pitch (tent), smite, sound, strike, [idiom] suretiship, thrust.

H8629.def: from H8628 (תָּקַע); a blast of a trumpet KJV: sound.

H8630.def: a primitive root; to overpower KJV: prevail (against).

H8631.gloss: to become (causatively, make) mighty or (figuratively) obstinate
H8631.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H8630 (תָּקַף); to become (causatively, make) mighty or (figuratively) obstinate KJV: make firm, harden, be(-come) strong.

H8632.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H8633 (תֹּקֶף); power KJV: might, strength.

H8633.def: from H8630 (תָּקַף); might or (figuratively) positiveness KJV: authority, power, strength.

H8634.def: probably for H8653 (תַּרְעֵלָה); a reeling; Taralah, a place in Palestine KJV: Taralah.

H8635.def: from H7235 (רָבָה); multiplication, i.e. progeny KJV: increase.

H8636.def: from H7235 (רָבָה); multiplication, i.e. percentage or bonus in addition to principal KJV: increase, unjust gain.

H8637.def: a denominative from H7270 (רָגַל); to cause to walk KJV: teach to go.

H8638.def: a denominative from H7275 (רָגַם) in the sense of throwing over; to transfer, i.e. translate KJV: interpret.

H8639.def: from H7290 (רָדַם); a lethargy or (by implication) trance KJV: deep sleep.

H8640.def: of foreign derivation; Tirhakah, a king of Kush KJV: Tirhakah.

H8641.gloss: a present (as offered up), especially in sacrifice or as tribute
H8641.def: or תְּרֻמָה; (Deuteronomy 12:11), from H7311 (רוּם); a present (as offered up), especially in sacrifice or as tribute KJV: gift, heave offering (shoulder), oblation, offered(-ing).

H8642.def: formed as H8641 (תְּרוּמָה); a sacrificial offering KJV: oblation.

H8643.def: from H7321 (רוּעַ); clamor, i.e. acclamation of joy or a battle-cry; especially clangorof trumpets, as an alarum KJV: alarm, blow(-ing) (of, the) (trumpets), joy, jubile, loud noise, rejoicing, shout(-ing), (high, joyful) sound(-ing).

H8644.def: from H7322 (רוּף) in the sense of its congener H7495 (רָפָא); a remedy KJV: medicine.

H8645.gloss: a species of tree (apparently from its slenderness), perhaps the cypress
H8645.def: probably from H7329 (רָזָה); a species of tree (apparently from its slenderness), perhaps the cypress KJV: cypress.

H8646.def: of uncertain derivation; Terach, the father of Abraham; also a place in the Desert KJV: Tarah, Terah.

H8647.def: of uncertain derivation; Tirchanah, an Israelite KJV: Tirhanah.

H8648.def: (Aramaic) feminine תַּרְתֵּין; corresponding to H8147 (שְׁנַיִם); two KJV: second, [phrase] twelve, two.

H8649.def: and תַּרְמוּת; or תַּרְמִית; from H7411 (רָמָה); fraud KJV: deceit(-ful), privily.

H8650.gloss: a pole (as a mast or flagstaff)
H8650.def: probably for H766 (אֹרֶן); a pole (as a mast or flagstaff) KJV: beacon, mast.

H8651.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to H8179 (שַׁעַר); a door; by implication, a palace KJV: gate mouth.

H8652.def: (Aramaic) from H8651 (תְּרַע); a doorkeeper KJV: porter.

H8653.def: from H7477 (רָעַל); reeling KJV: astonishment, trembling.

H8654.gloss: a Tirathite or inhabitant of an unknown Tirah
H8654.def: patrial from an unused name meaning gate; a Tirathite or inhabitant of an unknown Tirah KJV: Tirathite.

H8655.gloss: Teraphim (singular or plural) a family idol
H8655.def: plural from H7495 (רָפָא); a healer; Teraphim (singular or plural) a family idol KJV: idols(-atry), images, teraphim.

H8656.def: from H7521 (רָצָה); delightsomeness; Tirtsah, a place in Palestine; also an Israelitess KJV: Tirzah.

H8657.def: of foreign derivation; Teresh, a eunuch of Xerxes KJV: Teresh.

H8658.def: probably of foreign derivation (compare H8659 (תַּרְשִׁישׁ)); a gem, perhaps the topaz KJV: beryl.

H8659.gloss: Tarshish, a place on the Mediterranean, hence, the ephithet of a merchant vessel (as if for or from that port)
H8659.def: probably the same as H8658 (תַּרְשִׁישׁ) (as the region of the stone, or the reverse); Tarshish, a place on the Mediterranean, hence, the ephithet of a merchant vessel (as if for or from that port); also the name of a Persian and of an Israelite KJV: Tarshish, Tharshish.

H8660.gloss: Tirshatha, the title of a Persian deputy or governor
H8660.def: of foreign derivation; Tirshatha, the title of a Persian deputy or governor KJV: Tirshatha.

H8661.def: of foreign derivation; Tartan, an Assyrian KJV: Tartan.

H8662.gloss: Tartak, a deity of the Avvites
H8662.def: of foreign derivation; Tartak, a deity of the Avvites KJV: Tartak.

H8663.def: from H7722 (שׁוֹא); a crashing or loud clamor KJV: crying, noise, shouting, stir.

H8664.gloss: a Tishbite or inhabitant of Tishbeh (in Gilead)
H8664.def: patrial from an unused name meaning recourse; a Tishbite or inhabitant of Tishbeh (in Gilead) KJV: Tishbite.

H8665.def: from H7660 (שָׁבַץ); checkered stuff (as reticulated) KJV: broidered.

H8666.def: or תְּשֻׁבָה; from H7725 (שׁוּב); a recurrence (of time or place); a reply (as returned) KJV: answer, be expired, return.

H8667.def: from H7760 (שׂוּם); a deposit, i.e. pledging KJV: [phrase] fellowship.

H8668.gloss: rescue (literal or figurative, persons, national or spiritual)
H8668.def: or תְּשֻׁעָה; from H7768 (שָׁוַע) in the sense of H3467 (יָשַׁע); rescue (literal or figurative, persons, national or spiritual) KJV: deliverance, help, safety, salvation, victory.

H8669.def: from H7783 (שׁוּק) in the original sense of stretching out after; a longing KJV: desire.

H8670.def: from H7788 (שׁוּר) in the sense of arrival; a gift KJV: present.

H8671.def: ordinal from H8672 (תֵּשַׁע); ninth KJV: ninth.

H8672.def: or (masculine) תִּשְׁעָה; perhaps from H8159 (שָׁעָה) through the idea of a turn to the next or full number ten; nine or (ordinal) ninth KJV: nine ([phrase] -teen, [phrase] -teenth, -th).

H8673.def: multiple from H8672 (תֵּשַׁע); ninety KJV: ninety.

H8674.def: of foreign derivation; Tattenai, a Persian KJV: Tatnai.
